    35	function newGame() {
    36	  Timers.clearAll();
    37	  Input.reset();
    38	  Fx.clear();
    39	  Game.waves = 0; Game.survivors = 0; Game.result = '';
    40	  Run.init(5);

    44	function toBase(n) {
    45	  Game.survivors = n;
    46	  if (n > Game.bestSquad) { Game.bestSquad = n; Store.set('bestSquad', n); }
    47	  Base.init(n);
    48	  Game.state = 'base';

    51	function gameOver(result) {
    52	  Game.result = result;
    53	  Game.waves = (result === 'win') ? 10 : Base.cleared;
    54	  if (Game.state !== 'over' && Game.waves > Game.best) { Game.best = Game.waves; Store.set('best', Game.best); }
    55	  Game.state = 'over';
    56	  Input.clearTaps(); Input.releases.length = 0;
    57	}

    59	function onKey(k) {
    60	  if (!Game.started) {
    61	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { document.getElementById('startBtn').click(); }
    62	    return;
    63	  }
    64	  if (Game.paused) return;
    65	  if (Game.state === 'over') {
    66	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter' || k === 'r' || k === 'R') newGame();
    67	    return;
    68	  }
    69	  if (Game.state === 'base') Base.key(k);
    70	}

    72	/* ---------- loop ---------- */
    73	var lastT = 0;
    74	function frame(now) {
    75	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    76	  var dt = (now - lastT) / 1000;
    77	  lastT = now;
    78	  if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
    79	  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
    80	  if (Game.paused || document.hidden) return;
    81	
    82	  update(dt);
    83	  render();
    84	}
    85	
    86	function update(dt) {
    87	  if (Game.state === 'run') {
    88	    Run.update(dt);
    89	    if (Run.done) {
    90	      if (Run.wiped) { Base.cleared = 0; gameOver('wiped'); Sfx.lose(); }
    91	      else { Game.state = 'arrive'; Game.arriveT = 1.5; Game.survivors = Run.n; Sfx.win(); Fx.bang('#7ee0a8', 0.5); }
    92	    }
    93	  } else if (Game.state === 'arrive') {
    94	    Game.arriveT -= dt;
    95	    Input.clearTaps(); Input.releases.length = 0;
    96	    var ps = Input.list();
    97	    for (var i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) { ps[i].dx = 0; ps[i].dy = 0; }
    98	    if (Game.arriveT <= 0) toBase(Game.survivors);
    99	  } else if (Game.state === 'base') {
   100	    Base.update(dt);
   101	    if (Base.result) gameOver(Base.result);
   102	  } else if (Game.state === 'over') {
   103	    var t = Input.consumeTap();
   104	    Input.releases.length = 0;
   105	    if (t && Game.overBtn && inRect(t, Game.overBtn)) newGame();
   106	    else if (t) newGame();
   107	  }
   108	  Fx.update(dt);
   109	}
   110	
   111	function render() {
   112	  var g = ctx;
   113	  g.setTransform(Game.rscale, 0, 0, Game.rscale, 0, 0);
   114	  g.save();
   115	  if (Fx.shake > 0) g.translate(rnd(-Fx.shake, Fx.shake), rnd(-Fx.shake, Fx.shake));
   116	
   117	  if (Game.state === 'run') Run.draw(g);
   118	  else if (Game.state === 'arrive') { Run.draw(g); drawArrive(g); }
   119	  else if (Game.state === 'base' || Game.state === 'over') {
   120	    if (Game.result === 'wiped') Run.draw(g); else Base.draw(g);
   121	  } else { g.fillStyle = '#12151c'; g.fillRect(0, 0, DW, DH); }
   122	
   123	  Fx.draw(g);
   124	  g.restore();
   125	
   126	  if (Fx.flash > 0) {
   127	    g.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.6, Fx.flash);
   128	    g.fillStyle = Fx.flashCol; g.fillRect(0, 0, DW, DH); g.globalAlpha = 1;
   129	  }
   130	  if (Game.state === 'over') drawOver(g);
   131	}

   138	}

   137	function toDesign(cx, cy) {
   138	  var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   139	  return { x: (cx - r.left - offX) / scale, y: (cy - r.top - offY) / scale };
   140	}

   142	function ptrDown(id, cx, cy) {
   143	  var p = toDesign(cx, cy);
   144	  Input.ptr[id] = { id: id, x: p.x, y: p.y, px: p.x, py: p.y, dx: 0, dy: 0, down: true, startX: p.x, startY: p.y, moved: false, t: performance.now() };
   145	  if (Input.primaryId === null) Input.primaryId = id;
   146	}
   147	function ptrMove(id, cx, cy) {
   148	  var e = Input.ptr[id]; if (!e) return;
   149	  var p = toDesign(cx, cy);
   150	  e.dx += p.x - e.x; e.dy += p.y - e.y;
   151	  e.px = e.x; e.py = e.y; e.x = p.x; e.y = p.y;
   152	  if (Math.abs(e.x - e.startX) > 8 || Math.abs(e.y - e.startY) > 8) e.moved = true;
   153	}
   154	function ptrUp(id, cancelled) {
   155	  var e = Input.ptr[id]; if (!e) return;
   156	  if (!cancelled && !e.moved && performance.now() - e.t < 700) {
   157	    Input.taps.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y });
   158	    if (Input.taps.length > 8) Input.taps.shift();
   159	  }
   160	  Input.releases.push({ id: id, x: e.x, y: e.y, startX: e.startX, startY: e.startY, cancelled: !!cancelled });
   161	  if (Input.releases.length > 8) Input.releases.shift();
   162	  delete Input.ptr[id];
   163	  if (Input.primaryId === id) {
   164	    var l = Input.list();
   165	    Input.primaryId = l.length ? l[0].id : null;
   166	  }

    19	  gen: function () {
    20	    var y = 620, i = 0, guard = 0;
    21	    while (y < TOTAL - 380 && guard++ < 64) {
    22	      var t = y / TOTAL, k = i % 4;
    23	      if (k === 0 || k === 2) this.objs.push(this.mkGate(y, t));
    24	      else if (k === 1) this.objs.push(this.mkMob(y, t));
    25	      else this.objs.push(this.mkSaw(y, t));
    26	      y += 330 + rndi(0, 90);

    28	    }
    29	    // guaranteed final reward gate before the wall
    30	    this.objs.push(this.mkGate(TOTAL - 300, 1));
    31	    if (this.objs.length > 40) this.objs.length = 40;
    32	  },

    34	  mkGate: function (y, t) {
    35	    var goods = [
    36	      { op: 'mul', v: 2, s: '×2' },
    37	      { op: 'add', v: 7 + Math.round(15 * t), s: '' },
    38	      { op: 'add', v: 10 + Math.round(22 * t), s: '' },
    39	      { op: 'add', v: 9 + Math.round(18 * t), s: '' }
    40	    ];
    41	    if (t > 0.7) goods.push({ op: 'mul', v: 3, s: '×3' });
    42	    var bads = [
    43	      { op: 'div', v: 2, s: '÷2' },
    44	      { op: 'sub', v: 8 + Math.round(20 * t), s: '' },
    45	      { op: 'div', v: 2, s: '÷2' },
    46	      { op: 'sub', v: 12 + Math.round(26 * t), s: '' }
    47	    ];
    48	    var a, b;
    49	    if (Math.random() < 0.66) { a = pick(goods); b = pick(bads); }
    50	    else {
    51	      a = pick(goods); b = pick(goods);
    52	      if (a === b) b = { op: 'add', v: 6 + Math.round(10 * t), s: '' };
    53	    }
    54	    a = this.lbl(a); b = this.lbl(b);
    55	    if (Math.random() < 0.5) { var tmp = a; a = b; b = tmp; }
    56	    return { k: 'gate', y: y, L: a, R: b, hit: false };
    57	  },
    58	  lbl: function (o) {
    59	    var c = { op: o.op, v: o.v, s: o.s };
    60	    if (!c.s) c.s = (o.op === 'add' ? '+' : '−') + o.v;
    61	    c.good = (o.op === 'add' || o.op === 'mul');
    62	    return c;
    63	  },
    64	
    65	  mkMob: function (y, t) {
    66	    var r = Math.random(), side;
    67	    if (r < 0.29) side = 'L'; else if (r < 0.58) side = 'R'; else side = 'F';
    68	    return { k: 'mob', y: y, side: side, size: -1, dead: false, hurt: 0 };
    69	  },
    70	  mkSaw: function (y, t) {
    71	    return { k: 'saw', y: y, ph: rnd(0, 6.28), spd: 1.1 + t * 0.9, hit: false };
    72	  },
    73	
    74	  /* -------- update -------- */
    75	  update: function (dt) {

    78	    this.inv = Math.max(0, this.inv - dt);

   174	    burst: function (x, y, col, n, spd) {
   175	      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   176	        if (this.parts.length >= BC.MAX_PARTS) this.parts.shift();
   177	        var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = (spd || 120) * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
   178	        this.parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40, life: 0.42 + Math.random() * 0.35, t: 0, col: col, r: 2 + Math.random() * 3.4 });
   179	      }
   180	    },
   181	    pop: function (x, y, txt, col) {
   182	      if (this.pops.length >= BC.MAX_POPUPS) this.pops.shift();
   183	      this.pops.push({ x: x, y: y, txt: txt, col: col || '#fff', t: 0, life: 0.9 });
   184	    },
   185	    kick: function (m) { this.shake = Math.min(18, this.shake + m); },
   186	    update: function (dt) {
   187	      var i, p;
   188	      for (i = this.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   189	        p = this.parts[i]; p.t += dt;
   190	        if (p.t >= p.life) { this.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   191	        p.vy += 620 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   192	      }
   193	      for (i = this.pops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   194	        p = this.pops[i]; p.t += dt;
   195	        if (p.t >= p.life) { this.pops.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   196	        p.y -= 34 * dt;
   197	      }
   198	      this.shake *= Math.pow(0.0015, dt);
   199	      if (this.shake < 0.1) this.shake = 0;
   200	      this.flash -= dt * 3.2; if (this.flash < 0) this.flash = 0;
   201	    },
   202	    draw: function (g) {
   203	      var i, p;
   204	      for (i = 0; i < this.parts.length; i++) {
   205	        p = this.parts[i];
   206	        var a = 1 - p.t / p.life;
   207	        g.globalAlpha = a;
   208	        g.fillStyle = p.col;
   209	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (0.4 + a * 0.9), 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   210	      }
   211	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   212	      for (i = 0; i < this.pops.length; i++) {
   213	        p = this.pops[i];
   214	        var k = p.t / p.life;
   215	        g.globalAlpha = k < 0.15 ? k / 0.15 : (1 - (k - 0.15) / 0.85);
   216	        g.font = '700 20px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   217	        g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
   218	        g.lineWidth = 4; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,6,14,0.85)';
   219	        g.strokeText(p.txt, p.x, p.y);
   220	        g.fillStyle = p.col;
   221	        g.fillText(p.txt, p.x, p.y);
   222	      }
   223	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   224	    }
   225	  };
   226	
   227	  return BC;
   228	})();
     1	/* Berry Cascade - headless match-3 engine, level generation, playout validation */
     2	(function (BC) {
     3	  var SP = { NONE: 0, LH: 1, LV: 2, BURST: 3, PRISM: 4 };
     4	  var EMPTY = -1, ACORN = -2, PRISMC = -3;
     5	  BC.SP = SP; BC.EMPTY = EMPTY; BC.ACORN = ACORN; BC.PRISMC = PRISMC;
     6	
     7	  BC.W = 8; BC.H = 8;
     8	
     9	  BC.newBoard = function (w, h) {
    10	    var n = w * h;
    11	    return { w: w, h: h, n: n, c: new Int8Array(n), sp: new Uint8Array(n), syr: new Uint8Array(n) };
    12	  };
    13	  BC.cloneBoard = function (b) {
    14	    return { w: b.w, h: b.h, n: b.n, c: b.c.slice(), sp: b.sp.slice(), syr: b.syr.slice() };
    15	  };
    16	
    17	  function isMatchable(b, i) { return b.c[i] >= 0; }
    18	
    19	  /* ---- run detection ---- */
    20	  function findRuns(b) {
    21	    var runs = [], x, y, i, c, run;
    22	    for (y = 0; y < b.h; y++) {
    23	      x = 0;
    24	      while (x < b.w) {
    25	        i = y * b.w + x; c = b.c[i];
    26	        if (c < 0) { x++; continue; }
    27	        var x2 = x;
    28	        while (x2 + 1 < b.w && b.c[y * b.w + x2 + 1] === c) x2++;
    29	        if (x2 - x + 1 >= 3) {
    30	          run = [];
    31	          for (var k = x; k <= x2; k++) run.push(y * b.w + k);
    32	          runs.push({ dir: 0, cells: run, color: c });
    33	        }
    34	        x = x2 + 1;
    35	      }
    36	    }
    37	    for (x = 0; x < b.w; x++) {
    38	      y = 0;
    39	      while (y < b.h) {
    40	        i = y * b.w + x; c = b.c[i];
    41	        if (c < 0) { y++; continue; }
    42	        var y2 = y;
    43	        while (y2 + 1 < b.h && b.c[(y2 + 1) * b.w + x] === c) y2++;
    44	        if (y2 - y + 1 >= 3) {
    45	          run = [];
    46	          for (var k2 = y; k2 <= y2; k2++) run.push(k2 * b.w + x);
    47	          runs.push({ dir: 1, cells: run, color: c });
    48	        }
    49	        y = y2 + 1;
    50	      }
    51	    }
    52	    return runs;
    53	  }
    54	
    55	  function groupRuns(runs) {
    56	    var groups = [], i, j;
    57	    for (i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
    58	      var r = runs[i], hit = -1;
    59	      for (j = 0; j < groups.length; j++) {
    60	        var g = groups[j];
    61	        if (g.color !== r.color) continue;
    62	        var share = false;
    63	        for (var k = 0; k < r.cells.length && !share; k++) if (g.set[r.cells[k]]) share = true;
    64	        if (share) { hit = j; break; }
    65	      }
    66	      if (hit < 0) {
    67	        var set = {}; for (var m = 0; m < r.cells.length; m++) set[r.cells[m]] = 1;
    68	        groups.push({ color: r.color, runs: [r], set: set });
    69	      } else {
    70	        groups[hit].runs.push(r);
    71	        for (var m2 = 0; m2 < r.cells.length; m2++) groups[hit].set[r.cells[m2]] = 1;
    72	      }
    73	    }
    74	    for (i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
    75	      var cells = [];
    76	      for (var key in groups[i].set) cells.push(key | 0);
    77	      groups[i].cells = cells;
    78	    }
    79	    return groups;
    80	  }
    81	
    82	  BC.hasAnyMatch = function (b) { return findRuns(b).length > 0; };
    83	
    84	  /* ---- special activation expansion ---- */
    85	  function pickCommonColor(b, rand) {
    86	    var counts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], i, best = 0, bc = -1;
    87	    for (i = 0; i < b.n; i++) if (b.c[i] >= 0) counts[b.c[i]]++;
    88	    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) if (counts[i] > best) { best = counts[i]; bc = i; }
    89	    if (bc < 0) bc = rand ? Math.floor(rand() * 6) : 0;
    90	    return bc;
    91	  }
    92	
    93	  function cellsOfColor(b, col) {
    94	    var out = [], i;
    95	    for (i = 0; i < b.n; i++) if (b.c[i] === col) out.push(i);
    96	    return out;
    97	  }
    98	
    99	  // expands special chains inside a clear-set (object used as set)
   100	  function expand(b, set, rand, fx) {
   101	    var q = [], i;
   102	    for (var key in set) { i = key | 0; if (b.sp[i] > 0) q.push(i); }
   103	    var done = {};
   104	    for (i = 0; i < q.length; i++) done[q[i]] = 1;
   105	    var guard = 0;
   106	    while (q.length && guard++ < 4096) {
   107	      var idx = q.shift();
   108	      var sp = b.sp[idx];
   109	      if (!sp) continue;
   110	      var cells = specialCells(b, idx, sp, rand);
   111	      if (fx) fx.push({ i: idx, sp: sp });
   112	      for (var m = 0; m < cells.length; m++) {
   113	        var j = cells[m];
   114	        if (j < 0 || j >= b.n) continue;
   115	        if (b.c[j] === ACORN || b.c[j] === EMPTY) continue;
   116	        if (!set[j]) set[j] = 1;
   117	        if (b.sp[j] > 0 && !done[j]) { done[j] = 1; q.push(j); }
   118	      }
   119	    }
   120	  }
   121	
   122	  function specialCells(b, idx, sp, rand) {
   123	    var w = b.w, x = idx % w, y = (idx / w) | 0, out = [], i, j;
   124	    if (sp === SP.LH) { for (i = 0; i < w; i++) out.push(y * w + i); }
   125	    else if (sp === SP.LV) { for (i = 0; i < b.h; i++) out.push(i * w + x); }
   126	    else if (sp === SP.BURST) {
   127	      for (j = y - 1; j <= y + 1; j++) for (i = x - 1; i <= x + 1; i++)
   128	        if (i >= 0 && i < w && j >= 0 && j < b.h) out.push(j * w + i);
   129	    } else if (sp === SP.PRISM) {
   130	      var col = pickCommonColor(b, rand);
   131	      out = cellsOfColor(b, col);
   132	    }
   133	    return out;
   134	  }
   135	  BC.specialCells = specialCells;
   136	
   137	  /* ---- one match-resolution step ---- */
   138	  // swapIdx: preferred pivot for special creation (-1 for cascades)
   139	  BC.stepClear = function (b, swapIdx, rand) {
   140	    var runs = findRuns(b);
   141	    if (!runs.length) return null;
   142	    var groups = groupRuns(runs);
   143	    var set = {}, creates = [], gi;
   144	    for (gi = 0; gi < groups.length; gi++) {
   145	      var g = groups[gi];
   146	      var hasH = false, hasV = false, maxRun = 0, longest = g.runs[0];
   147	      for (var r = 0; r < g.runs.length; r++) {
   148	        var rr = g.runs[r];
   149	        if (rr.dir === 0) hasH = true; else hasV = true;
   150	        if (rr.cells.length > maxRun) { maxRun = rr.cells.length; longest = rr; }
   151	      }
   152	      var spType = SP.NONE;
   153	      if (maxRun >= 5) spType = SP.PRISM;
   154	      else if (hasH && hasV) spType = SP.BURST;
   155	      else if (maxRun === 4) spType = (longest.dir === 0 ? SP.LH : SP.LV);
   156	
   157	      var pivot = -1;
   158	      if (spType) {
   159	        if (swapIdx >= 0 && g.set[swapIdx]) pivot = swapIdx;
   160	        else if (spType === SP.BURST) {
   161	          // intersection cell of an h-run and a v-run
   162	          for (var a = 0; a < g.runs.length && pivot < 0; a++) {
   163	            if (g.runs[a].dir !== 0) continue;
   164	            for (var bq = 0; bq < g.runs.length && pivot < 0; bq++) {
   165	              if (g.runs[bq].dir !== 1) continue;
   166	              for (var ca = 0; ca < g.runs[a].cells.length && pivot < 0; ca++)
   167	                for (var cb = 0; cb < g.runs[bq].cells.length; cb++)
   168	                  if (g.runs[a].cells[ca] === g.runs[bq].cells[cb]) { pivot = g.runs[a].cells[ca]; break; }
   169	            }
   170	          }
   171	          if (pivot < 0) pivot = g.cells[(g.cells.length / 2) | 0];
   172	        } else {
   173	          pivot = longest.cells[(longest.cells.length / 2) | 0];
   174	        }
   175	        creates.push({ i: pivot, sp: spType, c: spType === SP.PRISM ? PRISMC : g.color });
   176	      }
   177	      for (var q = 0; q < g.cells.length; q++) set[g.cells[q]] = 1;
   178	    }
   179	    var fx = [];
   180	    expand(b, set, rand, fx);
   181	    // created specials survive
   182	    for (var ci = 0; ci < creates.length; ci++) delete set[creates[ci].i];
   183	    var cells = [];
   184	    for (var key in set) cells.push(key | 0);
   185	    if (!cells.length && !creates.length) return null;
   186	    return { cells: cells, creates: creates, fx: fx };
   187	  };
   188	
   189	  /* ---- swap validity + combos ---- */
   190	  BC.canSwap = function (b, i, j) {
   191	    if (b.c[i] === ACORN || b.c[j] === ACORN) return false;
   192	    if (b.c[i] === EMPTY || b.c[j] === EMPTY) return false;
   193	    if (b.sp[i] === SP.PRISM || b.sp[j] === SP.PRISM) return true;
   194	    if (b.sp[i] > 0 && b.sp[j] > 0) return true;
   195	    // simulate
   196	    var ci = b.c[i], cj = b.c[j], si = b.sp[i], sj = b.sp[j];
   197	    b.c[i] = cj; b.c[j] = ci; b.sp[i] = sj; b.sp[j] = si;
   198	    var ok = touchesRun(b, i) || touchesRun(b, j);
   199	    b.c[i] = ci; b.c[j] = cj; b.sp[i] = si; b.sp[j] = sj;
   200	    return ok;
   201	  };
   202	
   203	  function touchesRun(b, i) {
   204	    var w = b.w, x = i % w, y = (i / w) | 0, c = b.c[i];
   205	    if (c < 0) return false;
   206	    var n = 1, k;
   207	    for (k = x - 1; k >= 0 && b.c[y * w + k] === c; k--) n++;
   208	    for (k = x + 1; k < w && b.c[y * w + k] === c; k++) n++;
   209	    if (n >= 3) return true;
   210	    n = 1;
   211	    for (k = y - 1; k >= 0 && b.c[k * w + x] === c; k--) n++;
   212	    for (k = y + 1; k < b.h && b.c[k * w + x] === c; k++) n++;
   213	    return n >= 3;
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  BC.listMoves = function (b) {
   217	    var out = [], x, y, i;
   218	    for (y = 0; y < b.h; y++) for (x = 0; x < b.w; x++) {
   219	      i = y * b.w + x;
   220	      if (x + 1 < b.w && BC.canSwap(b, i, i + 1)) out.push([i, i + 1]);
   221	      if (y + 1 < b.h && BC.canSwap(b, i, i + b.w)) out.push([i, i + b.w]);
   222	    }
   223	    return out;
   224	  };
   225	
   226	  BC.doSwap = function (b, i, j) {
   227	    var c = b.c[i], s = b.sp[i];
   228	    b.c[i] = b.c[j]; b.sp[i] = b.sp[j];
   229	    b.c[j] = c; b.sp[j] = s;
   230	  };
   231	
   232	  // Returns the first clear step after a swap (handles special+special combos).
   233	  BC.swapClear = function (b, i, j, rand) {
   234	    var si = b.sp[i], sj = b.sp[j];
   235	    var set = null, fx = [], name = '';
   236	    var w = b.w;
   237	    function addAll(list) { for (var k = 0; k < list.length; k++) { var q = list[k]; if (q >= 0 && q < b.n && b.c[q] !== ACORN && b.c[q] !== EMPTY) set[q] = 1; } }
   238	    function lineOrBurst(s) { return s === SP.LH || s === SP.LV || s === SP.BURST; }
   239	
   240	    var isCombo = (si === SP.PRISM || sj === SP.PRISM || (lineOrBurst(si) && lineOrBurst(sj)));
   241	    if (isCombo) {
   242	      // both swapped pieces are consumed by the combo; strip them so expand() can't re-fire them
   243	      b.sp[i] = SP.NONE; b.sp[j] = SP.NONE;
   244	      if (b.c[i] === PRISMC) b.c[i] = 0;
   245	      if (b.c[j] === PRISMC) b.c[j] = 0;
   246	    }
   247	
   248	    if (si === SP.PRISM && sj === SP.PRISM) {
   249	      set = {}; name = 'BOARD WIPE!';
   250	      for (var k = 0; k < b.n; k++) if (b.c[k] !== ACORN && b.c[k] !== EMPTY) set[k] = 1;
   251	    } else if (si === SP.PRISM || sj === SP.PRISM) {
   252	      var pi = (si === SP.PRISM) ? i : j, oi = (si === SP.PRISM) ? j : i;
   253	      var osp = (si === SP.PRISM) ? sj : si, ocol = b.c[oi];
   254	      set = {}; set[pi] = 1; set[oi] = 1;
   255	      if (ocol < 0) ocol = pickCommonColor(b, rand);
   256	      var targets = cellsOfColor(b, ocol);
   257	      if (osp === SP.LH || osp === SP.LV) {
   258	        name = 'PRISM LINES!';
   259	        for (var t = 0; t < targets.length; t++) b.sp[targets[t]] = (rand && rand() < 0.5) ? SP.LH : SP.LV;
   260	      } else if (osp === SP.BURST) {
   261	        name = 'PRISM BURST!';
   262	        for (var t2 = 0; t2 < targets.length; t2++) b.sp[targets[t2]] = SP.BURST;
   263	      } else {
   264	        name = 'PRISM!';
   265	      }
   266	      for (var t3 = 0; t3 < targets.length; t3++) set[targets[t3]] = 1;
   267	    } else if (lineOrBurst(si) && lineOrBurst(sj)) {
   268	      var x = i % w, y = (i / w) | 0;
   269	      var bothBurst = (si === SP.BURST && sj === SP.BURST);
   270	      var anyBurst = (si === SP.BURST || sj === SP.BURST);
   271	      set = {};
   272	      if (bothBurst) {
   273	        name = 'MEGA BURST!';
   274	        for (var yy = y - 2; yy <= y + 2; yy++) for (var xx = x - 2; xx <= x + 2; xx++)
   275	          if (xx >= 0 && xx < w && yy >= 0 && yy < b.h) set[yy * w + xx] = 1;
   276	      } else if (anyBurst) {
   277	        name = 'TRIPLE CROSS!';
   278	        var list = [];
   279	        for (var d = -1; d <= 1; d++) {
   280	          if (y + d >= 0 && y + d < b.h) for (var xa = 0; xa < w; xa++) list.push((y + d) * w + xa);
   281	          if (x + d >= 0 && x + d < w) for (var ya = 0; ya < b.h; ya++) list.push(ya * w + (x + d));
   282	        }
   283	        addAll(list);
   284	      } else {
   285	        name = 'CROSS!';
   286	        var l2 = [];
   287	        for (var xb = 0; xb < w; xb++) l2.push(y * w + xb);
   288	        for (var yb = 0; yb < b.h; yb++) l2.push(yb * w + x);
   289	        addAll(l2);
   290	      }
   291	      set[i] = 1; set[j] = 1;
   292	    }
   293	
   294	    if (set) {
   295	      expand(b, set, rand, fx);
   296	      var cells = [];
   297	      for (var key in set) cells.push(key | 0);
   298	      return { cells: cells, creates: [], fx: fx, combo: name };
   299	    }
   300	    return BC.stepClear(b, i, rand) || BC.stepClear(b, j, rand);
   301	  };
   302	
   303	  /* ---- apply / gravity ---- */
   304	  BC.applyClear = function (b, step, st) {
   305	    var cells = step.cells, i, k, syr = 0;
   306	    for (k = 0; k < cells.length; k++) {
   307	      i = cells[k];
   308	      if (b.c[i] === ACORN || b.c[i] === EMPTY) continue;
   309	      if (b.syr[i] > 0) { b.syr[i]--; syr++; }
   310	      b.c[i] = EMPTY; b.sp[i] = SP.NONE;
   311	    }
   312	    for (k = 0; k < step.creates.length; k++) {
   313	      var cr = step.creates[k];
   314	      b.c[cr.i] = cr.c; b.sp[cr.i] = cr.sp;
   315	    }
   316	    if (st) { st.syrup += syr; }
   317	    return { cleared: cells.length, syrup: syr };
   318	  };
   319	
   320	  // Compacts + refills until nothing is left falling and no acorn is sitting on the floor.
   321	  // Returns {falls: {finalIndex: cellsFallen}, acorns:[index]} so the view can animate the drop.
   322	  BC.gravity = function (b, rand, cfg, st) {
   323	    var w = b.w, x, y, i, falls = {}, acorns = [], pass = 0, again = true;
   324	    while (again && pass++ < 12) {
   325	      again = false;
   326	      // 1. anything resting on the floor that is an acorn gets delivered
   327	      for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
   328	        var bi = (b.h - 1) * w + x;
   329	        if (b.c[bi] === ACORN) {
   330	          acorns.push(bi); b.c[bi] = EMPTY; b.sp[bi] = SP.NONE;
   331	          delete falls[bi];
   332	          if (st) st.acorns++;
   333	        }
   334	      }
   335	      // 2. compact each column, then refill the gap at the top
   336	      for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
   337	        var write = b.h - 1;
   338	        for (y = b.h - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   339	          i = y * w + x;
   340	          if (b.c[i] === EMPTY) continue;
   341	          if (write !== y) {
   342	            var to = write * w + x;
   343	            b.c[to] = b.c[i]; b.sp[to] = b.sp[i];
   344	            b.c[i] = EMPTY; b.sp[i] = SP.NONE;
   345	            falls[to] = (falls[i] || 0) + (write - y);
   346	            delete falls[i];
   347	          }
   348	          write--;
   349	        }
   350	        for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   351	          var idx = y * w + x;
   352	          var makeAcorn = false;
   353	          if (cfg && cfg.acorns > 0 && st && st.acornSpawned < cfg.acorns) {
   354	            var inplay = st.acornSpawned - st.acorns;
   355	            if (inplay < 3 && rand() < 0.34) makeAcorn = true;
   356	          }
   357	          if (makeAcorn) { b.c[idx] = ACORN; b.sp[idx] = SP.NONE; st.acornSpawned++; }
   358	          else { b.c[idx] = (rand() * cfg.colors) | 0; b.sp[idx] = SP.NONE; }
   359	          falls[idx] = y + 1.4;
   360	        }
   361	      }
   362	      // 3. a freshly landed acorn on the floor means another delivery pass
   363	      for (x = 0; x < w; x++) if (b.c[(b.h - 1) * w + x] === ACORN) { again = true; break; }
   364	    }
   365	    return { falls: falls, acorns: acorns };
   366	  };
   367	
   368	  BC.shuffle = function (b, rand, cfg) {
   369	    var pool = [], i, guard = 0;
   370	    for (i = 0; i < b.n; i++) if (b.c[i] >= 0 && b.sp[i] === SP.NONE) pool.push(i);
   371	    do {
   372	      for (i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   373	        var j = (rand() * (i + 1)) | 0;
   374	        var a = pool[i], c = pool[j];
   375	        var t = b.c[a]; b.c[a] = b.c[c]; b.c[c] = t;
   376	      }
   377	      guard++;
   378	      if (guard > 40) {
   379	        for (i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) b.c[pool[i]] = (rand() * cfg.colors) | 0;
   380	      }
   381	    } while (guard < 90 && (BC.hasAnyMatch(b) || !BC.listMoves(b).length));
   382	  };
   383	
   384	  BC.fillFresh = function (b, rand, cfg) {
   385	    var guard = 0;
   386	    do {
   387	      for (var i = 0; i < b.n; i++) { b.c[i] = (rand() * cfg.colors) | 0; b.sp[i] = SP.NONE; }
   388	      var g2 = 0;
   389	      while (BC.hasAnyMatch(b) && g2++ < 200) {
   390	        var runs = findRuns(b);
   391	        for (var r = 0; r < runs.length; r++) {
   392	          var cell = runs[r].cells[(runs[r].cells.length / 2) | 0];
   393	          b.c[cell] = (rand() * cfg.colors) | 0;
   394	        }
   395	      }
   396	      guard++;
   397	    } while (guard < 30 && !BC.listMoves(b).length);
   398	  };

   467	  BC.scoreFor = function (cleared, chain) {
   468	    var mult = 1 + chain * 0.5;
   469	    return Math.round(cleared * 60 * mult);
   470	  };
   471	
   472	  /* full headless resolve of one player move (used by validation playouts) */
   473	  function resolveAll(b, i, j, lv, st, rand) {
   474	    var step = BC.swapClear(b, i, j, rand);
   475	    if (!step) { BC.doSwap(b, i, j); return false; }
   476	    var chain = 0, guard = 0;
   477	    while (step && guard++ < 60) {
   478	      var res = BC.applyClear(b, step, st);
   479	      st.score += BC.scoreFor(res.cleared, chain) + res.syrup * 120;
   480	      var gr = BC.gravity(b, rand, lv, st);
   481	      st.score += gr.acorns.length * 500;
   482	      chain++;
   483	      step = BC.stepClear(b, -1, rand);
   484	    }
   485	    return true;
   486	  }
   487	
   488	  function playout(lv, seed) {
   489	    var init = BC.initBoardFor(lv);
   490	    var b = init.board;
   491	    var rand = BC.rng(seed);
   492	    var st = BC.newState(lv);
   493	    var guard = 0;
   494	    while (st.moves > 0 && guard++ < 400) {
   495	      if (BC.goalsMet(lv, st)) return true;
   496	      var moves = BC.listMoves(b);
   497	      if (!moves.length) { BC.shuffle(b, rand, lv); moves = BC.listMoves(b); if (!moves.length) break; }
   498	      var m = moves[(rand() * moves.length) | 0];
   499	      BC.doSwap(b, m[0], m[1]);
   500	      resolveAll(b, m[0], m[1], lv, st, rand);
   501	      st.moves--;
   502	    }
   503	    return BC.goalsMet(lv, st);
   504	  }

   506	  // random-playout validation: bump the move budget until a random bot clears it often enough
   507	  BC.getLevel = function (n) {
   508	    if (LEVEL_CACHE[n]) return LEVEL_CACHE[n];
   509	    var lv = baseLevel(n);
   510	    var TRIES = 10, NEED = 2, bump = 0;  // >=20% of blind random playouts must clear it
   511	    while (bump < 16) {
   512	      var pass = 0, fail = 0, ok = false;
   513	      for (var k = 0; k < TRIES; k++) {
   514	        if (playout(lv, 0x1234 + n * 977 + k * 31)) pass++; else fail++;
   515	        if (pass >= NEED) { ok = true; break; }
   516	        if (TRIES - fail < NEED) break;    // cannot reach the bar; stop early
   517	      }
   518	      if (ok) break;
   519	      // relax: more moves, and every third round trim the score target too
   520	      lv.moves += 3;
   521	      if (bump % 3 === 2 && lv.target > 900) lv.target = Math.round(lv.target * 0.9);
   522	      bump++;
   523	    }
   524	    lv.moves += 5; // safety margin over the validated budget (players beat blind random play)
   525	    // confirmation pass on independent seeds, so a lucky sample can't ship an impossible grove
   526	    for (var round = 0; round < 6; round++) {
   527	      var p2 = 0, f2 = 0;
   528	      for (var v = 0; v < 10; v++) {
   529	        if (playout(lv, 0x77E1 + n * 613 + v * 149)) p2++; else f2++;
   530	        if (p2 >= 2) break;
   531	        if (10 - f2 < 2) break;
   532	      }
   533	      if (p2 >= 2) break;
   534	      lv.moves += 4;
   535	      if (lv.target > 900) lv.target = Math.round(lv.target * 0.94);
   536	    }
   537	    lv.stars = [lv.target, Math.round(lv.target * 2.5), Math.round(lv.target * 4.5)];
   538	    LEVEL_CACHE[n] = lv;
   539	    return lv;
   540	  };

   105	  function shapePath(shape, cx, cy, r) {
   106	    var i, a;
   107	    g.beginPath();

   149	  function sprite(c, sp) {
   150	    if (spriteCS !== CS) { sprites = {}; boardBg = null; spriteCS = CS; }
   151	    var key = c + '_' + sp;
   152	    if (sprites[key] !== undefined) return sprites[key];

   154	    var cn = makeCanvas(size, size);

   156	    var og = g;
   157	    g = cn.getContext('2d');
   158	    paintPiece(size / 2, size / 2, CS * 0.38, c, sp);
   159	    g = og;

   163	  function drawPiece(cx, cy, r, c, sp, alpha, scale) {
   164	    var a = (alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha);
   165	    if (a <= 0) return;
   166	    var img = sprite(c, sp);
   167	    if (!img) { g.globalAlpha = a; paintPiece(cx, cy, r * (scale === undefined ? 1 : scale), c, sp); g.globalAlpha = 1; return; }
   168	    var s = (scale === undefined ? 1 : scale) * (r / (CS * 0.38));

   226	  function tri(x, y, r, a) {
   227	    g.beginPath();
   228	    g.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * r, y + Math.sin(a) * r);
   229	    g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a + 2.6) * r, y + Math.sin(a + 2.6) * r);
   230	    g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a - 2.6) * r, y + Math.sin(a - 2.6) * r);
   231	    g.closePath(); g.fill();
   232	  }

   532	  /* ---------------- game logic steps ---------------- */
   533	  function startPop(step) {
   534	    var b = P.b, i;
   535	    P.popping.length = 0;
   536	    for (i = 0; i < step.cells.length; i++) {
   537	      var idx = step.cells[i];
   538	      if (b.c[idx] === EMPTY || b.c[idx] === ACORN) continue;
   539	      var rc = cellRect(idx);
   540	      var px = rc.x + CS / 2, py = rc.y + CS / 2;
   541	      if (P.popping.length < 90) P.popping.push({ x: px, y: py, c: b.c[idx], sp: b.sp[idx], t: 0 });
   542	      BC.Fx.burst(px, py, COL[b.c[idx]] || '#fff', b.sp[idx] ? 8 : 3, b.sp[idx] ? 220 : 130);
   543	    }
   544	    if (step.fx && step.fx.length) { BC.Audio.special(); BC.Fx.kick(6 + step.fx.length * 1.5); BC.Fx.flash = 0.5; }
   545	    BC.Audio.pop(P.chain);
   546	    BC.Fx.kick(1.6 + Math.min(6, step.cells.length * 0.22));
   547	
   548	    var res = BC.applyClear(b, step, P.st);
   549	    var pts = BC.scoreFor(res.cleared, P.chain) + res.syrup * 120;
   550	    P.st.score += pts;
   551	    var cxp = BX + CS * BC.W / 2, cyp = BY + CS * BC.H / 2;
   552	    if (P.chain >= 1) BC.Fx.pop(cxp, cyp - 30 - P.chain * 6, 'CASCADE x' + (P.chain + 1), '#ffd45e');
   553	    if (step.combo) BC.Fx.pop(cxp, cyp + 10, step.combo, '#ff8ad8');
   554	    else if (res.cleared >= 7) BC.Fx.pop(cxp, cyp + 10, 'JUICY!', '#7bd94a');
   555	    if (res.syrup > 0) BC.Fx.pop(cxp - 40, cyp - 60, '+' + res.syrup + ' syrup', '#ff8ad8');
   556	    // create specials pop
   557	    for (i = 0; i < step.creates.length; i++) {
   558	      var crc = cellRect(step.creates[i].i);
   559	      P.sq[step.creates[i].i] = 1;
   560	      BC.Fx.burst(crc.x + CS / 2, crc.y + CS / 2, '#fff', 10, 200);
   561	    }
   562	    P.phase = 'pop'; P.t = 0;
   563	  }
   564	
   565	  function doGravity() {
   566	    var b = P.b, i;
   567	    var before = P.st.acorns;
   568	    var gr = BC.gravity(b, P.rand, P.lv, P.st);
   569	    for (i = 0; i < b.n; i++) { P.oy[i] = 0; P.vy[i] = 0; }
   570	    for (var key in gr.falls) {
   571	      var k = key | 0;
   572	      if (k >= 0 && k < b.n) P.oy[k] = -Math.min(gr.falls[key], BC.H + 2) * CS;
   573	    }
   574	    var got = P.st.acorns - before;
   575	    if (got > 0) {
   576	      BC.Audio.acorn();
   577	      P.st.score += got * 500;
   578	      for (i = 0; i < gr.acorns.length; i++) {
   579	        var rc = cellRect(gr.acorns[i]);
   580	        BC.Fx.burst(rc.x + CS / 2, rc.y + CS / 2, '#c98a3c', 16, 220);
   581	      }
   582	      BC.Fx.pop(BX + CS * BC.W / 2, BY + CS * BC.H - 40, 'ACORN SAVED!', '#ffb020');
   583	      BC.Fx.kick(7);
   584	    }
   585	    P.phase = 'fall'; P.t = 0;
   586	  }
   587	
   588	  function settle() {
   589	    var lv = P.lv, st = P.st;
   590	    if (P.endless) {
   591	      // each refill costs more score than the last, so the run always tightens
   592	      while (st.score >= P.nextBonus && P.bonusCount < 200) {
   593	        P.bonusCount++;
   594	        P.nextBonus += 3000 + P.bonusCount * 1800;
   595	        st.moves += 2;
   596	        BC.Fx.pop(W / 2, BY + 40, '+2 MOVES', '#7bd94a');
   597	      }
   598	      var stage = Math.min(8, Math.floor(st.score / 14000));
   599	      if (stage > P.stage) { P.stage = stage; lv.colors = stage < 1 ? 4 : (stage < 3 ? 5 : 6); BC.Fx.pop(W / 2, BY + 70, 'DIFFICULTY UP', '#ff6b83'); }
   600	      if (st.moves <= 0) { endGame(0); return; }
   601	    } else {
   602	      if (BC.goalsMet(lv, st)) { endGame(1); return; }
   603	      if (st.moves <= 0) { endGame(0); return; }
   604	    }
   605	    if (!BC.listMoves(P.b).length) {
   606	      BC.shuffle(P.b, P.rand, lv);
   607	      BC.Fx.pop(W / 2, BY + CS * BC.H / 2, 'NO MOVES — SHUFFLE', '#8fe3ff');
   608	      BC.Audio.swap();
   609	    }
   610	    P.phase = 'idle'; P.chain = 0; P.t = 0;
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  function endGame(won) {
   614	    P.over = won ? 1 : 2;
   615	    P.phase = 'over';
   616	    P.sel = -1;
   617	    if (P.endless) {
   618	      if (P.st.score > save.endless) { save.endless = P.st.score; BC.Store.write(save); }
   619	      BC.Audio.lose();
   620	      return;
   620	      return;
   621	    }
   622	    if (won) {
   623	      var s = 1, lv = P.lv;
   624	      if (P.st.score >= lv.stars[1]) s = 2;
   625	      if (P.st.score >= lv.stars[2]) s = 3;
   626	      P.stars = s;
   627	      var n = lv.n;
   628	      if ((save.stars[n] | 0) < s) save.stars[n] = s;
   629	      if ((save.best[n] | 0) < P.st.score) save.best[n] = P.st.score;
   630	      if (save.unlocked < Math.min(30, n + 2)) save.unlocked = Math.min(30, n + 2);
   631	      BC.Store.write(save);
   632	      BC.Audio.win();
   633	      BC.Fx.kick(10);
   634	      for (var k = 0; k < 40; k++) BC.Fx.burst(Math.random() * W, H * 0.35 + Math.random() * 120, COL[k % 6], 2, 200);
   635	    } else {
   636	      BC.Audio.lose();
   637	      BC.Fx.kick(9);
   638	    }
   639	  }
   640	
   641	  function attemptSwap(i, j) {
   642	    if (P.phase !== 'idle' || P.over) return false;
   643	    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= P.b.n || j >= P.b.n) return false;
   644	    var b = P.b;
   645	    if (b.c[i] === ACORN || b.c[j] === ACORN || b.c[i] === EMPTY || b.c[j] === EMPTY) { BC.Audio.deny(); return false; }
   646	    P.sel = -1;
   647	    P.swapA = i; P.swapB = j; P.t = 0;
   648	    P.pendingValid = BC.canSwap(b, i, j);
   649	    P.phase = 'swap';
   650	    BC.Audio.swap();
   651	    return true;
   652	  }
   653	
   654	  function updatePlay(dt) {
   655	    var i;
   656	    if (P.phase === 'swap') {
   657	      P.t += dt;
   658	      if (P.t >= 0.13) {
   659	        BC.doSwap(P.b, P.swapA, P.swapB);
   660	        if (!P.pendingValid) { P.phase = 'unswap'; P.t = 0; BC.Audio.deny(); }
   661	        else {
   662	          P.st.moves--;
   663	          P.chain = 0;
   664	          var step = BC.swapClear(P.b, P.swapA, P.swapB, P.rand);
   665	          if (step) startPop(step);
   666	          else { P.phase = 'idle'; P.t = 0; }
   667	        }
   668	      }
   669	    } else if (P.phase === 'unswap') {
   670	      P.t += dt;
   671	      if (P.t >= 0.13) { BC.doSwap(P.b, P.swapA, P.swapB); P.phase = 'idle'; P.swapA = P.swapB = -1; P.t = 0; }
   672	    } else if (P.phase === 'pop') {
   673	      P.t += dt;
   674	      for (i = 0; i < P.popping.length; i++) P.popping[i].t += dt;
   675	      if (P.t >= 0.16) { P.popping.length = 0; doGravity(); }
   676	    } else if (P.phase === 'fall') {
   677	      P.t += dt;
   678	      var moving = false;
   679	      for (i = 0; i < P.b.n; i++) {
   680	        if (P.oy[i] < 0) {
   681	          P.vy[i] += 3600 * dt;
   682	          P.oy[i] += P.vy[i] * dt;
   683	          if (P.oy[i] >= 0) { P.oy[i] = 0; P.vy[i] = 0; P.sq[i] = 1; }
   684	          else moving = true;
   685	        }
   686	        if (P.sq[i] > 0) { P.sq[i] -= dt * 5.5; if (P.sq[i] < 0) P.sq[i] = 0; }
   687	      }
   688	      if (!moving || P.t > 2.2) {
   689	        for (i = 0; i < P.b.n; i++) { if (P.oy[i] < 0) { P.oy[i] = 0; P.vy[i] = 0; } }
   690	        var st2 = BC.stepClear(P.b, -1, P.rand);
   691	        if (st2) { P.chain++; startPop(st2); }
   692	        else settle();
   693	      }
   694	    } else {
   695	      for (i = 0; i < P.b.n; i++) if (P.sq[i] > 0) { P.sq[i] -= dt * 5.5; if (P.sq[i] < 0) P.sq[i] = 0; }
   696	    }
   697	    P.hintT += dt;
   698	  }
   699	
   700	  /* ---------------- input ---------------- */
   701	  var kbActive = false;
   702	
   703	  function cellAt(px, py) {
   704	    var x = Math.floor((px - BX) / CS), y = Math.floor((py - BY) / CS);
   705	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= BC.W || y >= BC.H) return -1;
   706	    return y * BC.W + x;
   707	  }
   708	
   709	  function fireButton(id) {
   710	    BC.Audio.unlock();
   711	    if (id === 'mute') { save.mute = save.mute ? 0 : 1; BC.Audio.setMute(save.mute); BC.Store.write(save); return; }
   712	    if (id === 'endless') { newPlay(0, true); scene = 'play'; return; }
   713	    if (id === 'crown') { scene = 'crown'; BC.Audio.crown(); return; }
   714	    if (id === 'menu' || id === 'back') { BC.Timers.clearAll(); BC.Input.reset(); BC.Fx.reset(); pending = -1; scene = 'map'; P = null; centerMapOn(save.unlocked - 1); return; }
   715	    if (id === 'retry' || id === 'again') {
   716	      if (!P) return;
   717	      if (P.endless) newPlay(0, true); else newPlay(P.lv.n, false);
   718	      return;
   719	    }
   720	    if (id === 'next') {
   721	      var n = P.lv.n + 1;
   722	      if (n > 29) { scene = 'crown'; return; }
   723	      queueLevel(n); return;
   724	    }
   725	  }
   726	
   727	  function centerMapOn(i) {
   728	    i = BC.clamp(i, 0, 29);
   729	    map.sel = i;
   730	    map.scroll = BC.clamp(i * STEP - (H - 70) + (H + MAPTOP) / 2, 0, map.maxScroll);
   731	  }
   732	
   733	  function onDown(e) {
   734	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   735	    var x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY;
   736	    BC.Audio.unlock();
   737	    var b = hitBtn(x, y);
   738	    if (b) { BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'btn', btn: b.id, x: x, y: y }; return; }
   739	    if (paused) return;
   740	    if (scene === 'map') {
   741	      BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'map', x: x, y: y, sx: x, sy: y, s0: map.scroll, moved: false };
   742	      return;
   743	    }
   744	    if (scene === 'play' && P && !P.over) {
   745	      var c = cellAt(x, y);
   746	      if (c >= 0) {
   747	        kbActive = false;
   748	        BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'board', cell: c, sx: x, sy: y, moved: false };
   749	        if (P.sel >= 0 && P.sel !== c && adjacent(P.sel, c)) { attemptSwap(P.sel, c); BC.Input.pointers[id].done = true; }
   750	        else if (P.phase === 'idle') P.sel = (P.sel === c ? -1 : c);
   751	      } else { BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'none' }; }
   752	    }
   753	  }
   754	  function adjacent(a, b) {
   755	    var ax = a % BC.W, ay = (a / BC.W) | 0, bx = b % BC.W, by = (b / BC.W) | 0;
   756	    return Math.abs(ax - bx) + Math.abs(ay - by) === 1;
   757	  }
   758	  function onMove(e) {
   759	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   760	    var p = BC.Input.pointers[id];
   761	    if (!p) return;
   762	    var x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY;
   763	    if (p.kind === 'map') {
   764	      map.scroll = BC.clamp(p.s0 + (y - p.sy), 0, map.maxScroll);
   765	      if (Math.abs(y - p.sy) > 8 || Math.abs(x - p.sx) > 8) p.moved = true;
   766	      return;
   767	    }
   768	    if (p.kind === 'board' && !p.done && P && P.phase === 'idle') {
   769	      var dx = x - p.sx, dy = y - p.sy;
   770	      if (Math.abs(dx) > 16 || Math.abs(dy) > 16) {
   771	        var cx = p.cell % BC.W, cy = (p.cell / BC.W) | 0, tx = cx, ty = cy;
   772	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) tx += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else ty += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   773	        p.done = true;
   774	        if (tx >= 0 && tx < BC.W && ty >= 0 && ty < BC.H) attemptSwap(p.cell, ty * BC.W + tx);
   775	        P.sel = -1;
   776	      }
   777	    }
   778	  }
   779	  function onUp(e) {
   780	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   781	    var p = BC.Input.pointers[id];
   782	    delete BC.Input.pointers[id];
   783	    if (!p || paused) return;
   784	    if (p.kind === 'btn') {
   785	      var b2 = hitBtn(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   786	      if (b2 && b2.id === p.btn) fireButton(p.btn);
   787	      return;
   788	    }
   789	    if (p.kind === 'map' && !p.moved) {
   790	      for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   791	        var ny = nodeScreenY(i);
   792	        if (ny < 40 || ny > H + 40) continue;
   793	        var dx = e.clientX - map.nodes[i].x, dy = e.clientY - ny;
   794	        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= 30 * 30) {
   795	          if (i < save.unlocked) { map.sel = i; BC.Audio.unlock(); queueLevel(i); }
   796	          else BC.Audio.deny();
   797	          return;
   798	        }
   799	      }
   800	    }
   801	  }
   802	  function onCancel(e) {
   803	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   804	    delete BC.Input.pointers[id];
   805	  }
   806	
   807	  function onKey(e) {
   808	    var k = e.key;
   809	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'Enter'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   810	    BC.Audio.unlock();
   811	    BC.Input.keys[k] = 1;
   812	    if (paused) return;
   813	    if (scene === 'crown') { if (k === 'Enter' || k === 'Escape' || k === ' ') fireButton('menu'); return; }
   814	    if (scene === 'map') {
   815	      if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowRight') { map.sel = BC.clamp(map.sel + 1, 0, save.unlocked - 1); centerMapOn(map.sel); }
   816	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowLeft') { map.sel = BC.clamp(map.sel - 1, 0, 29); centerMapOn(map.sel); }
   817	      else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { if (map.sel < save.unlocked) queueLevel(map.sel); else BC.Audio.deny(); }
   818	      else if (k === 'e' || k === 'E') fireButton('endless');
   819	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') fireButton('mute');
   820	      return;
   821	    }
   822	    if (scene === 'play' && P) {
   823	      if (k === 'Escape') { fireButton('menu'); return; }
   824	      if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { fireButton('again'); return; }
   825	      if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { fireButton('mute'); return; }
   826	      if (P.over) {
   827	        if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   828	          if (P.over === 1 && !P.endless && P.lv.n < 29) fireButton('next');
   829	          else if (P.over === 1 && !P.endless) fireButton('crown');
   830	          else fireButton('again');
   831	        }
   832	        return;
   833	      }
   834	      kbActive = true;
   835	      if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown') {
   836	        var dx = (k === 'ArrowRight') - (k === 'ArrowLeft');
   837	        var dy = (k === 'ArrowDown') - (k === 'ArrowUp');
   838	        if (P.sel >= 0) {
   839	          var tx = (P.sel % BC.W) + dx, ty = ((P.sel / BC.W) | 0) + dy;
   840	          if (tx >= 0 && tx < BC.W && ty >= 0 && ty < BC.H) { attemptSwap(P.sel, ty * BC.W + tx); P.cx = BC.clamp(tx, 0, BC.W - 1); P.cy = BC.clamp(ty, 0, BC.H - 1); }
   841	          P.sel = -1;
   842	        } else {
   843	          P.cx = BC.clamp(P.cx + dx, 0, BC.W - 1);
   844	          P.cy = BC.clamp(P.cy + dy, 0, BC.H - 1);
   845	        }
   846	      } else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   847	        var ci = P.cy * BC.W + P.cx;
   848	        P.sel = (P.sel === ci) ? -1 : ci;
   849	      }
   850	    }
   851	  }
   852	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete BC.Input.keys[e.key]; }
   853	
   854	  function releaseAll() { BC.Input.reset(); }
   855	
   856	  /* ---------------- orientation / pause (hardening #1) ---------------- */
   857	  function checkOrientation() {
   858	    var landscape = W > H && H < 460;
   859	    if (landscape !== paused) {
   860	      paused = landscape;
   861	      if (paused) releaseAll();
   862	      lastT = 0;
   863	    }
   864	    var el = document.getElementById('rotate');
   865	    if (el) el.style.display = paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
   866	  }
   867	
   868	  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
   869	  function resize() {
   870	    W = Math.max(240, window.innerWidth);
   871	    H = Math.max(320, window.innerHeight);
   872	    var d = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   873	    var longAxis = Math.max(W, H);
   874	    if (longAxis * d > 960) d = 960 / longAxis;
   875	    dpr = d;
   876	    canvas.width = Math.round(W * d);
   877	    canvas.height = Math.round(H * d);
   878	    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
   879	    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
   880	    g.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
   881	    buildMapNodes();
   882	    if (P) layoutBoard();
   883	    checkOrientation();
   884	  }
   885	
   886	  function frame(ts) {
   887	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   888	    if (!lastT) lastT = ts;
   889	    var dt = (ts - lastT) / 1000;
   890	    lastT = ts;
   891	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   892	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   893	    if (paused) { return; }
   894	    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   895	    if (booted) {
   896	      BC.Fx.update(dt);
   897	      if (scene === 'play' && P && !P.over) updatePlay(dt);
   898	      if (scene === 'loading') {
   899	        if (pendingDrawn) { var pn = pending; pending = -1; newPlay(pn, false); scene = 'play'; drawPlay(); }
   900	        else { drawLoading(); pendingDrawn = true; }
   901	      }
   902	      else if (scene === 'map') drawMap();
   903	      else if (scene === 'play') drawPlay();
   904	      else drawCrown();
   905	      if (BC.Fx.flash > 0) {
   906	        g.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.35, BC.Fx.flash * 0.4);
   907	        g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); g.globalAlpha = 1;
   908	      }
   909	    }
   910	  }
   911	
   912	  /* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
   913	  function boot() {
   914	    canvas = document.getElementById('cv');
   915	    g = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
   916	    BC.Audio.setMute(save.mute);
   917	    resize();
   918	    centerMapOn(save.unlocked - 1);
   919	
   920	    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   921	    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { BC.Timers.set(resize, 120); });
   922	
   923	    var opts = { passive: false };
   924	    if (window.PointerEvent) {
   925	      canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onDown(e); }, opts);
   926	      window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (BC.Input.pointers[e.pointerId] !== undefined) e.preventDefault(); onMove(e); }, opts);
   927	      window.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { onUp(e); }, opts);
   928	      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel, opts);
   929	    } else {
   930	      canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; onDown({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY }); } }, opts);
   931	      canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; onMove({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY }); } }, opts);
   932	      canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; onUp({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY }); } }, opts);
   933	      canvas.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) onCancel({ pointerId: e.changedTouches[i].identifier }); }, opts);
   934	      canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
   935	      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
   936	      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
   937	    }
   938	    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
   939	      if (scene === 'map') { e.preventDefault(); map.scroll = BC.clamp(map.scroll - e.deltaY, 0, map.maxScroll); }
   940	    }, opts);
   941	    canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   942	    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
   943	    window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
   944	    window.addEventListener('blur', releaseAll);
   945	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) { releaseAll(); lastT = 0; } });
   946	
   947	    var ov = document.getElementById('tap');
   948	    function start() {
   949	      BC.Audio.unlock();
   950	      if (ov && ov.parentNode) ov.parentNode.removeChild(ov);
   951	      booted = true;
   952	      lastT = 0;
   953	    }
   954	    if (ov) {

     9	  function levelDef(n) {
    10	    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAXLV, n | 0));

    15	
    16	    goals.crate = Math.min(8, 3 + Math.floor(n / 3));
    17	    if (n >= 4) goals.balloon = Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor((n - 4) / 6));
    18	    if (n >= 7) goals.gear = Math.min(3, 1 + Math.floor((n - 7) / 7));
    19	    if (n >= 10 && n % 3 === 1) { goals.pop = 24 + ((n * 5) % 16); popColor = r.int(colors); }

    24	    mv = Math.round(mv);

    26

    42	  function Board(def) {

    60	  Board.prototype.at = function (x, y) {

    68	  Board.prototype.build = function () {

    70	    for (i = 0; i < COLS * ROWS; i++) this.cells[i] = mkBlock(this.rc());

    74	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) q.push(this.rc());

    76	    }

   142	  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
   143	    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   144	      var c = this.at(x, y);

   150	    }

   154	  Board.prototype.shuffleColors = function () {

   192	    } else if (c.sp === SP_BOMB) {

   199	        var t = this.at(i, j);
   200	        if (t && t.k === 'b' && (t.c === col || t.sp !== SP_NONE)) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
   201	      }

   205	  Board.prototype._hit = function (x, y, set, queue) {
   206	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   207	    if (!c || set[c.id]) return;
   208	    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
   209	      if (queue.length < 96) queue.push([x, y, c]);
   210	      return;
   211	    }
   212	    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
   213	  };

   215	  Board.prototype.commonColor = function () {
   216	    var cnt = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], x, y, best = 0;
   217	    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   218	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   219	      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) cnt[c.c]++;
   220	    }
   221	    for (x = 1; x < 6; x++) if (cnt[x] > cnt[best]) best = x;
   222	    return best;
   223	  };

   225	  // Fire one or more specials, chaining. Returns cleared set map.
   226	  Board.prototype.fireSpecials = function (starts) {
   227	    var set = {}, queue = starts.slice(), guard = 0;
   228	    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
   229	      var e = queue.shift(), x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   230	      if (set[c.id]) continue;
   231	      set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
   232	      this.events.push({ t: c.sp === SP_ORB ? 'orb' : (c.sp === SP_BOMB ? 'bomb' : 'rocket'), x: x, y: y, rot: c.rot || 0 });
   233	      this.blastOf(x, y, c, set, queue);
   234	    }
   235	    var coords = [], k;
   236	    for (k in set) coords.push([set[k][0], set[k][1]]);
   237	    this._splash(coords, set);
   238	    return set;
   239	  };
   240	
   241	  // Combine two adjacent specials into a bigger effect
   242	  Board.prototype.combo = function (a, b) {
   243	    var set = {}, queue = [], lo = Math.min(a[2].sp, b[2].sp), hi = Math.max(a[2].sp, b[2].sp);
   244	    var ax = a[0], ay = a[1], i, j;
   245	    set[a[2].id] = a; set[b[2].id] = b;
   246	    this.events.push({ t: 'combo', x: ax, y: ay, kind: lo + '' + hi });
   247	    if (lo === SP_ROCKET && hi === SP_ROCKET) {
   248	      for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) { this._hit(i, ay, set, queue); this._hit(i, b[1], set, queue); }
   249	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) { this._hit(ax, j, set, queue); this._hit(b[0], j, set, queue); }
   250	    } else if (lo === SP_ROCKET && hi === SP_BOMB) {
   251	      for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) for (j = -1; j <= 1; j++) this._hit(i, ay + j, set, queue);
   252	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = -1; i <= 1; i++) this._hit(ax + i, j, set, queue);
   253	    } else if (lo === SP_BOMB && hi === SP_BOMB) {
   254	      for (i = -3; i <= 3; i++) for (j = -3; j <= 3; j++)
   255	        if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 4) this._hit(ax + i, ay + j, set, queue);
   256	    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_ORB) {
   257	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
   258	    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_ROCKET) {
   259	      var col = this.commonColor();
   260	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   261	        var t = this.at(i, j);
   262	        if (t && t.k === 'b' && t.c === col) {
   263	          var k2;
   264	          for (k2 = 0; k2 < this.cols; k2++) this._hit(k2, j, set, queue);
   265	          for (k2 = 0; k2 < this.rows; k2++) this._hit(i, k2, set, queue);
   266	        }
   267	      }
   268	    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_BOMB) {
   269	      var col2 = this.commonColor();
   270	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   271	        var t2 = this.at(i, j);
   272	        if (t2 && t2.k === 'b' && t2.c === col2) {
   273	          for (var di = -1; di <= 1; di++) for (var dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) this._hit(i + di, j + dj, set, queue);
   274	        }
   275	      }
   276	    }
   277	    // chain any specials swept up
   278	    var guard = 0;
   279	    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
   280	      var e = queue.shift();
   281	      if (set[e[2].id]) continue;
   282	      set[e[2].id] = e;
   283	      this.events.push({ t: e[2].sp === SP_ORB ? 'orb' : (e[2].sp === SP_BOMB ? 'bomb' : 'rocket'), x: e[0], y: e[1], rot: e[2].rot || 0 });
   284	      this.blastOf(e[0], e[1], e[2], set, queue);
   285	    }
   286	    var coords = [], k;
   287	    for (k in set) coords.push([set[k][0], set[k][1]]);
   288	    this._splash(coords, set);
   289	    return set;
   290	  };
   291	
   292	  /* ---------- player action ---------- */
   293	  // returns null (illegal) or {cleared:[cells], made:cellOrNull}
   294	  Board.prototype.tap = function (x, y) {
   295	    if (this.over) return null;
   296	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   297	    if (!c) return null;
   298	    this.events.length = 0;
   299	
   300	    var set = null, made = null, n = 0;
   301	
   302	    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
   303	      // adjacent special => combo
   304	      var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], partner = null;
   305	      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   306	        var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   307	        if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp !== SP_NONE) { partner = [x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1], q]; break; }
   308	      }
   309	      if (c.sp === SP_ORB && !partner) c.orbColor = this.bestNeighborColor(x, y);
   310	      set = partner ? this.combo([x, y, c], partner) : this.fireSpecials([[x, y, c]]);
   311	    } else {
   312	      var grp = this.groupAt(x, y);
   313	      if (grp.length < 2) return null;
   314	      n = grp.length;
   315	      set = {};
   316	      var sp = n >= 9 ? SP_ORB : (n >= 7 ? SP_BOMB : (n >= 5 ? SP_ROCKET : SP_NONE));
   317	      for (var k = 0; k < grp.length; k++) {
   318	        var gx = grp[k][0], gy = grp[k][1];
   319	        if (sp && gx === x && gy === y) continue;   // seed cell survives as the special
   320	        var cc = this.at(gx, gy);
   321	        set[cc.id] = [gx, gy, cc];
   322	      }
   323	      this._splash(grp, set);
   324	      if (sp) {
   325	        made = this.at(x, y);
   326	        made.sp = sp;
   327	        made.rot = (x + y) % 2;
   328	        if (sp === SP_ORB) made.orbColor = made.c;
   329	        made.flash = 1;
   330	        this.events.push({ t: 'make', x: x, y: y, sp: sp });
   331	      }
   332	      this.events.push({ t: 'pop', x: x, y: y, n: n });
   333	    }
   334	
   335	    var cleared = this.applyClear(set);
   336	    if (!cleared.length && !made) return null;
   337	
   338	    var base = Math.max(cleared.length, n);
   339	    this.score += base * base * 6 + cleared.length * 12;
   340	    this.movesLeft--; this.movesUsed++;
   341	
   342	    this.settle();
   343	    this.endOfMove();
   344	    return { cleared: cleared, made: made, n: cleared.length };
   345	  };
   346	
   347	  Board.prototype.bestNeighborColor = function (x, y) {
   348	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], best = -1, bn = 0;
   349	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   350	      var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   351	      if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE) {
   352	        var n = this.groupAt(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]).length;
   353	        if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = q.c; }
   354	      }
   355	    }
   356	    return best < 0 ? this.commonColor() : best;
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  // Remove all cells in set, tally goals. Returns list of [x,y,cell]
   360	  Board.prototype.applyClear = function (set) {
   361	    var out = [], k;
   362	    for (k in set) {
   363	      var e = set[k], x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   364	      if (this.at(x, y) !== c) continue;
   365	      if (c.k === 'crate') this.prog.crate++;
   366	      else if (c.k === 'balloon') this.prog.balloon++;
   367	      else if (c.k === 'gear') {
   368	        // plain collapses never touch a gear (see _splash); only a blast knocks it loose
   369	        this.prog.gear++;
   370	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: y });
   371	      }
   372	      else if (c.k === 'b' && c.c === this.def.popColor) this.prog.pop++;
   373	      this.set(x, y, null);
   374	      out.push(e);
   375	    }
   376	    return out;
   377	  };
   378	
   379	  /* ---------- gravity + refill ---------- */
   380	  Board.prototype.settle = function () {
   381	    var x, y, CELL = 1;
   382	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   383	      var write = this.rows - 1;
   384	      for (y = this.rows - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   385	        var c = this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
   386	        if (!c) continue;
   387	        if (write !== y) {
   388	          this.cells[write * this.cols + x] = c;
   389	          this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = null;
   390	          c.oy = (y - write) * CELL;   // rows above (negative), scaled by renderer
   391	          c.vy = 0;
   392	        }
   393	        write--;
   394	      }
   395	      for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   396	        var q = this.queue[x];
   397	        while (q.length < 4) q.push(this.rc());
   398	        if (q.length > 8) q.length = 8;
   399	        var nb = mkBlock(q.shift());
   400	        q.push(this.rc());
   401	        nb.oy = -(write - y + 1);
   402	        nb.vy = 0;
   403	        this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = nb;
   404	      }
   405	    }
   406	  };
   407	
   408	  /* ---------- end of move ---------- */
   409	  Board.prototype.endOfMove = function () {
   410	    var x, y, c;
   411	    // gears are heavy: each move they sink one row through a plain block
   412	    for (y = this.rows - 2; y >= 0; y--) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   413	      c = this.at(x, y);
   414	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   415	        var dn = this.at(x, y + 1);
   416	        if (dn && dn.k === 'b' && dn.sp === SP_NONE) {
   417	          this.set(x, y + 1, c); this.set(x, y, dn);
   418	          c.oy = -1; dn.oy = 1;
   419	        }
   420	      }
   421	    }
   422	    // gears reaching the floor are collected
   423	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   424	      c = this.at(x, this.rows - 1);
   425	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   426	        this.prog.gear++;
   427	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: this.rows - 1 });
   428	        this.set(x, this.rows - 1, null);
   429	      }
   430	    }
   431	    // balloons rise one cell (swap with a plain block above)
   432	    var risers = [];
   433	    for (y = 1; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   434	      c = this.at(x, y);
   435	      if (c && c.k === 'balloon' && !c._rose) {
   436	        var up = this.at(x, y - 1);
   437	        if (up && up.k === 'b') {
   438	          this.set(x, y - 1, c); this.set(x, y, up);
   439	          c.oy = 1; up.oy = -1; c._rose = 1; risers.push(c);
   440	        }
   441	      }
   442	    }
   443	    for (x = 0; x < risers.length; x++) risers[x]._rose = 0;
   444	    this.settle();
   445	
   446	    // goal / fail evaluation
   447	    var gl = this.def.goals, done =
   448	      this.prog.crate >= gl.crate && this.prog.balloon >= gl.balloon &&
   449	      this.prog.gear >= gl.gear && this.prog.pop >= gl.pop;
   450	    if (done) {
   451	      this.over = 1;
   452	      var ratio = this.movesLeft / Math.max(1, this.def.moves);
   453	      this.stars = ratio >= 0.38 ? 3 : (ratio >= 0.15 ? 2 : 1);
   454	      this.score += this.movesLeft * 120;
   455	    } else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) {
   456	      this.over = -1;
   457	    } else {
   458	      var guard = 0;
   459	      while (!this.hasMove() && guard++ < 30) this.shuffleColors();
   460	    }
   461	    if (this.score > 99999999) this.score = 99999999;
   462	  };
   463	
   464	  Board.prototype.goalsLeft = function () {
   465	    var gl = this.def.goals, out = [];
   466	    if (gl.crate) out.push({ k: 'crate', need: gl.crate, have: Math.min(gl.crate, this.prog.crate) });
   467	    if (gl.balloon) out.push({ k: 'balloon', need: gl.balloon, have: Math.min(gl.balloon, this.prog.balloon) });
   468	    if (gl.gear) out.push({ k: 'gear', need: gl.gear, have: Math.min(gl.gear, this.prog.gear) });
   469	    if (gl.pop) out.push({ k: 'pop', need: gl.pop, have: Math.min(gl.pop, this.prog.pop), c: this.def.popColor });
   470	    return out;
   471	  };
   472	
   473	  // Best available group, for the hint button
   474	  Board.prototype.hint = function () {
   475	    var best = null, bn = 1, seen = {};
   476	    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   477	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   478	      if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   479	      if (c.sp !== SP_NONE) return [[x, y]];
   480	      if (seen[c.id]) continue;
   481	      var grp = this.groupAt(x, y);
   482	      for (var i = 0; i < grp.length; i++) { var q = this.at(grp[i][0], grp[i][1]); if (q) seen[q.id] = 1; }
   483	      if (grp.length > bn) { bn = grp.length; best = grp; }
   484	    }
   485	    return best;
   486	  };

   491	    levelDef: levelDef, Board: Board

    42	  function later(fn, ms) {
    43	    if (timers.length > 16) clearTimeout(timers.shift());

    45	      var k = timers.indexOf(id); if (k >= 0) timers.splice(k, 1);

    79	  function finishLevel() {
    80	    var b = S.board, key = '' + S.level;
    81	    if (b.over === 1) {
    82	      var prevStars = save.stars[key] || 0;
    83	      if (b.stars > prevStars) save.stars[key] = b.stars;
    84	      if (b.score > (save.best[key] || 0)) save.best[key] = b.score;
    85	      if (S.level + 1 > save.unlocked) save.unlocked = Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.level + 1);
    86	      save.totalStars = 0;

    97	  /* ---------------- effects ---------------- */
    98	  function burst(x, y, col, n) {
    99	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   100	      if (S.parts.length >= 240) S.parts.shift();
   101	      var a = Math.random() * 6.283, sp = 40 + Math.random() * 190;
   102	      S.parts.push({
   103	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 60,
   104	        life: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.4, max: 0.75, col: col, s: 2 + Math.random() * 4
   105	      });
   106	    }
   107	  }
   108	  function addFx(o) { if (S.fx.length >= 40) S.fx.shift(); o.life = o.life || 0.4; o.max = o.life; S.fx.push(o); }
   109	  function addFloat(x, y, s, col) {
   110	    if (S.floats.length >= 12) S.floats.shift();
   111	    S.floats.push({ x: x, y: y, s: s, col: col || '#fff', life: 0.9 });
   112	  }
   113	  function cellCX(x) { return BX + x * CELL + CELL / 2; }
   114	  function cellCY(y) { return BY + y * CELL + CELL / 2; }
