   116	  /* ---------------- gameplay action ---------------- */
   117	  function doTap(cx, cy) {
   118	    var b = S.board;
   119	    if (!b || b.over || S.overlay) return;
   120	    var pre = { crate: b.prog.crate, balloon: b.prog.balloon, gear: b.prog.gear };
   121	    var res = b.tap(cx, cy);
   122	    if (!res) { Sfx.bad(); S.shake = Math.min(S.shake + 2, 4); return; }
   123	    S.hint = null; S.hintT = 0;
   124	
   125	    var i, e, n = res.cleared.length;
   126	    for (i = 0; i < res.cleared.length; i++) {
   127	      e = res.cleared[i];
   128	      var c = e[2];
   129	      var col = c.k === 'b' ? PAL[c.c] : (c.k === 'crate' ? '#c08a4a' : (c.k === 'balloon' ? '#ff7ab5' : '#9aa4b8'));
   130	      burst(cellCX(e[0]), cellCY(e[1]), col, c.k === 'b' ? 3 : 7);
   131	    }
   132	    for (i = 0; i < b.events.length; i++) {
   133	      e = b.events[i];
   134	      if (e.t === 'rocket') addFx({ t: 'beam', x: e.x, y: e.y, rot: e.rot, life: 0.32 });
   135	      else if (e.t === 'bomb') { addFx({ t: 'ring', x: e.x, y: e.y, r: CELL * 2.6, life: 0.36 }); S.shake += 7; }
   136	      else if (e.t === 'orb') { addFx({ t: 'flash', life: 0.3 }); S.shake += 5; }
   137	      else if (e.t === 'combo') { addFx({ t: 'flash', life: 0.35 }); S.shake += 9; }
   138	      else if (e.t === 'make') { addFx({ t: 'pulse', x: e.x, y: e.y, life: 0.5 }); Sfx.make(); }
   139	      else if (e.t === 'gear') {
   140	        burst(cellCX(e.x), cellCY(e.y), '#ffd166', 14);
   141	        addFloat(cellCX(e.x), cellCY(e.y) - 10, 'GEAR!', '#ffd166');
   142	      }
   143	      else if (e.t === 'pop') { Sfx.pop(e.n); }
   144	    }
   145	    var hadSpecial = false, hadBig = false;
   146	    for (i = 0; i < b.events.length; i++) {
   147	      var t = b.events[i].t;
   148	      if (t === 'rocket' || t === 'bomb') hadSpecial = true;
   149	      if (t === 'orb' || t === 'combo') hadBig = true;
   150	    }
   151	    if (hadBig) Sfx.orb();
   152	    else if (hadSpecial) Sfx.blast();
   153	    if (b.prog.crate > pre.crate) burstText('CRATE');
   154	    if (b.prog.balloon > pre.balloon) burstText('POP!');
   155	
   156	    S.shake = Math.min(S.shake + Math.min(9, n * 0.7), 16);
   157	    if (n >= 4) addFloat(cellCX(cx), cellCY(cy) - 14, '+' + (n * n * 6), '#ffffff');
   158	
   159	    if (b.over) later(finishLevel, 420);
   160	    function burstText(s) { addFloat(cellCX(cx), cellCY(cy) - 30, s, '#9ff2ff'); }
   161	  }
   162	
   163	  function useHint() {
   164	    var b = S.board;
   165	    if (!b || b.over || S.overlay) return;
   166	    S.hint = b.hint(); S.hintT = 3.2;
   167	    Sfx.click();
   168	  }
   169	
   170	  /* ---------------- pointer input ---------------- */
   171	  function local(e) {
   172	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   173	    return {
   174	      x: (e.clientX - r.left) / (r.width || 1) * W,
   175	      y: (e.clientY - r.top) / (r.height || 1) * H
   176	    };
   177	  }
   178	  function btnAt(x, y) {
   179	    for (var i = hits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   180	      var b = hits[i];
   181	      if (x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h) return b;
   182	    }
   183	    return null;
   184	  }
   185	
   186	  function onDown(e) {
   187	    e.preventDefault();
   188	    var p = local(e);
   189	    Sfx.unlock();
   190	    pointers[e.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, btn: btnAt(p.x, p.y) };
   191	    S.kb = false;
   192	  }
   193	  function onMove(e) {
   194	    var p = pointers[e.pointerId];
   195	    if (!p) return;
   196	    e.preventDefault();
   197	    var l = local(e);
   198	    p.x = l.x; p.y = l.y;
   199	  }
   200	  function onUp(e) {
   201	    var p = pointers[e.pointerId];
   202	    delete pointers[e.pointerId];
   203	    if (!p) return;
   204	    e.preventDefault();
   205	    var moved = Math.abs(p.x - p.sx) + Math.abs(p.y - p.sy);
   206	    if (moved > 22) return;
   207	    Sfx.unlock();
   208	    if (S.overlay === 'start') { S.overlay = ''; Sfx.click(); return; }
   209	    if (S.overlay === 'rotate') return;
   210	    var b = btnAt(p.x, p.y);
   211	    if (b && p.btn && b.id === p.btn.id) doAction(b);
   212	  }
   213	  function onCancel(e) { delete pointers[e.pointerId]; }
   214	
   215	  function doAction(b) {
   216	    Sfx.unlock();
   217	    if (b.id === 'cell') {
   218	      doTap(b.cx, b.cy);
   219	      return;
   220	    }
   221	    Sfx.click();
   222	    switch (b.id) {
   223	      case 'retry': newLevel(S.level); break;
   224	      case 'next': newLevel(Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.level + 1)); break;
   225	      case 'levels': S.overlay = ''; S.screen = 'levels'; S.sel = S.level; break;
   226	      case 'back': S.screen = 'play'; break;
   227	      case 'hint': useHint(); break;
   228	      case 'sound':
   229	        save.mute = save.mute ? 0 : 1; Sfx.setMuted(!!save.mute); Store.save(save);
   230	        break;
   231	      case 'pick':
   232	        if (b.n <= save.unlocked) { newLevel(b.n); S.screen = 'play'; }
   233	        break;
   234	    }
   235	  }
   236	
   237	  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, { passive: false });
   238	  cv.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, { passive: false });
   239	  cv.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp, { passive: false });
   240	  cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel, { passive: false });
   241	  cv.addEventListener('pointerleave', onCancel, { passive: false });
   242	  cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   243	  cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   244	  cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   245	
   246	  window.addEventListener('blur', function () { resetInput(); });
   247	  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) resetInput(); });
   248	
   249	  /* ---------------- keyboard ---------------- */
   250	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   251	    var k = e.key;
   252	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'Enter'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   253	    if (keys[k]) return;
   254	    keys[k] = 1;
   255	    Sfx.unlock();
   256	    if (S.overlay === 'start') { if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') S.overlay = ''; return; }
   257	    if (S.overlay === 'rotate') return;
   258	    S.kb = true;
   259	    if (S.screen === 'levels') {
   260	      if (k === 'ArrowLeft') S.sel = Math.max(1, S.sel - 1);
   261	      else if (k === 'ArrowRight') S.sel = Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.sel + 1);
   262	      else if (k === 'ArrowUp') S.sel = Math.max(1, S.sel - 5);
   263	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown') S.sel = Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.sel + 5);
   264	      else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { if (S.sel <= save.unlocked) { newLevel(S.sel); S.screen = 'play'; } }
   265	      else if (k === 'Escape') S.screen = 'play';
   266	      return;
   267	    }
   268	    if (S.overlay === 'win') {
   269	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') newLevel(Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.level + 1));
   270	      else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') newLevel(S.level);
   271	      else if (k === 'Escape') { S.overlay = ''; S.screen = 'levels'; }
   272	      return;
   273	    }
   274	    if (S.overlay === 'lose') {
   275	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter' || k === 'r' || k === 'R') newLevel(S.level);
   276	      else if (k === 'Escape') { S.overlay = ''; S.screen = 'levels'; }
   277	      return;
   278	    }
   279	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') S.cur.x = (S.cur.x + COLS - 1) % COLS;
   280	    else if (k === 'ArrowRight') S.cur.x = (S.cur.x + 1) % COLS;
   281	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp') S.cur.y = (S.cur.y + ROWS - 1) % ROWS;
   282	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown') S.cur.y = (S.cur.y + 1) % ROWS;
   283	    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') doTap(S.cur.x, S.cur.y);
   284	    else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') newLevel(S.level);
   285	    else if (k === 'h' || k === 'H') useHint();
   286	    else if (k === 'Escape') S.screen = 'levels';
   287	  });
   288	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });
   289	
   290	  /* ---------------- canvas fit ---------------- */
   291	  var dpr = 1;
   292	  function fit() {
   293	    var vw = window.innerWidth || W, vh = window.innerHeight || H;
   294	    var scale = Math.min(vw / W, vh / H);
   295	    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   296	    dpr = Math.min(dpr, 960 / H);
   297	    cv.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
   298	    cv.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
   299	    cv.style.width = Math.floor(W * scale) + 'px';
   300	    cv.style.height = Math.floor(H * scale) + 'px';
   301	    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   302	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   303	    S.landscape = vw > vh * 1.12 && vh < 520;
   304	  }
   305	  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
   306	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { later(fit, 120); });
   307	
   308	  /* ---------------- drawing helpers ---------------- */
   309	  function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {
   310	    ctx.beginPath();
   311	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   312	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   313	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   314	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   315	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   316	    ctx.closePath();
   317	  }
   318	  function txt(s, x, y, size, col, align, weight) {
   319	    ctx.fillStyle = col || '#fff';
   320	    ctx.font = (weight || '700') + ' ' + size + 'px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
   321	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   322	    ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
   323	  }
   324	  function button(id, x, y, w, h, label, opts) {
   325	    opts = opts || {};
   326	    var held = false, k;
   327	    for (k in pointers) {
   328	      var p = pointers[k];
   329	      if (p.btn && p.btn.id === id && p.btn.n === opts.n) held = true;
   330	    }
   331	    var yy = y + (held ? 2 : 0);
   332	    ctx.fillStyle = opts.shadow || '#05070f';
   333	    rr(x, y + 4, w, h, 12); ctx.fill();
   334	    ctx.fillStyle = opts.bg || (held ? '#2f3f66' : '#26365c');
   335	    rr(x, yy, w, h, 12); ctx.fill();
   336	    ctx.strokeStyle = opts.border || 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)';
   337	    ctx.lineWidth = 2; rr(x, yy, w, h, 12); ctx.stroke();
   338	    if (label) txt(label, x + w / 2, yy + h / 2 + 1, opts.size || 17, opts.fg || '#eaf1ff', 'center');
   339	    hits.push({ id: id, x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h + 4, n: opts.n, cx: opts.cx, cy: opts.cy });
   340	    return { x: x, y: yy, w: w, h: h };
   341	  }
   342	
   343	  /* shapes per colour = colour-blind readable */
   344	  function glyph(i, cx, cy, r) {
   345	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.82)';
   346	    ctx.beginPath();
   347	    switch (i) {
   348	      case 0: ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.5, 0, 6.283); break;
   349	      case 1: ctx.rect(cx - r * 0.45, cy - r * 0.45, r * 0.9, r * 0.9); break;
   350	      case 2: ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.55); ctx.lineTo(cx + r * 0.55, cy + r * 0.45); ctx.lineTo(cx - r * 0.55, cy + r * 0.45); break;
   351	      case 3: ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(cx + r * 0.6, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + r * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(cx - r * 0.6, cy); break;
   352	      case 4: ctx.rect(cx - r * 0.55, cy - r * 0.17, r * 1.1, r * 0.34); ctx.rect(cx - r * 0.17, cy - r * 0.55, r * 0.34, r * 1.1); break;
   353	      default:
   354	        for (var k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
   355	          var a = -1.5708 + k * 1.2566;
   356	          var px = cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.55, py = cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.55;
   357	          if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
   358	        }
   359	        ctx.closePath();
   360	    }
   361	    ctx.fill();
   362	  }
   363	
   364	  function drawTile(c, x, y, size, ghost) {
   365	    var pad = 3, s = size - pad * 2, cx = x + size / 2, cy = y + size / 2;
   366	    if (c.k === 'b') {
   367	      ctx.fillStyle = PAL_D[c.c % 6];
   368	      rr(x + pad, y + pad + 3, s, s, 10); ctx.fill();
   369	      ctx.fillStyle = PAL[c.c % 6];
   370	      rr(x + pad, y + pad, s, s - 2, 10); ctx.fill();
   371	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.20)';
   372	      rr(x + pad + 4, y + pad + 4, s - 8, (s - 8) * 0.34, 7); ctx.fill();
   373	      if (c.sp === G.SP_NONE) glyph(c.c % 6, cx, cy + 1, size * 0.30);
   374	      else drawSpecial(c, cx, cy, size);
   375	      if (c.flash > 0) {
   376	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (c.flash * 0.7).toFixed(3) + ')';
   377	        rr(x + pad, y + pad, s, s - 2, 10); ctx.fill();
   378	      }
   379	    } else if (c.k === 'crate') {
   380	      ctx.fillStyle = '#7a5124'; rr(x + pad, y + pad + 3, s, s, 8); ctx.fill();
   381	      ctx.fillStyle = '#b9823c'; rr(x + pad, y + pad, s, s - 2, 8); ctx.fill();
   382	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b4519'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   383	      ctx.beginPath();
   384	      ctx.moveTo(x + pad + 4, y + pad + 4); ctx.lineTo(x + pad + s - 4, y + pad + s - 8);
   385	      ctx.moveTo(x + pad + s - 4, y + pad + 4); ctx.lineTo(x + pad + 4, y + pad + s - 8);
   386	      ctx.stroke();
   387	    } else if (c.k === 'balloon') {
   388	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#dfe6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   389	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + size * 0.22); ctx.lineTo(cx + 3, cy + size * 0.42); ctx.stroke();
   390	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6fb0';
   391	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - 2, size * 0.30, size * 0.34, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   392	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
   393	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx - size * 0.10, cy - size * 0.13, size * 0.08, size * 0.11, 0.5, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   394	    } else if (c.k === 'gear') {
   395	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8f9bb3';
   396	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, size * 0.32, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   397	      ctx.fillStyle = '#c6d0e4';
   398	      for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
   399	        var a = i * 0.785;
   400	        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx + Math.cos(a) * size * 0.32, cy + Math.sin(a) * size * 0.32);
   401	        ctx.rotate(a); ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.06, -size * 0.06, size * 0.13, size * 0.12); ctx.restore();
   402	      }
   403	      ctx.fillStyle = '#0e1526';
   404	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, size * 0.12, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   405	    }
   406	    if (ghost) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; rr(x + pad, y + pad, s, s, 10); ctx.fill(); }
   407	  }
   408	
   409	  function drawSpecial(c, cx, cy, size) {
   410	    var r = size * 0.30;
   411	    if (c.sp === G.SP_ROCKET) {
   412	      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx, cy); if (c.rot) ctx.rotate(-1.5708);
   413	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
   414	      ctx.beginPath();
   415	      ctx.moveTo(-r, -r * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(0, -r * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(r * 0.9, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, r * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(-r, r * 0.5);
   416	      ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.5, 0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   417	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
   418	      ctx.fillRect(-r * 1.35, -r * 0.18, r * 0.3, r * 0.36);
   419	      ctx.restore();
   420	    } else if (c.sp === G.SP_BOMB) {
   421	      ctx.fillStyle = '#12172a';
   422	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy + 2, r, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   423	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd166'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   424	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + r * 0.4, cy - r * 0.7); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + r, cy - r * 1.3, cx + r * 1.1, cy - r * 0.5); ctx.stroke();
   425	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
   426	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - r * 0.35, cy - r * 0.25, r * 0.2, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   427	    } else {
   428	      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   429	        ctx.strokeStyle = PAL[(i + Math.floor(S.t * 3)) % 6];
   430	        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   431	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * (0.28 + i * 0.19), i * 1.2 + S.t * 2, i * 1.2 + S.t * 2 + 2.6); ctx.stroke();
   432	      }
   433	      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   434	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.2, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   435	    }
   436	  }

   439	  function goalIcon(kind, x, y, s, col) {
   440	    var fake = { k: kind === 'pop' ? 'b' : kind, c: col || 0, sp: 0, flash: 0 };
   441	    drawTile(fake, x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, false);
   442	  }

   444	  function drawHUD() {
   445	    var b = S.board;
   446	    ctx.fillStyle = '#131a30';
   447	    rr(10, 6, W - 20, 44, 12); ctx.fill();
   448	    txt('LEVEL ' + S.level, 22, 28, 15, '#8fa3cc', 'left');
   449	    txt('' + b.movesLeft, W / 2, 27, 27, b.movesLeft <= 3 ? '#ff6b74' : '#ffffff', 'center');
   450	    txt('MOVES', W / 2, 44, 9, '#8fa3cc', 'center');
   451	    txt(b.score.toLocaleString ? b.score.toLocaleString() : '' + b.score, W - 22, 22, 15, '#eaf1ff', 'right');
   452	    var best = save.best['' + S.level] || 0;
   453	    txt('best ' + best, W - 22, 38, 10, '#8fa3cc', 'right');
   454	
   455	    // goals
   456	    var gs = b.goalsLeft(), n = gs.length;
   457	    var gw = Math.min(112, Math.floor((W - 30) / Math.max(1, n)) - 6);
   458	    var startX = W / 2 - (n * (gw + 6) - 6) / 2;
   459	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   460	      var gx = startX + i * (gw + 6), gy = 56, gh = 38;
   461	      var done = gs[i].have >= gs[i].need;
   462	      ctx.fillStyle = done ? '#1c3d2c' : '#131a30';
   463	      rr(gx, gy, gw, gh, 10); ctx.fill();
   464	      if (done) { ctx.strokeStyle = '#3ecb7e'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; rr(gx, gy, gw, gh, 10); ctx.stroke(); }
   465	      goalIcon(gs[i].k, gx + 20, gy + gh / 2, 30, gs[i].c);
   466	      var lbl = done ? 'DONE' : (gs[i].have + '/' + gs[i].need);
   467	      txt(lbl, gx + 38, gy + gh / 2 + 1, 14, done ? '#7ff0ad' : '#eaf1ff', 'left');
   468	    }
   469	
   470	    // next-spawn preview: what falls into each column next
   471	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f1426';
   472	    rr(BX - 5, 100, BW + 10, 44, 10); ctx.fill();
   473	    txt('NEXT SPAWN', BX - 1, 108, 8.5, '#8fa3cc', 'left');
   474	    for (var x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
   475	      var q = b.queue[x] || [];
   476	      for (var r2 = 0; r2 < 2; r2++) {
   477	        var px = BX + x * CELL + CELL / 2, py = r2 === 0 ? 121 : 135;
   478	        var c = q[r2 === 0 ? 1 : 0];
   479	        if (typeof c !== 'number') continue;
   480	        var sz = r2 === 0 ? 11 : 17;
   481	        ctx.globalAlpha = r2 === 0 ? 0.45 : 1;
   482	        ctx.fillStyle = PAL[c % 6];
   483	        rr(px - sz / 2, py - sz / 2, sz, sz, 4); ctx.fill();
   484	        if (r2 === 1) glyph(c % 6, px, py, sz * 0.52);
   485	        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   486	      }
   487	    }
   488	  }

   490	  /* ---------------- board ---------------- */
   491	  function drawBoard() {
   492	    var b = S.board, x, y;
   493	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f1426';
   494	    rr(BX - 5, BY - 5, BW + 10, BH + 10, 14); ctx.fill();
   495	    ctx.save();
   496	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(BX - 3, BY - 3, BW + 6, BH + 6); ctx.clip();
   497	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f1e';
   498	    for (y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) for (x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
   499	      if ((x + y) % 2) { ctx.fillRect(BX + x * CELL, BY + y * CELL, CELL, CELL); }
   500	    }
   501	    var hintSet = {};
   502	    if (S.hint && S.hintT > 0) for (var i = 0; i < S.hint.length; i++) hintSet[S.hint[i][0] + ',' + S.hint[i][1]] = 1;
   503	
   504	    for (y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) for (x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
   505	      var c = b.cells[y * COLS + x];
   506	      if (!c) continue;
   507	      var px = BX + x * CELL, py = BY + (y + c.oy) * CELL;
   508	      drawTile(c, px, py, CELL, false);
   509	      if (hintSet[x + ',' + y]) {
   510	        var a = 0.35 + 0.3 * Math.sin(S.t * 9);
   511	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')';
   512	        ctx.lineWidth = 3; rr(px + 3, py + 3, CELL - 6, CELL - 6, 10); ctx.stroke();
   513	      }
   514	    }
   515	    // fx inside board
   516	    for (i = 0; i < S.fx.length; i++) {
   517	      var f = S.fx[i], k = f.life / f.max;
   518	      if (f.t === 'beam') {
   519	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (k * 0.75).toFixed(3) + ')';
   520	        if (f.rot) ctx.fillRect(BX + f.x * CELL + CELL * 0.28, BY, CELL * 0.44, BH);
   521	        else ctx.fillRect(BX, BY + f.y * CELL + CELL * 0.28, BW, CELL * 0.44);
   522	      } else if (f.t === 'ring') {
   523	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,' + (k * 0.9).toFixed(3) + ')';
   524	        ctx.lineWidth = 6 * k + 2;
   525	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cellCX(f.x), cellCY(f.y), f.r * (1 - k) + 8, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();
   526	      } else if (f.t === 'pulse') {
   527	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (k * 0.9).toFixed(3) + ')';
   528	        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
   529	        var rr2 = CELL * (0.4 + (1 - k) * 0.7);

   685	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   686	  function update(dt) {
   687	    S.t += dt;
   688	    var b = S.board, i;
   689	    // tile physics (units = rows)
   690	    for (i = 0; i < b.cells.length; i++) {
   691	      var c = b.cells[i];
   692	      if (!c) continue;
   693	      if (c.oy < 0) {
   694	        c.vy += 46 * dt;
   695	        c.oy += c.vy * dt;
   696	        if (c.oy >= 0) { c.oy = 0; c.vy = 0; }
   697	      } else if (c.oy > 0) {
   698	        c.oy -= 7 * dt;
   699	        if (c.oy <= 0) c.oy = 0;
   700	      }
   701	      if (c.flash > 0) c.flash = Math.max(0, c.flash - dt * 2.4);
   702	    }
   703	    for (i = S.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   704	      var p = S.parts[i];
   705	      p.life -= dt;
   706	      if (p.life <= 0) { S.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   707	      p.vy += 520 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   708	    }
   709	    for (i = S.fx.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { S.fx[i].life -= dt; if (S.fx[i].life <= 0) S.fx.splice(i, 1); }
   710	    for (i = S.floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   711	      S.floats[i].life -= dt; S.floats[i].y -= 34 * dt;
   712	      if (S.floats[i].life <= 0) S.floats.splice(i, 1);
   713	    }
   714	    if (S.shake > 0) S.shake = Math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 34);
   715	    if (S.hintT > 0) S.hintT = Math.max(0, S.hintT - dt);
   716	    if (S.overlay === 'win') {
   717	      S.winT += dt;
   718	      var want = Math.min(S.board.stars, Math.floor(S.winT / 0.32));
   719	      if (want > S.starShown) { S.starShown = want; Sfx.star(want - 1); }
   720	    }
   721	  }

   723	  /* ---------------- frame ---------------- */
   724	  function frame(now) {
   725	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   726	    var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
   727	    last = now;
   728	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   729	    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
   730	
   731	    // rotate overlay pauses the sim (hardening #1)
   732	    if (S.landscape && S.overlay !== 'rotate') {
   733	      S.prevOverlay = S.overlay; S.overlay = 'rotate'; resetInput();
   734	    } else if (!S.landscape && S.overlay === 'rotate') {
   735	      S.overlay = S.prevOverlay || ''; S.prevOverlay = '';
   736	    }
   737	    var paused = (S.overlay === 'rotate' || S.overlay === 'start');
   738	    if (!paused) update(dt);
   739	
   740	    hits.length = 0;
   741	    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   742	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0e1a';
   743	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   744	
   745	    if (S.overlay === 'rotate') { drawRotate(); return; }
   746	
   747	    ctx.save();
   748	    if (S.shake > 0.2) {
   749	      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake);
   750	    }
   751	    if (S.screen === 'levels') {
   752	      drawLevels();
   753	    } else {
   754	      drawHUD();
   755	      drawBoard();
   756	      drawFooter();
   757	      if (S.overlay === 'win') drawWin();
   758	      else if (S.overlay === 'lose') drawLose();
   759	    }
   760	    ctx.restore();

   172	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   173	    return {
   174	      x: (e.clientX - r.left) / (r.width || 1) * W,
   175	      y: (e.clientY - r.top) / (r.height || 1) * H
   176	    };
   177	  }
   178	  function btnAt(x, y) {
   179	    for (var i = hits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   180	      var b = hits[i];
   181	      if (x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h) return b;
   182	    }
   183	    return null;
   184	  }
   185	
   186	  function onDown(e) {
   187	    e.preventDefault();
   188	    var p = local(e);
   189	    Sfx.unlock();
   190	    pointers[e.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, btn: btnAt(p.x, p.y) };
   191	    S.kb = false;
   192	  }
   193	  function onMove(e) {
   194	    var p = pointers[e.pointerId];
   195	    if (!p) return;
   196	    e.preventDefault();
   197	    var l = local(e);
   198	    p.x = l.x; p.y = l.y;
   199	  }
   200	  function onUp(e) {
   201	    var p = pointers[e.pointerId];
   202	    delete pointers[e.pointerId];
   203	    if (!p) return;
   204	    e.preventDefault();
   205	    var moved = Math.abs(p.x - p.sx) + Math.abs(p.y - p.sy);
   206	    if (moved > 22) return;
   207	    Sfx.unlock();
   208	    if (S.overlay === 'start') { S.overlay = ''; Sfx.click(); return; }
   209	    if (S.overlay === 'rotate') return;
   210	    var b = btnAt(p.x, p.y);
   211	    if (b && p.btn && b.id === p.btn.id) doAction(b);
   212	  }
   213	  function onCancel(e) { delete pointers[e.pointerId]; }
   214	
   215	  function doAction(b) {
   216	    Sfx.unlock();
   217	    if (b.id === 'cell') {
   218	      doTap(b.cx, b.cy);
   219	      return;
   220	    }
   221	    Sfx.click();
   222	    switch (b.id) {
   223	      case 'retry': newLevel(S.level); break;
   224	      case 'next': newLevel(Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.level + 1)); break;
   225	      case 'levels': S.overlay = ''; S.screen = 'levels'; S.sel = S.level; break;
   226	      case 'back': S.screen = 'play'; break;
   227	      case 'hint': useHint(); break;
   228	      case 'sound':
   229	        save.mute = save.mute ? 0 : 1; Sfx.setMuted(!!save.mute); Store.save(save);
   230	        break;
   231	      case 'pick':
   232	        if (b.n <= save.unlocked) { newLevel(b.n); S.screen = 'play'; }
   233	        break;
   234	    }
   235	  }

   347	  Board.prototype.bestNeighborColor = function (x, y) {
   348	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], best = -1, bn = 0;
   349	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   350	      var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   351	      if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE) {
   352	        var n = this.groupAt(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]).length;
   353	        if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = q.c; }
   354	      }
   355	    }
   356	    return best < 0 ? this.commonColor() : best;
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  // Remove all cells in set, tally goals. Returns list of [x,y,cell]
   360	  Board.prototype.applyClear = function (set) {
   361	    var out = [], k;
   362	    for (k in set) {
   363	      var e = set[k], x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   364	      if (this.at(x, y) !== c) continue;
   365	      if (c.k === 'crate') this.prog.crate++;
   366	      else if (c.k === 'balloon') this.prog.balloon++;
   367	      else if (c.k === 'gear') {
   368	        // plain collapses never touch a gear (see _splash); only a blast knocks it loose
   369	        this.prog.gear++;
   370	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: y });
   371	      }
   372	      else if (c.k === 'b' && c.c === this.def.popColor) this.prog.pop++;
   373	      this.set(x, y, null);
   374	      out.push(e);
   375	    }
   376	    return out;
   377	  };
   378	
   379	  /* ---------- gravity + refill ---------- */
   380	  Board.prototype.settle = function () {
   381	    var x, y, CELL = 1;
   382	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   383	      var write = this.rows - 1;
   384	      for (y = this.rows - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   385	        var c = this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
   386	        if (!c) continue;
   387	        if (write !== y) {
   388	          this.cells[write * this.cols + x] = c;
   389	          this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = null;
   390	          c.oy = (y - write) * CELL;   // rows above (negative), scaled by renderer
   391	          c.vy = 0;
   392	        }
   393	        write--;
   394	      }
   395	      for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   396	        var q = this.queue[x];
   397	        while (q.length < 4) q.push(this.rc());
   398	        if (q.length > 8) q.length = 8;
   399	        var nb = mkBlock(q.shift());
   400	        q.push(this.rc());
   401	        nb.oy = -(write - y + 1);
   402	        nb.vy = 0;
   403	        this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = nb;
   404	      }
   405	    }
   406	  };
   407	
   408	  /* ---------- end of move ---------- */
   409	  Board.prototype.endOfMove = function () {
   410	    var x, y, c;
   411	    // gears are heavy: each move they sink one row through a plain block
   412	    for (y = this.rows - 2; y >= 0; y--) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   413	      c = this.at(x, y);
   414	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   415	        var dn = this.at(x, y + 1);
   416	        if (dn && dn.k === 'b' && dn.sp === SP_NONE) {
   417	          this.set(x, y + 1, c); this.set(x, y, dn);
   418	          c.oy = -1; dn.oy = 1;
   419	        }
   420	      }
   421	    }
   422	    // gears reaching the floor are collected
   423	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   424	      c = this.at(x, this.rows - 1);
   425	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   426	        this.prog.gear++;
   427	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: this.rows - 1 });
   428	        this.set(x, this.rows - 1, null);
   429	      }
   430	    }
   431	    // balloons rise one cell (swap with a plain block above)
   432	    var risers = [];
   433	    for (y = 1; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   434	      c = this.at(x, y);
   435	      if (c && c.k === 'balloon' && !c._rose) {
   436	        var up = this.at(x, y - 1);
   437	        if (up && up.k === 'b') {
   438	          this.set(x, y - 1, c); this.set(x, y, up);
   439	          c.oy = 1; up.oy = -1; c._rose = 1; risers.push(c);
   440	        }
   441	      }
   442	    }
   443	    for (x = 0; x < risers.length; x++) risers[x]._rose = 0;
   444	    this.settle();
   445	
   446	    // goal / fail evaluation
   447	    var gl = this.def.goals, done =
   448	      this.prog.crate >= gl.crate && this.prog.balloon >= gl.balloon &&
   449	      this.prog.gear >= gl.gear && this.prog.pop >= gl.pop;
   450	    if (done) {
   451	      this.over = 1;
   452	      var ratio = this.movesLeft / Math.max(1, this.def.moves);
   453	      this.stars = ratio >= 0.38 ? 3 : (ratio >= 0.15 ? 2 : 1);
   454	      this.score += this.movesLeft * 120;
   455	    } else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) {
   456	      this.over = -1;
   457	    } else {
   458	      var guard = 0;
   459	      while (!this.hasMove() && guard++ < 30) this.shuffleColors();
   460	    }
   461	    if (this.score > 99999999) this.score = 99999999;
   462	  };
   463	
   464	  Board.prototype.goalsLeft = function () {
   465	    var gl = this.def.goals, out = [];
   466	    if (gl.crate) out.push({ k: 'crate', need: gl.crate, have: Math.min(gl.crate, this.prog.crate) });
   467	    if (gl.balloon) out.push({ k: 'balloon', need: gl.balloon, have: Math.min(gl.balloon, this.prog.balloon) });
   468	    if (gl.gear) out.push({ k: 'gear', need: gl.gear, have: Math.min(gl.gear, this.prog.gear) });
   469	    if (gl.pop) out.push({ k: 'pop', need: gl.pop, have: Math.min(gl.pop, this.prog.pop), c: this.def.popColor });
   470	    return out;
   471	  };
   472	
   473	  // Best available group, for the hint button
   474	  Board.prototype.hint = function () {
   475	    var best = null, bn = 1, seen = {};
   476	    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   477	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   478	      if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   479	      if (c.sp !== SP_NONE) return [[x, y]];
   480	      if (seen[c.id]) continue;
   481	      var grp = this.groupAt(x, y);
   482	      for (var i = 0; i < grp.length; i++) { var q = this.at(grp[i][0], grp[i][1]); if (q) seen[q.id] = 1; }
   483	      if (grp.length > bn) { bn = grp.length; best = grp; }
   484	    }
   485	    return best;
   486	  };

   358	        }

   132	  G.W = 390; G.H = 700; G.scale = 1;
   133	  G.landscape = false;
   134	
   135	  G.resize = function () {
   136	    var w = Math.max(240, window.innerWidth || 390);
   137	    var h = Math.max(320, window.innerHeight || 700);
   138	    G.W = w; G.H = h;
   139	    G.landscape = w > h * 1.02;
   140	    var s = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   141	    var long = Math.max(w, h);
   142	    if (long * s > 960) s = 960 / long;
   143	    s = Math.max(0.6, s);
   144	    G.scale = s;
   145	    cv.width = Math.round(w * s);
   146	    cv.height = Math.round(h * s);
   147	    cv.style.width = w + 'px';
   148	    cv.style.height = h + 'px';
   149	    if (G.onResize) G.onResize();
   150	  };
   151	
   152	  /* ---------- particles (capped, hardening #5) ---------- */
   153	  var PART_MAX = 200;
   154	  G.parts = [];
   155	  G.spark = function (x, y, col, n, spd, life, grav, size) {
   156	    n = n || 6;
   157	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   158	      if (G.parts.length >= PART_MAX) G.parts.shift();
   159	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, v = (spd || 90) * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
   160	      G.parts.push({
   161	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vy: Math.sin(a) * v,
   162	        life: (life || 0.5) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7), max: (life || 0.5),
   163	        c: col || '#8ef', g: grav === undefined ? 260 : grav, r: (size || 3.4) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8)
   164	      });
   165	    }
   166	  };
   167	  G.updateParts = function (dt) {
   168	    for (var i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   169	      var p = G.parts[i];
   170	      p.life -= dt;
   171	      if (p.life <= 0) { G.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   172	      p.vy += p.g * dt; p.vx *= (1 - 1.6 * dt);
   173	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   174	    }
   175	    if (G.parts.length > PART_MAX) G.parts.splice(0, G.parts.length - PART_MAX);
   176	  };
   177	  G.drawParts = function () {
   178	    var c = ctx;
   179	    for (var i = 0; i < G.parts.length; i++) {
   180	      var p = G.parts[i];
   181	      var a = G.clamp(p.life / Math.max(0.05, p.max), 0, 1);
   182	      c.globalAlpha = a;
   183	      c.fillStyle = p.c;
   184	      c.beginPath(); c.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (0.4 + a * 0.8), 0, 6.2832); c.fill();
   185	    }
   186	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
   187	  };
   188	
   189	  /* ---------- screen shake ---------- */
   190	  G.shake = 0;
   191	  G.addShake = function (v) { G.shake = Math.min(16, G.shake + v); };
   192	
   193	  /* ---------- text helpers ---------- */
   194	  G.text = function (s, x, y, size, col, align, weight) {
   195	    ctx.font = (weight || '700') + ' ' + size + 'px system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif';
   196	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   197	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   198	    ctx.fillStyle = col || '#eaf6ff';
   199	    ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
   200	  };
   201	  G.rr = function (x, y, w, h, r) {
   202	    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   203	    ctx.beginPath();
   204	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   205	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   206	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   207	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   208	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   209	    ctx.closePath();
   210	  };
   211	
   212	  /* ---------- immediate-mode buttons + keyboard focus ---------- */
   213	  G.ui = {
   214	    hits: [],
   215	    focus: 0,
   216	    reset: function () { this.focus = 0; },
   217	    clearFrame: function () { this.hits.length = 0; },
   218	    btn: function (x, y, w, h, label, fn, opt) {
   219	      opt = opt || {};
   220	      var idx = this.hits.length;
   221	      this.hits.push({ x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h, fn: fn, dis: !!opt.disabled, label: label });
   222	      var focused = (this.focus === idx) && G.keyMode;
   223	      var down = false;
   224	      G.input.pointers.forEach(function (p) {
   225	        if (p.btnIdx === idx && p.x >= x && p.x <= x + w && p.y >= y && p.y <= y + h) down = true;
   226	      });
   227	      var c = ctx;
   228	      c.save();
   229	      if (down) { c.translate(0, 1.5); }
   230	      var bg = opt.disabled ? '#123241' : (opt.bg || (down ? '#1f7fa0' : '#12586f'));
   231	      c.fillStyle = bg;
   232	      G.rr(x, y, w, h, opt.r === undefined ? 12 : opt.r); c.fill();
   233	      c.strokeStyle = opt.disabled ? '#1d4557' : (focused ? '#ffe08a' : (opt.border || '#2ea9cc'));
   234	      c.lineWidth = focused ? 3 : 2;
   235	      G.rr(x, y, w, h, opt.r === undefined ? 12 : opt.r); c.stroke();
   236	      if (label) G.text(label, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 1, opt.fs || 16, opt.disabled ? '#5b7f8e' : (opt.fg || '#eaf6ff'), 'center');
   237	      c.restore();
   238	      return idx;
   239	    },
   240	    nextFocus: function (d) {
   241	      if (!this.hits.length) return;
   242	      var start = this.focus, n = this.hits.length;
   243	      for (var i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
   244	        var k = ((start + d * i) % n + n) % n;
   245	        if (!this.hits[k].dis) { this.focus = k; return; }
   246	      }
   247	    },
   248	    activate: function () {
   249	      var b = this.hits[this.focus];
   250	      if (b && !b.dis && b.fn) { G.audio.sfx('tap'); b.fn(); return true; }
   251	      return false;
   252	    }
   253	  };
   254	  G.keyMode = false;
   255	
   256	  /* ---------- input (hardening #2 #3) ---------- */
   257	  var IN = G.input = {
   258	    pointers: new Map(),
   259	    keys: new Set(),
   260	    reset: function () {
   261	      this.pointers.clear();
   262	      this.keys.clear();
   263	      G.ui.focus = 0;
   264	    }
   265	  };
   266	
   267	  function pos(e) {
   268	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   269	    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   270	  }
   271	  function scr() { return G.screens[G.screen]; }
   272	
   273	  function down(e) {
   274	    e.preventDefault();
   275	    var wasStarted = G.started;
   276	    G.firstGesture();
   277	    var p = pos(e);
   278	    if (!wasStarted || G.paused()) return;
   279	    var rec = { id: e.pointerId, x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, t: performance.now(), btnIdx: -1, claim: null };
   280	    // button hit test (frozen from last frame)
   281	    for (var i = 0; i < G.ui.hits.length; i++) {
   282	      var b = G.ui.hits[i];
   283	      if (!b.dis && p.x >= b.x && p.x <= b.x + b.w && p.y >= b.y && p.y <= b.y + b.h) { rec.btnIdx = i; break; }
   284	    }
   285	    IN.pointers.set(e.pointerId, rec);
   286	    if (IN.pointers.size > 8) { var first = IN.pointers.keys().next().value; IN.pointers.delete(first); }
   287	    G.keyMode = false;
   288	    if (rec.btnIdx < 0) { var s = scr(); if (s && s.down) s.down(rec); }
   289	  }
   290	  function move(e) {
   291	    e.preventDefault();
   292	    var rec = IN.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
   293	    if (!rec) return;
   294	    var p = pos(e);
   295	    rec.x = p.x; rec.y = p.y;
   296	    if (rec.btnIdx < 0) { var s = scr(); if (s && s.move) s.move(rec); }
   297	  }
   298	  function up(e) {
   299	    e.preventDefault();
   300	    var rec = IN.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
   301	    if (!rec) return;
   302	    IN.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
   303	    var p = pos(e); rec.x = p.x; rec.y = p.y;
   304	    if (G.paused()) return;
   305	    if (rec.btnIdx >= 0) {
   306	      var b = G.ui.hits[rec.btnIdx];
   307	      if (b && !b.dis && rec.x >= b.x && rec.x <= b.x + b.w && rec.y >= b.y && rec.y <= b.y + b.h) {
   308	        G.ui.focus = rec.btnIdx;
   309	        G.audio.sfx('tap');
   310	        if (b.fn) b.fn();
   311	      }
   312	      return;
   313	    }
   314	    var s = scr(); if (s && s.up) s.up(rec);
   315	  }
   316	  function cancel(e) {
   317	    var rec = IN.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
   318	    if (!rec) return;
   319	    IN.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
   320	    var s = scr(); if (s && s.cancel) s.cancel(rec);
   321	  }
   322	  G.releaseAll = function () {
   323	    var s = scr();
   324	    IN.pointers.forEach(function (rec) { if (s && s.cancel) s.cancel(rec); });
   325	    IN.pointers.clear();
   326	    IN.keys.clear();
   327	  };
   328	
   329	  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
   330	  cv.addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: false });
   331	  cv.addEventListener('pointerup', up, { passive: false });
   332	  cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel, { passive: false });
   333	  cv.addEventListener('pointerleave', cancel, { passive: false });
   334	  cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   335	  cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   336	  cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   337	  window.addEventListener('blur', function () { G.releaseAll(); });
   338	  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) G.releaseAll(); });
   339	  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { G.resize(); });
   340	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { G.resize(); });
   341	
   342	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   343	    var k = e.key;
   344	    if ([' ', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Enter', 'Tab'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   345	    var wasStarted = G.started;
   346	    G.firstGesture();
   347	    if (!wasStarted || G.paused()) return;
   348	    IN.keys.add(k);
   349	    G.keyMode = true;
   350	    var s = scr();
   351	    if (s && s.key && s.key(k, e)) return;
   352	    if (k === 'Tab' || k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowRight') G.ui.nextFocus(1);
   353	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowLeft') G.ui.nextFocus(-1);
   354	    else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') G.ui.activate();
   355	    else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { G.audio.muted = !G.audio.muted; }
   356	  });
   357	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { IN.keys.delete(e.key); });
   358	})();

     2	(function () {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var G = window.G;
     5	  var COLS = 7, ROWS = 8, NT = 6;
     6	  var GEM = [
     7	    { c: '#ff7a63', d: '#b8402f', n: 'Coral' },
     8	    { c: '#5fd97a', d: '#2b8a45', n: 'Kelp' },
     9	    { c: '#4fc9ef', d: '#1c7fa4', n: 'Bubble' },

    13	  ];
    14	  G.GEM = GEM;

    16	  /* ---- deterministic level table ---- */
    17	  G.LEVELS = 15;
    18	  G.levelCfg = function (i) {
    19	    var r = G.mulberry32(4242 + i * 911);
    20	    var order = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    21	    for (var k = order.length - 1; k > 0; k--) { var j = Math.floor(r() * (k + 1)); var t = order[k]; order[k] = order[j]; order[j] = t; }
    22	    var n = i < 4 ? 1 : (i < 9 ? 2 : 3);
    23	    var moves = 24 + (i % 3) * 2 + (n === 3 ? 4 : n === 2 ? 2 : 0);
    24	    var per = Math.max(8, Math.round(moves * (0.40 + 0.008 * i)));
    25	    var goals = [];
    26	    for (var g = 0; g < n; g++) goals.push({ t: order[g], need: per, got: 0 });
    27	    var base = 1100 + i * 110;
    28	    return {
    29	      idx: i, seed: 9001 + i * 137, moves: moves, goals: goals,
    30	      stars: [base, Math.round(base * 1.8), Math.round(base * 2.6)],
    31	      pearls: 18 + i * 3
    32	    };
    33	  };
    34	  G.bandOf = function (i) { return i < 5 ? 0 : i < 10 ? 1 : 2; };
    35	  G.BAND_COMFORT = [0, 30, 60];
    36	
    37	  /* ---- board ---- */
    38	  var B = G.board = {
    39	    grid: [], rng: null, cfg: null, phase: 'idle', ph: 0,
    40	    sel: null, cur: { r: 4, c: 3 }, swapA: null, swapB: null,
    41	    score: 0, moves: 0, chain: 0, over: 0, pearlsWon: 0, starsWon: 0,
    42	    flash: 0, dragId: -1, popped: []
    43	  };
    44	
    45	  function mk(t) { return { t: t, sp: 0, ox: 0, oy: 0, sc: 1, pop: 0 }; }
    46	
    47	  function fill() {
    48	    B.grid = [];
    49	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    50	      var row = [];
    51	      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    52	        var t, guard = 0;
    53	        do {
    54	          t = Math.floor(B.rng() * NT);
    55	          guard++;
    56	        } while (guard < 24 && (
    57	          (c >= 2 && row[c - 1] && row[c - 2] && row[c - 1].t === t && row[c - 2].t === t) ||
    58	          (r >= 2 && B.grid[r - 1][c].t === t && B.grid[r - 2][c].t === t)
    59	        ));
    60	        row.push(mk(t));
    61	      }
    62	      B.grid.push(row);
    63	    }
    64	    var guard2 = 0;
    65	    while (!hasMove() && guard2++ < 30) shuffle();
    66	  }
    67	
    68	  function shuffle() {
    69	    var list = [];
    70	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) list.push(B.grid[r][c].t);
    71	    for (var i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { var j = Math.floor(B.rng() * (i + 1)); var t = list[i]; list[i] = list[j]; list[j] = t; }
    72	    var k = 0;
    73	    for (r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (c = 0; c < COLS; c++) { B.grid[r][c].t = list[k++]; B.grid[r][c].sp = 0; }
    74	  }
    75	
    76	  function matchRuns() {
    77	    var runs = [];
    78	    var r, c, s, i;
    79	    for (r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    80	      s = 0;
    81	      for (c = 1; c <= COLS; c++) {
    82	        var same = c < COLS && B.grid[r][c].t === B.grid[r][s].t;
    83	        if (!same) {
    84	          if (c - s >= 3) { var cells = []; for (i = s; i < c; i++) cells.push(r * COLS + i); runs.push({ cells: cells, len: c - s, h: true }); }
    85	          s = c;
    86	        }
    87	      }
    88	    }
    89	    for (c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    90	      s = 0;
    91	      for (r = 1; r <= ROWS; r++) {
    92	        var same2 = r < ROWS && B.grid[r][c].t === B.grid[s][c].t;
    93	        if (!same2) {
    94	          if (r - s >= 3) { var cl = []; for (i = s; i < r; i++) cl.push(i * COLS + c); runs.push({ cells: cl, len: r - s, h: false }); }
    95	          s = r;
    96	        }
    97	      }
    98	    }
    99	    return runs;
   100	  }
   101	
   102	  function hasMove() {
   103	    function tryS(r, c, r2, c2) {
   104	      if (r2 < 0 || r2 >= ROWS || c2 < 0 || c2 >= COLS) return false;
   105	      var a = B.grid[r][c], b = B.grid[r2][c2];
   106	      if (a.sp > 0 || b.sp > 0) return true;
   107	      var t = a.t; a.t = b.t; b.t = t;
   108	      var ok = matchRuns().length > 0;
   109	      t = a.t; a.t = b.t; b.t = t;
   110	      return ok;
   111	    }
   112	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   113	      if (tryS(r, c, r, c + 1) || tryS(r, c, r + 1, c)) return true;
   114	    }
   115	    return false;
   116	  }
   117	  B.hasMove = hasMove;
   118	
   119	  function expand(set) {
   120	    var q = [], guard = 0;
   121	    set.forEach(function (k) { q.push(k); });
   122	    while (q.length && guard++ < 600) {
   123	      var k = q.pop(), r = (k / COLS) | 0, c = k % COLS, cell = B.grid[r][c];
   124	      if (!cell) continue;
   125	      if (cell.sp === 1) {
   126	        for (var i = 0; i < COLS; i++) { var k1 = r * COLS + i; if (!set.has(k1)) { set.add(k1); q.push(k1); } }
   127	        for (var j = 0; j < ROWS; j++) { var k2 = j * COLS + c; if (!set.has(k2)) { set.add(k2); q.push(k2); } }
   128	        B.flash = Math.max(B.flash, 0.35); G.addShake(5); G.audio.sfx('special');
   129	      } else if (cell.sp === 2) {
   130	        var t = cell.t;
   131	        for (var rr = 0; rr < ROWS; rr++) for (var cc = 0; cc < COLS; cc++) {
   132	          if (B.grid[rr][cc].t === t) { var k3 = rr * COLS + cc; if (!set.has(k3)) { set.add(k3); q.push(k3); } }
   133	        }
   134	        B.flash = Math.max(B.flash, 0.5); G.addShake(7); G.audio.sfx('special');
   135	      }
   136	    }
   137	  }
   138	
   139	  function cellXY(r, c) {
   140	    var L = B.geo;
   141	    return { x: L.x + c * L.cs + L.cs / 2, y: L.y + r * L.cs + L.cs / 2 };
   142	  }
   143	
   144	  function resolve(origin) {
   145	    var runs = matchRuns();
   146	    var forced = [];
   147	    if (origin) {
   148	      [B.swapA, B.swapB].forEach(function (p) {
   149	        if (p && B.grid[p.r][p.c].sp > 0) forced.push(p.r * COLS + p.c);
   150	      });
   151	    }
   152	    if (!runs.length && !forced.length) return false;
   153	
   154	    var set = new Set();
   155	    runs.forEach(function (run) { run.cells.forEach(function (k) { set.add(k); }); });
   156	    forced.forEach(function (k) { set.add(k); });
   157	
   158	    // specials to create
   159	    var creates = [];
   160	    runs.forEach(function (run) {
   161	      if (run.len < 4) return;
   162	      var k = run.cells[Math.floor(run.len / 2)];
   163	      if (origin) {
   164	        var ok = origin.r * COLS + origin.c;
   165	        if (run.cells.indexOf(ok) >= 0) k = ok;
   166	      }
   167	      creates.push({ k: k, sp: run.len >= 5 ? 2 : 1, t: B.grid[(k / COLS) | 0][k % COLS].t });
   168	    });
   169	
   170	    expand(set);
   171	    creates.forEach(function (cr) { set.delete(cr.k); });
   172	
   173	    B.chain++;
   174	    var mult = Math.min(6, B.chain);
   175	    var counted = 0;
   176	    set.forEach(function (k) {
   177	      var r = (k / COLS) | 0, c = k % COLS, cell = B.grid[r][c];
   178	      if (!cell) return;
   179	      counted++;
   180	      B.score += 25 * mult;
   181	      B.cfg.goals.forEach(function (g) { if (g.t === cell.t && g.got < g.need) g.got++; });
   182	      var p = cellXY(r, c);
   183	      G.spark(p.x, p.y, GEM[cell.t].c, 4, 130, 0.45, 220, B.geo.cs * 0.11);
   184	      cell.pop = 0.01;
   185	    });
   186	    B.clearing = set;
   187	    B.creates = creates;
   188	    B.phase = 'clear'; B.ph = 0;
   189	    G.audio.sfx('match', Math.min(5, B.chain - 1));
   190	    if (counted >= 6) G.addShake(4);
   191	    return true;
   192	  }
   193	
   194	  function applyClear() {
   195	    var set = B.clearing;
   196	    set.forEach(function (k) {
   197	      var r = (k / COLS) | 0, c = k % COLS;
   198	      B.grid[r][c] = null;
   199	    });
   200	    B.creates.forEach(function (cr) {
   201	      var r = (cr.k / COLS) | 0, c = cr.k % COLS;
   202	      var cell = B.grid[r][c];
   203	      if (!cell) { cell = mk(cr.t); B.grid[r][c] = cell; }
   204	      cell.sp = cr.sp; cell.t = cr.t; cell.sc = 1.5;
   205	    });
   206	    B.clearing = null; B.creates = null;
   207	    // gravity
   208	    for (var c2 = 0; c2 < COLS; c2++) {
   209	      var write = ROWS - 1;
   210	      for (var r2 = ROWS - 1; r2 >= 0; r2--) {
   211	        var cell2 = B.grid[r2][c2];
   212	        if (cell2) {
   213	          if (write !== r2) {
   214	            B.grid[write][c2] = cell2;
   215	            B.grid[r2][c2] = null;
   216	            cell2.oy = (r2 - write) * B.geo.cs;
   217	          }
   218	          write--;
   219	        }
   220	      }
   221	      var spawn = 1;
   222	      for (var r3 = write; r3 >= 0; r3--) {
   223	        var nc = mk(Math.floor(B.rng() * NT));
   224	        nc.oy = -(spawn++) * B.geo.cs - 8;
   225	        B.grid[r3][c2] = nc;
   226	      }
   227	    }
   228	    B.phase = 'fall'; B.ph = 0;
   229	  }
   230	
   231	  function trySwap(r, c, r2, c2) {
   232	    if (B.phase !== 'idle' || B.over) return;
   233	    if (r2 < 0 || r2 >= ROWS || c2 < 0 || c2 >= COLS) return;
   234	    B.swapA = { r: r, c: c }; B.swapB = { r: r2, c: c2 };
   235	    var a = B.grid[r][c], b = B.grid[r2][c2];
   236	    B.grid[r][c] = b; B.grid[r2][c2] = a;
   237	    var cs = B.geo.cs;
   238	    b.ox = (c2 - c) * cs; b.oy = (r2 - r) * cs;
   239	    a.ox = (c - c2) * cs; a.oy = (r - r2) * cs;
   240	    B.phase = 'swap'; B.ph = 0;
   241	    B.sel = null;
   242	    G.audio.sfx('swap');
   243	  }
   244	
   245	  function undoSwap() {
   246	    var A = B.swapA, Bb = B.swapB;
   247	    var a = B.grid[A.r][A.c], b = B.grid[Bb.r][Bb.c];
   248	    B.grid[A.r][A.c] = b; B.grid[Bb.r][Bb.c] = a;
   249	    var cs = B.geo.cs;
   250	    b.ox = (Bb.c - A.c) * cs; b.oy = (Bb.r - A.r) * cs;
   251	    a.ox = (A.c - Bb.c) * cs; a.oy = (A.r - Bb.r) * cs;
   252	    B.phase = 'back'; B.ph = 0;
   253	    G.audio.sfx('bad');
   254	  }
   255	
   256	  /* ---- public level API ---- */
   257	  B.start = function (i) {
   258	    B.cfg = G.levelCfg(i);
   259	    B.rng = G.mulberry32(B.cfg.seed);
   260	    B.score = 0; B.moves = B.cfg.moves; B.chain = 0; B.over = 0;
   261	    B.sel = null; B.cur = { r: ROWS - 2, c: 3 }; B.phase = 'idle'; B.ph = 0;
   262	    B.flash = 0; B.dragId = -1; B.pearlsWon = 0; B.starsWon = 0;
   263	    B.clearing = null; B.creates = null;
   264	    B.layout();
   265	    fill();
   266	    // clear pre-existing matches silently
   267	    var guard = 0;
   268	    while (matchRuns().length && guard++ < 40) {
   269	      var runs = matchRuns();
   270	      runs.forEach(function (run) {
   271	        run.cells.forEach(function (k) {
   272	          var r = (k / COLS) | 0, c = k % COLS;
   273	          B.grid[r][c].t = Math.floor(B.rng() * NT);
   274	        });
   275	      });
   276	    }
   277	    if (!hasMove()) shuffle();
   278	  };
   279	
   280	  B.layout = function () {
   281	    var pa = G.LAY.play;
   282	    var top = pa.y + 66;
   283	    var bot = pa.y + pa.h - 26;
   284	    var cs = Math.min((pa.w - 18) / COLS, (bot - top) / ROWS);
   285	    cs = Math.floor(cs);
   286	    B.geo = { cs: cs, x: Math.round(pa.x + (pa.w - cs * COLS) / 2), y: Math.round(top + (bot - top - cs * ROWS) / 2), top: top };
   287	  };
   288	
   289	  B.update = function (dt) {
   290	    if (!B.cfg) return;
   291	    B.flash = Math.max(0, B.flash - dt * 2.2);
   292	    var mul = Math.pow(1e-9, dt);
   293	    var still = true;
   294	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   295	      var cell = B.grid[r][c];
   296	      if (!cell) continue;
   297	      cell.ox *= mul; cell.oy *= mul;
   298	      if (Math.abs(cell.ox) < 0.6) cell.ox = 0;
   299	      if (Math.abs(cell.oy) < 0.6) cell.oy = 0;
   300	      if (cell.ox || cell.oy) still = false;
   301	      cell.sc += (1 - cell.sc) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
   302	      if (cell.pop > 0) cell.pop = Math.min(1, cell.pop + dt * 7);
   303	    }
   304	    B.ph += dt;
   305	
   306	    if (B.phase === 'swap') {
   307	      if (still || B.ph > 0.32) {
   308	        var origin = B.swapB;
   309	        if (!resolve(origin)) {
   310	          undoSwap();
   311	        } else {
   312	          B.moves--;
   313	        }
   314	      }
   315	    } else if (B.phase === 'back') {
   316	      if (still || B.ph > 0.32) { B.phase = 'idle'; B.swapA = B.swapB = null; }
   317	    } else if (B.phase === 'clear') {
   318	      if (B.ph > 0.16) applyClear();
   319	    } else if (B.phase === 'fall') {
   320	      if (still || B.ph > 0.9) {
   321	        if (!resolve(null)) {
   322	          B.phase = 'idle'; B.chain = 0; B.swapA = B.swapB = null;
   323	          var guard = 0;
   324	          while (!hasMove() && guard++ < 20) shuffle();
   325	          B.checkEnd();
   326	        }
   327	      }
   328	    }
   329	  };
   330	
   331	  B.goalsDone = function () {
   332	    return B.cfg.goals.every(function (g) { return g.got >= g.need; });
   333	  };
   334	
   335	  B.checkEnd = function () {
   336	    if (B.over) return;
   337	    if (B.goalsDone()) {
   338	      B.over = 1;
   339	      var st = 1;
   340	      if (B.score >= B.cfg.stars[1]) st = 2;
   341	      if (B.score >= B.cfg.stars[2]) st = 3;
   342	      B.starsWon = st;
   343	      G.onLevelWin(B.cfg.idx, st, B.score);
   344	      G.audio.sfx('win');
   345	      G.addShake(8);
   346	    } else if (B.moves <= 0) {
   347	      B.over = -1;
   348	      G.audio.sfx('lose');
   349	    }
   350	  };
   351	
   352	  /* ---- drawing ---- */
   353	  function gemPath(x, y, s, t) {
   354	    var c = G.ctx, i;
   355	    c.beginPath();
   356	    switch (t) {
   357	      case 0: c.arc(x, y, s * 0.46, 0, 6.2832); break;
   358	      case 1:
   359	        c.moveTo(x, y - s * 0.5); c.quadraticCurveTo(x + s * 0.5, y, x, y + s * 0.5);
   360	        c.quadraticCurveTo(x - s * 0.5, y, x, y - s * 0.5); break;
   361	      case 2: c.arc(x, y, s * 0.44, 0, 6.2832); break;
   362	      case 3:
   363	        for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
   364	          var a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5, rr = i % 2 ? s * 0.22 : s * 0.5;
   365	          c[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y + Math.sin(a) * rr);
   366	        }
   367	        c.closePath(); break;
   368	      case 4:
   369	        c.moveTo(x, y - s * 0.5); c.lineTo(x + s * 0.44, y); c.lineTo(x, y + s * 0.5); c.lineTo(x - s * 0.44, y); c.closePath(); break;
   370	      default:
   371	        for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
   372	          var a2 = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 3;
   373	          c[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](x + Math.cos(a2) * s * 0.47, y + Math.sin(a2) * s * 0.47);
   374	        }
   375	        c.closePath();
   376	    }
   377	  }
   378	
   379	  G.drawGem = function (x, y, s, t, sp, alpha) {
   380	    var c = G.ctx;
   381	    c.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
   382	    c.fillStyle = GEM[t].d;
   383	    gemPath(x, y + s * 0.06, s, t); c.fill();
   384	    c.fillStyle = GEM[t].c;
   385	    gemPath(x, y, s, t); c.fill();
   386	    if (t === 2) { c.fillStyle = '#0a3346'; c.beginPath(); c.arc(x, y, s * 0.2, 0, 6.2832); c.fill(); }
   387	    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)';
   388	    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x - s * 0.14, y - s * 0.17, s * 0.13, s * 0.09, -0.5, 0, 6.2832); c.fill();
   389	    if (sp === 1) {
   390	      c.strokeStyle = '#fff'; c.lineWidth = Math.max(2, s * 0.07);
   391	      c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x - s * 0.3, y); c.lineTo(x + s * 0.3, y); c.stroke();
   392	      c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x, y - s * 0.3); c.lineTo(x, y + s * 0.3); c.stroke();
   393	    } else if (sp === 2) {
   394	      c.strokeStyle = '#fff'; c.lineWidth = Math.max(2, s * 0.06);
   395	      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   396	        var a = i * Math.PI / 4 + performance.now() * 0.0012;
   397	        c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * s * 0.36, y + Math.sin(a) * s * 0.36);
   398	        c.lineTo(x - Math.cos(a) * s * 0.36, y - Math.sin(a) * s * 0.36); c.stroke();
   399	      }
   400	    }
   401	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
   402	  };
   403	
   404	  B.draw = function () {
   405	    var c = G.ctx, L = B.geo, pa = G.LAY.play;
   406	    // panel
   407	    var px = pa.x + 10, py = pa.y + 6, pw = pa.w - 20, ph = 54;
   408	    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,40,56,0.85)'; G.rr(px, py, pw, ph, 12); c.fill();
   409	    c.strokeStyle = '#1d6a86'; c.lineWidth = 2; G.rr(px, py, pw, ph, 12); c.stroke();
   410	    G.text('LV ' + (B.cfg.idx + 1), px + 12, py + 16, 13, '#8fd7f0');
   411	    G.text(B.score.toString(), px + 12, py + 37, 20, '#fff');
   412	    var mx = px + pw - 12;
   413	    G.text('MOVES', mx, py + 16, 12, B.moves <= 3 ? '#ff8a7a' : '#8fd7f0', 'right');
   414	    G.text(B.moves.toString(), mx, py + 37, 22, B.moves <= 3 ? '#ff8a7a' : '#fff', 'right');
   415	    var gw = B.cfg.goals.length, gx = px + pw / 2 - (gw * 44) / 2 + 22;
   416	    for (var i = 0; i < gw; i++) {
   417	      var g = B.cfg.goals[i];
   418	      G.drawGem(gx + i * 44, py + 22, 24, g.t, 0, g.got >= g.need ? 0.35 : 1);
   419	      G.text(g.got >= g.need ? 'OK' : (g.need - g.got) + '', gx + i * 44, py + 43, 13, g.got >= g.need ? '#7fe3a0' : '#fff', 'center');
   420	    }
   421	
   422	    // board bg
   423	    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,28,42,0.7)';
   424	    G.rr(L.x - 5, L.y - 5, L.cs * COLS + 10, L.cs * ROWS + 10, 14); c.fill();
   425	    c.save();
   426	    G.rr(L.x - 5, L.y - 5, L.cs * COLS + 10, L.cs * ROWS + 10, 14); c.clip();
   427	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var cc = 0; cc < COLS; cc++) {
   428	      c.fillStyle = ((r + cc) & 1) ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.030)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.055)';
   429	      c.fillRect(L.x + cc * L.cs, L.y + r * L.cs, L.cs, L.cs);
   430	    }
   431	    // selection / cursor
   432	    if (B.sel) {
   433	      c.strokeStyle = '#ffe08a'; c.lineWidth = 3;
   434	      G.rr(L.x + B.sel.c * L.cs + 2, L.y + B.sel.r * L.cs + 2, L.cs - 4, L.cs - 4, 8); c.stroke();
   435	    }
   436	    if (G.keyMode) {
   437	      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'; c.lineWidth = 2;
   438	      G.rr(L.x + B.cur.c * L.cs + 3, L.y + B.cur.r * L.cs + 3, L.cs - 6, L.cs - 6, 8); c.stroke();
   439	    }

   455	  /* ---- input ---- */
   456	  function cellAt(x, y) {
   457	    var L = B.geo;
   458	    var c = Math.floor((x - L.x) / L.cs), r = Math.floor((y - L.y) / L.cs);
   459	    if (r < 0 || r >= ROWS || c < 0 || c >= COLS) return null;

   462	  B.down = function (rec) {
   463	    if (B.over || B.phase !== 'idle') return;
   464	    var cl = cellAt(rec.x, rec.y);
   465	    if (!cl) return;
   466	    B.dragId = rec.id;
   467	    rec.cell = cl;
   468	    B.sel = cl;
   469	    G.keyMode = false;
   470	  };
   471	  B.move = function (rec) {
   472	    if (rec.id !== B.dragId || !rec.cell || B.phase !== 'idle' || B.over) return;
   473	    var dx = rec.x - rec.sx, dy = rec.y - rec.sy;
   474	    var th = B.geo.cs * 0.4;
   475	    if (Math.abs(dx) < th && Math.abs(dy) < th) return;
   476	    var a = rec.cell;
   477	    var r2 = a.r, c2 = a.c;
   478	    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) c2 += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else r2 += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   479	    B.dragId = -1; rec.cell = null;
   480	    trySwap(a.r, a.c, r2, c2);
   481	  };
   482	  B.up = function (rec) {
   483	    if (rec.id === B.dragId) B.dragId = -1;
   484	    if (!rec.cell) { B.sel = null; return; }
   485	    // tap-tap swap fallback
   486	    var cl = cellAt(rec.x, rec.y);
   487	    rec.cell = null;
   488	    if (!cl) { B.sel = null; return; }
   489	    if (B.tapSel && B.tapSel.r === cl.r && B.tapSel.c === cl.c) {
   490	      B.tapSel = null; B.sel = null;
   491	    } else if (B.tapSel && (Math.abs(B.tapSel.r - cl.r) + Math.abs(B.tapSel.c - cl.c)) === 1) {
   492	      var s = B.tapSel; B.tapSel = null; B.sel = null;
   493	      trySwap(s.r, s.c, cl.r, cl.c);
   494	    } else {
   495	      B.tapSel = cl; B.sel = cl;
   496	    }
   497	  };
   498	  B.cancel = function (rec) {
   499	    if (rec.id === B.dragId) B.dragId = -1;
   500	    rec.cell = null;
   501	    B.sel = B.tapSel || null;
   502	  };
   503	  B.resetInput = function () { B.dragId = -1; B.sel = null; B.tapSel = null; };
   504	
   505	  B.key = function (k) {
   506	    if (B.over) return false;
   507	    var cur = B.cur;
   508	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown') {
   509	      var dr = k === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : k === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : 0;
   510	      var dc = k === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : k === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : 0;
   511	      if (B.sel) {
   512	        var s = B.sel; B.sel = null; B.tapSel = null;
   513	        trySwap(s.r, s.c, s.r + dr, s.c + dc);
   514	        B.cur = { r: G.clamp(s.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1), c: G.clamp(s.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1) };
   515	      } else {
   516	        cur.r = G.clamp(cur.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   517	        cur.c = G.clamp(cur.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   518	      }
   519	      return true;
   520	    }
   521	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   522	      if (B.phase !== 'idle') return true;
   523	      B.sel = B.sel ? null : { r: cur.r, c: cur.c };
   524	      B.tapSel = B.sel;
   525	      G.audio.sfx('tap');
   526	      return true;
   527	    }
   528	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { G.startLevel(B.cfg.idx); return true; }
   529	    return false;
   530	  };
