    25	    { n: 'Vent Goby', cost: 44, sz: 10, spd: 52, school: 0.2, shy: 0.2, bottom: 0.3, vent: 1, greed: 0.8, col: '#7effc0', fin: '#28a877', desc: 'Bubbles at vents' }
    26	  ];
    27	
    28	  var MAXF = 24, MAXD = 24, MAXFOOD = 36, MAXBUB = 70;
    29	
    30	  var T = G.tank = {
    31	    fish: [], decor: [], food: [], bub: [], fed: 0.35,
    32	    dragId: -1, drag: null, t: 0, rect: null, msg: '', msgT: 0
    33	  };
    34	
    35	  T.rectCalc = function () {
    36	    var pa = G.LAY.play;
    37	    T.rect = { x: pa.x + 8, y: pa.y + 46, w: pa.w - 16, h: pa.h - 46 - 34 };
    38	  };
    39	
    40	  /* ---- comfort ---- */
    41	  T.stats = function () {
    42	    var pl = 0, hd = 0, fl = 0, sp = {};
    43	    for (var i = 0; i < T.decor.length; i++) {
    44	      var d = DECOR[T.decor[i].k];
    45	      if (!d) continue;
    46	      pl += d.plant; hd += d.hide; fl += d.filt;
    47	    }
    48	    for (var j = 0; j < T.fish.length; j++) sp[T.fish[j].s] = 1;
    49	    var variety = Object.keys(sp).length;
    50	    var comfort = Math.min(100, Math.round(pl * 5 + hd * 5 + fl * 6 + variety * 3 + T.fed * 26));
    51	    return { plants: pl, hides: hd, filters: fl, variety: variety, comfort: comfort };
    52	  };
    53	
    54	  /* ---- entities ---- */
    55	  T.addFish = function (s, x, y) {
    56	    if (T.fish.length >= MAXF) return false;
    57	    var r = T.rect;
    58	    var f = FISH[s];
    59	    T.fish.push({
    60	      s: s, x: x === undefined ? r.x + 20 + Math.random() * (r.w - 40) : x,
    61	      y: y === undefined ? r.y + 30 + Math.random() * (r.h - 70) : y,
    62	      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30, vy: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0, rt: 0, dir: 1,
    63	      belly: 0.5, ph: Math.random() * 6.283, bt: Math.random() * 3
    64	    });
    65	    return true;
    66	  };
    67	  T.addDecor = function (k, v, x, y) {
    68	    if (T.decor.length >= MAXD) return false;
    69	    var r = T.rect;
    70	    T.decor.push({
    71	      k: k, v: v,
    72	      x: x === undefined ? 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.7 : x,
    73	      y: y === undefined ? 0.86 + Math.random() * 0.08 : y
    74	    });
    75	    return true;
    76	  };
    77	  T.dropFood = function (x, y) {
    78	    if (T.food.length >= MAXFOOD) T.food.shift();
    79	    T.food.push({ x: x, y: y, vy: 10 + Math.random() * 10, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8, life: 26 });
    80	    G.audio.sfx('plop');
    81	    G.spark(x, y, '#cfe9ff', 4, 60, 0.4, 60, 2);
    82	  };
    83	
    84	  /* ---- sim ---- */
    85	  T.update = function (dt) {
    86	    var r = T.rect;
    87	    if (!r) return;
    88	    if (T.msgT > 0) T.msgT -= dt;
    89	
    90	    // food
    91	    for (var i = T.food.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    92	      var fd = T.food[i];
    93	      fd.life -= dt;
    94	      fd.vy = Math.min(26, fd.vy + 8 * dt);
    95	      fd.x += fd.vx * dt; fd.vx *= (1 - dt);
    96	      fd.y += fd.vy * dt;
    97	      if (fd.y > r.y + r.h - 6) { fd.y = r.y + r.h - 6; fd.vy = 0; }
    98	      if (fd.life <= 0) T.food.splice(i, 1);
    99	    }
   100	
   101	    // bubbles from vents
   102	    var vents = [];
   103	    for (i = 0; i < T.decor.length; i++) {
   104	      var dd = DECOR[T.decor[i].k];
   105	      if (dd && dd.filt) vents.push(T.decor[i]);
   106	    }
   107	    if (vents.length && T.bub.length < MAXBUB && Math.random() < dt * 9) {
   108	      var vv = vents[(Math.random() * vents.length) | 0];
   109	      T.bub.push({ x: r.x + vv.x * r.w + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14, y: r.y + vv.y * r.h - 10, r: 1.6 + Math.random() * 2.6, ph: Math.random() * 6.28 });
   110	    }
   111	    for (i = T.bub.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   112	      var b = T.bub[i];
   113	      b.y -= (26 + b.r * 6) * dt;
   114	      b.x += Math.sin(T.t * 2 + b.ph) * 8 * dt;
   115	      if (b.y < r.y + 4) T.bub.splice(i, 1);
   116	    }
   117	    if (T.bub.length > MAXBUB) T.bub.splice(0, T.bub.length - MAXBUB);
   118	
   119	    // hunger decay (slow, no gate: feeding is free & instant)
   120	    T.fed = G.clamp(T.fed - dt * 0.006, 0, 1);
   121	
   122	    // fish AI
   123	    var plants = [], hides = [];
   124	    for (i = 0; i < T.decor.length; i++) {
   125	      var dc = DECOR[T.decor[i].k];
   126	      if (!dc) continue;
   127	      var px = r.x + T.decor[i].x * r.w, py = r.y + T.decor[i].y * r.h - dc.h[T.decor[i].v] * 0.4;
   128	      if (dc.plant) plants.push({ x: px, y: py });
   129	      if (dc.hide) hides.push({ x: px, y: py });
   130	    }
   131	    var ventPts = vents.map(function (v) { return { x: r.x + v.x * r.w, y: r.y + v.y * r.h - 20 }; });
   132	
   133	    for (i = 0; i < T.fish.length; i++) {
   134	      var f = T.fish[i], sp = FISH[f.s];
   135	      f.rt -= dt; f.bt -= dt;
   136	      f.belly = G.clamp(f.belly - dt * 0.012, 0, 1);
   137	
   138	      var ax = 0, ay = 0;
   139	      // wander target
   140	      if (f.rt <= 0 || f.tx === 0) {
   141	        f.rt = 1.6 + Math.random() * 3.2;
   142	        f.tx = r.x + 24 + Math.random() * (r.w - 48);
   143	        f.ty = r.y + 24 + Math.random() * (r.h - 52);
   144	        if (sp.bottom) f.ty = r.y + r.h - 18 - Math.random() * 40 * (1 - sp.bottom);
   145	        if (sp.vent && ventPts.length && Math.random() < 0.7) {
   146	          var vp = ventPts[(Math.random() * ventPts.length) | 0];
   147	          f.tx = vp.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40; f.ty = vp.y - Math.random() * 30;
   148	        } else if (sp.shy > 0.5 && plants.length && Math.random() < sp.shy * 0.8) {
   149	          var pp = plants[(Math.random() * plants.length) | 0];
   150	          f.tx = pp.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 34; f.ty = pp.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 26;
   151	        } else if (sp.shy > 0.3 && hides.length && Math.random() < 0.4) {
   152	          var hp = hides[(Math.random() * hides.length) | 0];
   153	          f.tx = hp.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30; f.ty = hp.y;
   154	        }
   155	      }
   156	
   157	      // food seeking
   158	      var best = null, bd = 1e9;
   159	      for (var q = 0; q < T.food.length; q++) {
   160	        var d2 = G.dist(f.x, f.y, T.food[q].x, T.food[q].y);
   161	        if (d2 < bd) { bd = d2; best = T.food[q]; }
   162	      }
   163	      var hungry = 1 - f.belly;
   164	      if (best && bd < 40 + 190 * sp.greed * hungry) {
   165	        ax += (best.x - f.x) * 2.4 * sp.greed;
   166	        ay += (best.y - f.y) * 2.4 * sp.greed;
   167	        if (bd < 9 + sp.sz * 0.4) {
   168	          var fi = T.food.indexOf(best);
   169	          if (fi >= 0) T.food.splice(fi, 1);
   170	          f.belly = G.clamp(f.belly + 0.32, 0, 1);
   171	          T.fed = G.clamp(T.fed + 0.035, 0, 1);
   172	          G.audio.sfx('eat');
   173	          G.spark(best.x, best.y, '#ffe9a8', 3, 45, 0.35, 30, 2);
   174	        }
   175	      } else {
   176	        ax += (f.tx - f.x) * 0.9;
   177	        ay += (f.ty - f.y) * 0.9;
   178	        // schooling
   179	        if (sp.school > 0.2) {
   180	          var cx = 0, cy = 0, n = 0, sx = 0, sy = 0;
   181	          for (var j = 0; j < T.fish.length; j++) {
   182	            if (j === i) continue;
   183	            var o = T.fish[j];
   184	            if (o.s !== f.s) continue;
   185	            var dd2 = G.dist(f.x, f.y, o.x, o.y);
   186	            if (dd2 < 110) { cx += o.x; cy += o.y; n++; if (dd2 < 22 && dd2 > 0.01) { sx += (f.x - o.x) / dd2; sy += (f.y - o.y) / dd2; } }
   187	          }
   188	          if (n) {
   189	            ax += ((cx / n) - f.x) * 1.5 * sp.school;
   190	            ay += ((cy / n) - f.y) * 1.5 * sp.school;
   191	            ax += sx * 190 * sp.school; ay += sy * 190 * sp.school;
   192	          }
   193	        }
   194	      }
   195	      // walls
   196	      var m = 16 + sp.sz;
   197	      if (f.x < r.x + m) ax += (r.x + m - f.x) * 8;
   198	      if (f.x > r.x + r.w - m) ax -= (f.x - (r.x + r.w - m)) * 8;
   199	      if (f.y < r.y + m) ay += (r.y + m - f.y) * 8;
   200	      if (f.y > r.y + r.h - m * 0.7) ay -= (f.y - (r.y + r.h - m * 0.7)) * 8;
   201	
   202	      f.vx += ax * dt; f.vy += ay * dt;
   203	      var damp = Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   204	      f.vx *= damp; f.vy *= damp;
   205	      var sp2 = Math.sqrt(f.vx * f.vx + f.vy * f.vy);
   206	      var maxs = sp.spd * (best && bd < 150 ? 1.7 : 1);
   207	      if (sp2 > maxs) { f.vx = f.vx / sp2 * maxs; f.vy = f.vy / sp2 * maxs; }
   208	      f.x += f.vx * dt; f.y += f.vy * dt;
   209	      f.x = G.clamp(f.x, r.x + 6, r.x + r.w - 6);
   210	      f.y = G.clamp(f.y, r.y + 6, r.y + r.h - 6);
   211	      if (Math.abs(f.vx) > 6) f.dir = f.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   212	      f.ph += dt * (3 + sp2 * 0.05);
   213	
   214	      // vent goby bubbling
   215	      if (sp.vent && f.bt <= 0 && T.bub.length < MAXBUB) {
   216	        f.bt = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.6;
   217	        T.bub.push({ x: f.x + f.dir * sp.sz, y: f.y - 2, r: 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.6, ph: Math.random() * 6.28 });
   218	      }
   219	    }
   220	    if (T.fish.length > MAXF) T.fish.length = MAXF;
   221	    if (T.decor.length > MAXD) T.decor.length = MAXD;
   222	  };
   223	
   224	  /* ---- drawing ---- */
   225	  function drawDecor(d, hl) {
   226	    var r = T.rect;
   227	    drawDecorAt(d.k, d.v, r.x + d.x * r.w, r.y + d.y * r.h, 1, hl, d.x);
   228	  }
   229	  function drawDecorAt(kk, vv, x, y, scale, hl, phase) {
   230	    var c = G.ctx, def = DECOR[kk];
   231	    if (!def) return;
   232	    var d = { k: kk, v: vv, x: phase === undefined ? 0.5 : phase };
   233	    var h = def.h[d.v], col = def.col[d.v];
   234	    c.save();
   235	    if (scale !== 1) { c.translate(x, y); c.scale(scale, scale); c.translate(-x, -y); }
   236	    if (hl) { c.shadowColor = '#ffe08a'; c.shadowBlur = 14; }
   237	    c.fillStyle = col;
   238	    var sway = Math.sin(T.t * 1.1 + d.x * 9) * 5;
   239	    switch (def.k) {
   240	      case 'kelp':
   241	        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   242	          var ox = (i - 1) * 9;
   243	          c.beginPath(); c.lineWidth = 7; c.strokeStyle = col; c.lineCap = 'round';
   244	          c.moveTo(x + ox, y);
   245	          c.quadraticCurveTo(x + ox + sway * (1 + i * 0.3), y - h * 0.6, x + ox + sway * 1.6, y - h);
   246	          c.stroke();
   247	        }
   248	        break;
   249	      case 'fan':
   250	        c.beginPath();
   251	        c.moveTo(x, y);
   252	        for (var a = 0; a <= 10; a++) {
   253	          var t2 = a / 10, ang = Math.PI * (0.15 + t2 * 0.7);
   254	          var rr = h * (d.v === 1 ? 1.0 : 0.85);
   255	          c.lineTo(x - Math.cos(ang) * rr * (d.v === 1 ? 0.45 : 0.8), y - Math.sin(ang) * rr);
   256	        }
   257	        c.closePath(); c.fill();
   258	        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
   259	        for (var b2 = 1; b2 < 4; b2++) { c.fillRect(x - 1 + (b2 - 2) * 8, y - h * 0.5, 2, h * 0.5); }
   260	        break;
   261	      case 'arch':
   262	        c.beginPath();
   263	        c.moveTo(x - 34, y); c.lineTo(x - 34, y - h * 0.55);
   264	        c.quadraticCurveTo(x, y - h * 1.5, x + 34, y - h * 0.55); c.lineTo(x + 34, y);
   265	        c.lineTo(x + 18, y); c.lineTo(x + 18, y - h * 0.5);
   266	        c.quadraticCurveTo(x, y - h * 1.05, x - 18, y - h * 0.5); c.lineTo(x - 18, y);
   267	        c.closePath(); c.fill();
   268	        break;
   269	      case 'log':
   270	        c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x, y - h * 0.4, 34, h * 0.42, 0, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   271	        c.fillStyle = '#20303a'; c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x - 22, y - h * 0.4, 11, h * 0.32, 0, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   272	        break;
   273	      case 'vent':
   274	        c.fillStyle = '#4a6470'; G.rr(x - h * 0.28, y - h * 0.7, h * 0.56, h * 0.7, 6); c.fill();
   275	        c.fillStyle = col; G.rr(x - h * 0.2, y - h * 0.62, h * 0.4, h * 0.16, 4); c.fill();
   276	        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
   277	        for (var v = 0; v < 3; v++) c.fillRect(x - h * 0.18 + v * h * 0.15, y - h * 0.34, h * 0.08, h * 0.22);
   278	        break;
   279	      case 'anem':
   280	        for (var t3 = 0; t3 < 9; t3++) {
   281	          var an = -Math.PI * (0.15 + t3 / 8 * 0.7);
   282	          var wob = Math.sin(T.t * 2.2 + t3) * 6;
   283	          c.beginPath(); c.lineWidth = 5; c.lineCap = 'round'; c.strokeStyle = col;
   284	          c.moveTo(x, y - 4);
   285	          c.quadraticCurveTo(x + Math.cos(an) * h * 0.4, y + Math.sin(an) * h * 0.5,
   286	            x + Math.cos(an) * h * 0.6 + wob, y + Math.sin(an) * h * 0.85);
   287	          c.stroke();
   288	        }
   289	        c.fillStyle = '#5a4a6a'; c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x, y - 2, 14, 7, 0, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   290	        break;
   291	      case 'shell':
   292	        for (var s2 = 0; s2 < 3; s2++) {
   293	          var sx2 = x + (s2 - 1) * 15, sy2 = y - (s2 === 1 ? 6 : 0);
   294	          c.fillStyle = col;
   295	          c.beginPath(); c.arc(sx2, sy2, h * 0.35, Math.PI, 0); c.closePath(); c.fill();
   296	          c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'; c.lineWidth = 1.5;
   297	          c.beginPath(); c.arc(sx2, sy2, h * 0.2, Math.PI, 0); c.stroke();
   298	        }
   299	        break;
   300	      default:
   301	        c.beginPath();
   302	        c.moveTo(x - 46, y);
   303	        c.quadraticCurveTo(x - 20, y - h, x + 6, y - h * 0.7);
   304	        c.quadraticCurveTo(x + 30, y - h * 0.4, x + 48, y);
   305	        c.closePath(); c.fill();
   306	    }
   307	    c.restore();
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function drawFish(f) {
   311	    var c = G.ctx, sp = FISH[f.s], s = sp.sz;
   312	    c.save();
   313	    c.translate(f.x, f.y);
   314	    c.scale(f.dir, 1);
   315	    var wob = Math.sin(f.ph) * 0.25;
   316	    c.rotate(G.clamp(f.vy * f.dir * 0.004, -0.5, 0.5));
   317	    // tail
   318	    c.fillStyle = sp.fin;
   319	    c.beginPath();
   320	    c.moveTo(-s * 0.8, 0);
   321	    c.lineTo(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.7 + wob * s);
   322	    c.lineTo(-s * 1.55, 0);
   323	    c.lineTo(-s * 1.8, s * 0.7 + wob * s);
   324	    c.closePath(); c.fill();
   325	    // fins
   326	    c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.45); c.lineTo(s * 0.3, -s * 1.1 - wob * s * 0.4); c.lineTo(s * 0.55, -s * 0.35); c.closePath(); c.fill();
   327	    c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(-s * 0.1, s * 0.4); c.lineTo(s * 0.1, s * 0.95); c.lineTo(s * 0.5, s * 0.3); c.closePath(); c.fill();
   328	    // body
   329	    c.fillStyle = sp.col;
   330	    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(0, 0, s * 1.15, s * 0.66, 0, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   331	    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
   332	    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.2, s * 0.75, s * 0.24, 0, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   333	    // eye
   334	    c.fillStyle = '#0d2029';
   335	    c.beginPath(); c.arc(s * 0.62, -s * 0.14, s * 0.16, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   336	    c.fillStyle = '#fff';
   337	    c.beginPath(); c.arc(s * 0.67, -s * 0.19, s * 0.06, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   338	    c.restore();
   339	    if (f.belly < 0.25) {
   340	      G.text('!', f.x, f.y - s * 1.6, 14, 'rgba(255,220,120,' + (0.5 + Math.sin(T.t * 6) * 0.4).toFixed(2) + ')', 'center');
   341	    }
   342	  }
   343	
   344	  T.draw = function (interactive) {
   345	    var c = G.ctx, r = T.rect;
   346	    c.save();
   347	    G.rr(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 14); c.clip();
   348	    var g = c.createLinearGradient(0, r.y, 0, r.y + r.h);
   349	    g.addColorStop(0, '#0d5f80'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#0a4260'); g.addColorStop(1, '#07293f');
   350	    c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
   351	    // caustics
   352	    c.globalAlpha = 0.09; c.strokeStyle = '#bff0ff'; c.lineWidth = 6;
   353	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   354	      c.beginPath();
   355	      for (var x = 0; x <= r.w; x += 18) {
   356	        var y = r.y + 24 + i * 30 + Math.sin((x * 0.03) + T.t * 0.8 + i) * 9;
   357	        if (x === 0) c.moveTo(r.x + x, y); else c.lineTo(r.x + x, y);
   358	      }
   359	      c.stroke();
   360	    }
   361	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
   362	    // sand
   363	    c.fillStyle = '#d8bd88';
   364	    c.beginPath();
   365	    c.moveTo(r.x, r.y + r.h);
   366	    c.lineTo(r.x, r.y + r.h - 22);
   367	    for (var sx = 0; sx <= r.w; sx += 24) c.lineTo(r.x + sx, r.y + r.h - 22 + Math.sin(sx * 0.05) * 5);
   368	    c.lineTo(r.x + r.w, r.y + r.h);
   369	    c.closePath(); c.fill();
   370	
   371	    for (i = 0; i < T.decor.length; i++) drawDecor(T.decor[i], T.drag === T.decor[i]);
   372	    for (i = 0; i < T.food.length; i++) {
   373	      var fd = T.food[i];
   374	      c.fillStyle = '#ffdf9a';
   375	      c.beginPath(); c.arc(fd.x, fd.y, 2.6, 0, 6.283); c.fill();
   376	    }
   377	    for (i = 0; i < T.fish.length; i++) drawFish(T.fish[i]);
   378	    for (i = 0; i < T.bub.length; i++) {
   379	      var b = T.bub[i];
   380	      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,240,255,0.55)'; c.lineWidth = 1.2;
   381	      c.beginPath(); c.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, 6.283); c.stroke();
   382	    }
   383	    // glass

   390	  function hitDecor(x, y) {
   391	    var r = T.rect;
   392	    for (var i = T.decor.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   393	      var d = T.decor[i], def = DECOR[d.k];
   394	      if (!def) continue;
   395	      var dx = r.x + d.x * r.w, dy = r.y + d.y * r.h, h = def.h[d.v];
   396	      if (x > dx - 40 && x < dx + 40 && y > dy - h - 6 && y < dy + 14) return d;
   397	    }
   398	    return null;
   399	  }
   400	  T.down = function (rec) {
   401	    var r = T.rect;
   402	    if (rec.x < r.x || rec.x > r.x + r.w || rec.y < r.y || rec.y > r.y + r.h) return;
   403	    if (T.dragId === -1) {

   408	        return;

   412	  };
   413	  T.move = function (rec) {
   414	    if (rec.id === T.dragId && T.drag) {
   415	      var r = T.rect;
   416	      T.drag.x = G.clamp((rec.x - r.x) / r.w, 0.06, 0.94);
   417	      T.drag.y = G.clamp((rec.y - r.y) / r.h, 0.42, 0.97);
   418	    }
   419	  };

   422	      T.dragId = -1; T.drag = null;
   423	      G.saveGame();
   424	      return;
   425	    }
   426	    if (rec.tank) {

   428	      if (moved < 14) T.dropFood(rec.x, rec.y);
   429	    }
   430	  };
   431	  T.cancel = function (rec) {
   432	    if (rec.id === T.dragId) { T.dragId = -1; T.drag = null; }
   433	    rec.tank = false;
   434	  };
   435	  T.resetInput = function () { T.dragId = -1; T.drag = null; };

   442	    c.restore();

   446	    return {

   449	      decor: T.decor.slice(0, MAXD).map(function (d) { return [d.k, d.v, +d.x.toFixed(3), +d.y.toFixed(3)]; })
   450	    };

   452	  T.load = function (o) {

   454	    T.fed = G.num(o && o.fed, 0.35, 0, 1);

   462	    }
   463	    var dl = (o && Array.isArray(o.decor)) ? o.decor : [];

   468	      var v = G.int(d[1], 0, 0, 1);

   470	      T.addDecor(k, v, G.num(d[2], 0.5, 0.06, 0.94), G.num(d[3], 0.9, 0.42, 0.97));
   471	    }

   194	  function applyClear() {
   195	    var set = B.clearing;

   197	      var r = (k / COLS) | 0, c = k % COLS;

   207	    // gravity
   208	    for (var c2 = 0; c2 < COLS; c2++) {
   209	      var write = ROWS - 1;
   210	      for (var r2 = ROWS - 1; r2 >= 0; r2--) {
   211	        var cell2 = B.grid[r2][c2];
   212	        if (cell2) {
   213	          if (write !== r2) {
   214	            B.grid[write][c2] = cell2;

   218	          write--;
   219	        }
   220	      }

   224	        nc.oy = -(spawn++) * B.geo.cs - 8;

   226	      }
   227	    }
   228	    B.phase = 'fall'; B.ph = 0;

   231	  function trySwap(r, c, r2, c2) {
   232	    if (B.phase !== 'idle' || B.over) return;
   233	    if (r2 < 0 || r2 >= ROWS || c2 < 0 || c2 >= COLS) return;
   234	    B.swapA = { r: r, c: c }; B.swapB = { r: r2, c: c2 };
   235	    var a = B.grid[r][c], b = B.grid[r2][c2];
   236	    B.grid[r][c] = b; B.grid[r2][c2] = a;
   237	    var cs = B.geo.cs;
   238	    b.ox = (c2 - c) * cs; b.oy = (r2 - r) * cs;
   239	    a.ox = (c - c2) * cs; a.oy = (r - r2) * cs;
   240	    B.phase = 'swap'; B.ph = 0;
   241	    B.sel = null;
   242	    G.audio.sfx('swap');
   243	  }

   245	  function undoSwap() {
   246	    var A = B.swapA, Bb = B.swapB;
   247	    var a = B.grid[A.r][A.c], b = B.grid[Bb.r][Bb.c];
   248	    B.grid[A.r][A.c] = b; B.grid[Bb.r][Bb.c] = a;
   249	    var cs = B.geo.cs;
   250	    b.ox = (Bb.c - A.c) * cs; b.oy = (Bb.r - A.r) * cs;
   251	    a.ox = (A.c - Bb.c) * cs; a.oy = (A.r - Bb.r) * cs;
   252	    B.phase = 'back'; B.ph = 0;
   253	    G.audio.sfx('bad');
   254	  }

   289	  B.update = function (dt) {
   290	    if (!B.cfg) return;
   291	    B.flash = Math.max(0, B.flash - dt * 2.2);
   292	    var mul = Math.pow(1e-9, dt);
   293	    var still = true;
   294	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   295	      var cell = B.grid[r][c];
   296	      if (!cell) continue;
   297	      cell.ox *= mul; cell.oy *= mul;
   298	      if (Math.abs(cell.ox) < 0.6) cell.ox = 0;
   299	      if (Math.abs(cell.oy) < 0.6) cell.oy = 0;
   300	      if (cell.ox || cell.oy) still = false;
   301	      cell.sc += (1 - cell.sc) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
   302	      if (cell.pop > 0) cell.pop = Math.min(1, cell.pop + dt * 7);
   303	    }
   304	    B.ph += dt;
   305	
   306	    if (B.phase === 'swap') {
   307	      if (still || B.ph > 0.32) {
   308	        var origin = B.swapB;
   309	        if (!resolve(origin)) {
   310	          undoSwap();
   311	        } else {
   312	          B.moves--;
   313	        }
   314	      }
   315	    } else if (B.phase === 'back') {
   316	      if (still || B.ph > 0.32) { B.phase = 'idle'; B.swapA = B.swapB = null; }
   317	    } else if (B.phase === 'clear') {
   318	      if (B.ph > 0.16) applyClear();
   319	    } else if (B.phase === 'fall') {
   320	      if (still || B.ph > 0.9) {
   321	        if (!resolve(null)) {
   322	          B.phase = 'idle'; B.chain = 0; B.swapA = B.swapB = null;
   323	          var guard = 0;
   324	          while (!hasMove() && guard++ < 20) shuffle();
   325	          B.checkEnd();
   326	        }
   327	      }
   328	    }
   329	  };

   353	  function gemPath(x, y, s, t) {

   455	  /* ---- input ---- */
   456	  function cellAt(x, y) {
   457	    var L = B.geo;
   458	    var c = Math.floor((x - L.x) / L.cs), r = Math.floor((y - L.y) / L.cs);
   459	    if (r < 0 || r >= ROWS || c < 0 || c >= COLS) return null;

   462	  B.down = function (rec) {
   463	    if (B.over || B.phase !== 'idle') return;
   464	    var cl = cellAt(rec.x, rec.y);
   465	    if (!cl) return;
   466	    B.dragId = rec.id;
   467	    rec.cell = cl;
   468	    B.sel = cl;
   469	    G.keyMode = false;
   470	  };
   471	  B.move = function (rec) {
   472	    if (rec.id !== B.dragId || !rec.cell || B.phase !== 'idle' || B.over) return;
   473	    var dx = rec.x - rec.sx, dy = rec.y - rec.sy;
   474	    var th = B.geo.cs * 0.4;
   475	    if (Math.abs(dx) < th && Math.abs(dy) < th) return;
   476	    var a = rec.cell;
   477	    var r2 = a.r, c2 = a.c;
   478	    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) c2 += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else r2 += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   479	    B.dragId = -1; rec.cell = null;
   480	    trySwap(a.r, a.c, r2, c2);
   481	  };
   482	  B.up = function (rec) {
   483	    if (rec.id === B.dragId) B.dragId = -1;
   484	    if (!rec.cell) { B.sel = null; return; }
   485	    // tap-tap swap fallback
   486	    var cl = cellAt(rec.x, rec.y);
   487	    rec.cell = null;
   488	    if (!cl) { B.sel = null; return; }
   489	    if (B.tapSel && B.tapSel.r === cl.r && B.tapSel.c === cl.c) {
   490	      B.tapSel = null; B.sel = null;
   491	    } else if (B.tapSel && (Math.abs(B.tapSel.r - cl.r) + Math.abs(B.tapSel.c - cl.c)) === 1) {
   492	      var s = B.tapSel; B.tapSel = null; B.sel = null;
   493	      trySwap(s.r, s.c, cl.r, cl.c);
   494	    } else {
   495	      B.tapSel = cl; B.sel = cl;
   496	    }
   497	  };
   498	  B.cancel = function (rec) {
   499	    if (rec.id === B.dragId) B.dragId = -1;
   500	    rec.cell = null;
   501	    B.sel = B.tapSel || null;
   502	  };
   503	  B.resetInput = function () { B.dragId = -1; B.sel = null; B.tapSel = null; };
   504	
   505	  B.key = function (k) {
   506	    if (B.over) return false;
   507	    var cur = B.cur;
   508	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown') {
   509	      var dr = k === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : k === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : 0;
   510	      var dc = k === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : k === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : 0;
   511	      if (B.sel) {
   512	        var s = B.sel; B.sel = null; B.tapSel = null;
   513	        trySwap(s.r, s.c, s.r + dr, s.c + dc);
   514	        B.cur = { r: G.clamp(s.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1), c: G.clamp(s.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1) };
   515	      } else {
   516	        cur.r = G.clamp(cur.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   517	        cur.c = G.clamp(cur.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   518	      }
   519	      return true;
   520	    }
   521	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   522	      if (B.phase !== 'idle') return true;
   523	      B.sel = B.sel ? null : { r: cur.r, c: cur.c };
   524	      B.tapSel = B.sel;
   525	      G.audio.sfx('tap');
   526	      return true;
   527	    }
   528	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { G.startLevel(B.cfg.idx); return true; }
   529	    return false;
   530	  };

    29	            bad = false;
    30	            var a = this.at(c - 1, r), b = this.at(c - 2, r);
    31	            if (a && b && a.t === t && b.t === t) bad = true;
    32	            var d = this.at(c, r - 1), e = this.at(c, r - 2);
    33	            if (d && e && d.t === t && e.t === t) bad = true;
    34	          } while (bad && ++guard < 24);
    35	          this.g[this.i(c, r)] = this.mk(t);
    36	        }
    37	      }
    38	      tries++;
    39	    } while (!this.hasMove() && tries < 20);
    40	  };
    41	
    42	  /* find all match runs; returns {clear:[idx], spawns:[{i,sp}]} */
    43	  Board.prototype.findMatches = function (prefer) {
    44	    var clearMap = {}, spawns = [], runsH = [], runsV = [], c, r, i;
    45	    for (r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
    46	      var run = 1;
    47	      for (c = 1; c <= this.cols; c++) {
    48	        var cur = c < this.cols ? this.g[this.i(c, r)] : null;
    49	        var prev = this.g[this.i(c - 1, r)];
    50	        if (cur && prev && !cur.dead && !prev.dead && cur.t === prev.t) run++;
    51	        else {
    52	          if (run >= 3) runsH.push({ c: c - run, r: r, len: run, t: prev.t, h: 1 });
    53	          run = 1;
    54	        }
    55	      }
    56	    }
    57	    for (c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
    58	      var run2 = 1;
    59	      for (r = 1; r <= this.rows; r++) {
    60	        var cur2 = r < this.rows ? this.g[this.i(c, r)] : null;
    61	        var prev2 = this.g[this.i(c, r - 1)];
    62	        if (cur2 && prev2 && !cur2.dead && !prev2.dead && cur2.t === prev2.t) run2++;
    63	        else {
    64	          if (run2 >= 3) runsV.push({ c: c, r: r - run2, len: run2, t: prev2.t, h: 0 });
    65	          run2 = 1;
    66	        }
    67	      }
    68	    }
    69	    if (!runsH.length && !runsV.length) return null;
    70	
    71	    var all = runsH.concat(runsV);
    72	    var cellRuns = {};
    73	    for (var k = 0; k < all.length; k++) {
    74	      var R = all[k];
    75	      for (var j = 0; j < R.len; j++) {
    76	        var cc = R.h ? R.c + j : R.c, rr = R.h ? R.r : R.r + j;
    77	        i = this.i(cc, rr);
    78	        clearMap[i] = true;
    79	        (cellRuns[i] || (cellRuns[i] = [])).push(k);
    80	      }
    81	    }
    82	    /* spawn specials */
    83	    var used = {};
    84	    for (var k2 = 0; k2 < all.length; k2++) {
    85	      var Rn = all[k2];
    86	      if (used[k2]) continue;
    87	      var idxs = [];
    88	      for (var j2 = 0; j2 < Rn.len; j2++) {
    89	        idxs.push(this.i(Rn.h ? Rn.c + j2 : Rn.c, Rn.h ? Rn.r : Rn.r + j2));
    90	      }
    91	      /* intersection -> bomb */
    92	      var cross = -1, crossRun = -1;
    93	      for (var q = 0; q < idxs.length; q++) {
    94	        var cr = cellRuns[idxs[q]];
    95	        if (cr && cr.length > 1) {
    96	          for (var z = 0; z < cr.length; z++) if (cr[z] !== k2 && !used[cr[z]]) { cross = idxs[q]; crossRun = cr[z]; break; }
    97	          if (cross >= 0) break;
    98	        }
    99	      }
   100	      var pivot = -1;
   101	      if (prefer != null && idxs.indexOf(prefer) >= 0) pivot = prefer;
   102	      if (cross >= 0) {
   103	        used[k2] = 1; used[crossRun] = 1;
   104	        spawns.push({ i: pivot >= 0 ? pivot : cross, sp: SP_BOMB, t: Rn.t });
   105	      } else if (Rn.len >= 5) {
   106	        used[k2] = 1;
   107	        spawns.push({ i: pivot >= 0 ? pivot : idxs[(Rn.len / 2) | 0], sp: SP_PRISM, t: Rn.t });
   108	      } else if (Rn.len === 4) {
   109	        used[k2] = 1;
   110	        spawns.push({ i: pivot >= 0 ? pivot : idxs[1], sp: Rn.h ? SP_COL : SP_ROW, t: Rn.t });
   111	      }
   112	    }
   113	    var clear = [];
   114	    for (var key in clearMap) clear.push(key | 0);
   115	    if (clear.length > this.cols * this.rows) clear.length = this.cols * this.rows;
   116	    return { clear: clear, spawns: spawns };
   117	  };
   118	
   119	  /* expand clear list with special effects; returns expanded array */
   120	  Board.prototype.expandSpecials = function (clear, protectIdx) {
   121	    var set = {}, i;
   122	    for (i = 0; i < clear.length; i++) set[clear[i]] = true;
   123	    var queue = clear.slice(0), rounds = 0, triggered = false;
   124	    while (queue.length && rounds < 400) {
   125	      rounds++;
   126	      var idx = queue.pop();
   127	      var cell = this.g[idx];
   128	      if (!cell || cell.sp === SP_NONE) continue;
   129	      if (protectIdx && protectIdx[idx]) continue;
   130	      var sp = cell.sp; cell.sp = SP_NONE;
   131	      triggered = true;
   132	      var c = idx % this.cols, r = (idx / this.cols) | 0, k;
   133	      var add = [];
   134	      if (sp === SP_ROW) { for (k = 0; k < this.cols; k++) add.push(this.i(k, r)); }
   135	      else if (sp === SP_COL) { for (k = 0; k < this.rows; k++) add.push(this.i(c, k)); }
   136	      else if (sp === SP_BOMB) {
   137	        for (var dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) for (var dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
   138	          if (this.at(c + dc, r + dr)) add.push(this.i(c + dc, r + dr));
   139	        }
   140	      } else if (sp === SP_PRISM) {
   141	        var tt = cell.t;
   142	        for (k = 0; k < this.g.length; k++) if (this.g[k] && this.g[k].t === tt) add.push(k);
   143	      }
   144	      for (k = 0; k < add.length; k++) {
   145	        if (!set[add[k]] && this.g[add[k]]) { set[add[k]] = true; queue.push(add[k]); }
   146	      }
   147	    }
   148	    var out = [];
   149	    for (var key in set) out.push(key | 0);
   150	    return { list: out, triggered: triggered };
   151	  };
   152	
   153	  /* remove cells, compute falls. returns array of {idx, fromRows} for animation */
   154	  Board.prototype.collapse = function () {
   155	    var moves = [];
   156	    for (var c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
   157	      var write = this.rows - 1;
   158	      for (var r = this.rows - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
   159	        var cell = this.g[this.i(c, r)];
   160	        if (cell && !cell.dead) {
   161	          if (write !== r) {
   162	            this.g[this.i(c, write)] = cell;
   163	            this.g[this.i(c, r)] = null;
   164	            cell.off = (write - r);
   165	            moves.push(cell);
   166	          }
   167	          write--;
   168	        } else {
   169	          this.g[this.i(c, r)] = null;
   170	        }
   171	      }
   172	      var spawnCount = write + 1;
   173	      for (var w = write; w >= 0; w--) {
   174	        var nc = this.mk((this.rand() * this.n) | 0);
   175	        nc.off = spawnCount;
   176	        this.g[this.i(c, w)] = nc;
   177	        moves.push(nc);
   178	      }
   179	    }
   180	    return moves;
   181	  };
   182	
   183	  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
   184	    var c, r;
   185	    for (r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
   186	      for (c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
   187	        if (c + 1 < this.cols && this.testSwap(c, r, c + 1, r)) return true;
   188	        if (r + 1 < this.rows && this.testSwap(c, r, c, r + 1)) return true;
   189	      }
   190	    }
   191	    return false;
   192	  };
   193	  Board.prototype.swapCells = function (c1, r1, c2, r2) {
   194	    var i1 = this.i(c1, r1), i2 = this.i(c2, r2);
   195	    var t = this.g[i1]; this.g[i1] = this.g[i2]; this.g[i2] = t;
   196	  };
   197	  Board.prototype.testSwap = function (c1, r1, c2, r2) {
   198	    var a = this.at(c1, r1), b = this.at(c2, r2);
   199	    if (!a || !b) return false;
   200	    if (a.sp === SP_PRISM || b.sp === SP_PRISM) return true;
   201	    this.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   202	    var m = this.findMatches();
   203	    this.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   204	    return !!m;
   205	  };
   206	  Board.prototype.shuffle = function () {
   207	    var types = [];
   208	    for (var i = 0; i < this.g.length; i++) types.push(this.g[i].t);
   209	    var tries = 0;
   210	    do {
   211	      for (var k = types.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
   212	        var j = (this.rand() * (k + 1)) | 0, tmp = types[k]; types[k] = types[j]; types[j] = tmp;
   213	      }
   214	      for (var m = 0; m < this.g.length; m++) this.g[m].t = types[m];
   215	      tries++;
   216	    } while ((this.findMatches() || !this.hasMove()) && tries < 60);
   217	  };
   218	
   219	  T.Board = Board;
   220	})(TT);

   344	  /* ---- scene ---- */
   345	  function drawScene(ctx, state, time, w, h) {
   346	    var built = state.lvl; /* number of slots funded */
   347	    var night = state.night; /* 0..1, 1 = deep night */
   348	    var sky1 = T.mixHex('#8fc6e8', '#141d33', night);
   349	    var sky2 = T.mixHex('#dfeef6', '#2b3350', night);
   350	    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 84, 0, 520);
   351	    g.addColorStop(0, sky1); g.addColorStop(1, sky2);
   352	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 84, w, 440);
   353	
   354	    /* sun / moon */
   355	    var ang = state.dayT * Math.PI * 2;
   356	    var sx = w / 2 + Math.cos(ang - Math.PI / 2) * 150, sy = 300 + Math.sin(ang - Math.PI / 2) * 150;
   357	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
   358	    ctx.fillStyle = night > 0.5 ? '#e9eef7' : '#ffe27a';
   359	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, night > 0.5 ? 11 : 15, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   360	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   361	    if (night > 0.55) {
   362	      for (var st = 0; st < 22; st++) {
   363	        var rx = ((st * 97) % 380) + 5, ry = 92 + ((st * 53) % 130);
   364	        ctx.globalAlpha = (night - 0.55) * 2 * (0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 1.2 + st)));
   365	        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillRect(rx, ry, 2, 2);
   366	      }
   367	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   368	    }
   369	
   370	    /* distant hills */
   371	    ctx.fillStyle = T.mixHex('#7fa9b8', '#1a2438', night);
   372	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 500);
   373	    for (var i = 0; i <= 10; i++) ctx.lineTo(i * 39, 470 - Math.sin(i * 1.3) * 26 - (i % 3) * 8);
   374	    ctx.lineTo(w, 520); ctx.lineTo(0, 520); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   375	
   376	    /* hill body */
   377	    ctx.fillStyle = T.mixHex('#6d7a52', '#232c22', night);
   378	    ctx.beginPath();
   379	    ctx.moveTo(-10, 620);
   380	    ctx.lineTo(-10, 500); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(90, 300, 197, 140);
   381	    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(300, 300, 400, 500); ctx.lineTo(400, 620);
   382	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   383	
   384	    /* terraces back to front */
   385	    for (var ti = 3; ti >= 0; ti--) {
   386	      var tr = TERRACES[ti];
   387	      var slotIdx = [], si;
   388	      for (si = 0; si < SLOTS.length; si++) if (SLOTS[si].tr === ti) slotIdx.push(si);
   389	      var doneCount = 0;
   390	      for (si = 0; si < slotIdx.length; si++) if (slotIdx[si] < built) doneCount++;
   391	      var lively = doneCount / slotIdx.length;
   392	
   393	      /* terrace face (wall) */
   394	      var faceTop = tr.y, faceH = tr.h;
   395	      ctx.fillStyle = T.mixHex(T.mixHex('#6a6355', '#8b8471', lively), '#1e232a', night);
   396	      ctx.fillRect(tr.x0 - 6, faceTop, (tr.x1 - tr.x0) + 12, faceH);
   397	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.16)';
   398	      for (var b = 0; b < 4; b++) ctx.fillRect(tr.x0 - 6, faceTop + 6 + b * 11, (tr.x1 - tr.x0) + 12, 1.5);
   399	      /* terrace top surface */
   400	      ctx.fillStyle = T.mixHex(T.mixHex('#5b5a42', '#6e8a4e', lively), '#1f2a26', night);
   401	      ctx.beginPath();
   402	      ctx.moveTo(tr.x0 - 6, faceTop); ctx.lineTo(tr.x1 + 6, faceTop);
   403	      ctx.lineTo(tr.x1 + 16, faceTop - 12); ctx.lineTo(tr.x0 - 16, faceTop - 12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   404	
   405	      /* slot contents */
   406	      for (si = 0; si < slotIdx.length; si++) {
   407	        var id = slotIdx[si], s = SLOTS[id];
   408	        if (id < built) {
   409	          var v = state.choices[id] === 1 ? 1 : 0;
   410	          ctx.save();
   411	          var age = state.justBuilt === id ? T.clamp((time - state.justBuiltAt) / 0.5, 0, 1) : 1;
   412	          if (age < 1) { ctx.globalAlpha = age; ctx.translate(s.x, s.y); ctx.scale(0.6 + 0.4 * age, 0.6 + 0.4 * age); ctx.translate(-s.x, -s.y); }
   413	          DRAW[id](ctx, s.x, s.y, v, time, night > 0.5);
   414	          ctx.restore();
   415	        } else {
   416	          /* unbuilt: faint marker */
   417	          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
   418	          ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
   419	          T.rr(ctx, s.x - 16, s.y - 26, 32, 26, 4); ctx.stroke();
   420	          ctx.setLineDash([]);
   421	        }
   422	      }
   423	    }
   424	    /* foreground */
   425	    ctx.fillStyle = T.mixHex('#3f4a33', '#141a18', night);
   426	    ctx.fillRect(0, 520, w, 90);
   427	
   428	    /* night tint over restored scene */
   429	    if (night > 0.02) {
   430	      ctx.globalAlpha = night * 0.38;
   431	      ctx.fillStyle = '#101a30';
   432	      ctx.fillRect(0, 84, w, 526);
   433	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   434	    }
   435	  }

   440	  };

     1	/* Terrace Tales - main loop, screens, input */
     2	(function (T) {
     3	  'use strict';

    28	  var pointers = Object.create(null);

    33	  function resetInput() {
    34	    for (var k in pointers) delete pointers[k];
    35	    for (var k2 in keys) delete keys[k2];
    36	    buttons.length = 0;
    37	    focusIdx = -1;
    38	    sel = null;
    39	    T.clearTimers();
    40	  }
    41	
    42	  /* ---------- canvas fit ---------- */
    43	  function fit() {
    44	    var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
    45	    var s = Math.min(vw / W, vh / H);
    46	    var cw = Math.max(1, Math.round(W * s)), ch = Math.max(1, Math.round(H * s));
    47	    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    48	    if (ch * dpr > 960) dpr = 960 / ch;
    49	    var bw = Math.max(1, Math.round(cw * dpr)), bh = Math.max(1, Math.round(ch * dpr));
    50	    cv.style.width = cw + 'px'; cv.style.height = ch + 'px';
    51	    if (cv.width !== bw || cv.height !== bh) { cv.width = bw; cv.height = bh; }
    52	    ctx.setTransform(bw / W, 0, 0, bh / H, 0, 0);
    53	    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    54	    checkRotate();
    55	  }
    56	  function checkRotate() {
    57	    var land = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight && window.innerHeight < 520;
    58	    if (land) { rotEl.style.display = 'flex'; paused = true; }
    59	    else { rotEl.style.display = 'none'; if (paused && !document.hidden) { paused = false; last = 0; } }
    60	  }
    61	  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
    62	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { T.later(fit, 60); });
    63	  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
    64	    if (document.hidden) { paused = true; resetInput(); }
    65	    else { checkRotate(); last = 0; }
    66	  });
    67	  window.addEventListener('blur', function () { resetInput(); });

    70	  function toLocal(e) {

    74	  function btn(x, y, w, h, label, fn, style) {

    84	  function say(m) { toast = m; toastT = 1.8; }

    87	  function startLevel(n) {
    88	    resetInput();
    89	    lvlIdx = T.clamp(n, 0, 14);
    90	    var d = G.LEVELS[lvlIdx];
    91	    board = new T.Board(COLS, ROWS, d.n, d.seed);
    92	    moves = d.moves; score = 0; cascade = 0;
    93	    goals = [];
    94	    for (var i = 0; i < d.goals.length; i++) goals.push({ t: d.goals[i][0], need: d.goals[i][1], got: 0 });
    95	    phase = 'idle'; animT = 0; animDur = 0; result = null; lastSwap = null;
    96	    cursor = { c: 3, r: 4 }; sel = null;

   101	  function goGarden() {

   106	  function setAnim(dur) { animT = 0; animDur = dur; }
   107	
   108	  function tryMove(c1, r1, c2, r2) {
   109	    if (phase !== 'idle' || !board || result) return;
   110	    if (c2 < 0 || r2 < 0 || c2 >= COLS || r2 >= ROWS) return;
   111	    var i1 = board.i(c1, r1), i2 = board.i(c2, r2);
   112	    board.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   113	    var m = board.findMatches(i2);
   114	    if (!m) {
   115	      var m2 = board.findMatches(i1);
   116	      if (!m2) {
   117	        /* invalid: revert and bounce */
   118	        board.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   119	        var a = board.g[i1], b = board.g[i2];
   120	        a.ax0 = (c2 - c1) * CELL * 0.32; a.ay0 = (r2 - r1) * CELL * 0.32;
   121	        b.ax0 = (c1 - c2) * CELL * 0.32; b.ay0 = (r1 - r2) * CELL * 0.32;
   122	        phase = 'bad'; setAnim(0.18);
   123	        T.sfx.bad();
   124	        sel = null;
   125	        return;
   126	      }
   127	    }
   128	    /* valid swap */
   129	    board.g[i2].ax0 = (c1 - c2) * CELL; board.g[i2].ay0 = (r1 - r2) * CELL;
   130	    board.g[i1].ax0 = (c2 - c1) * CELL; board.g[i1].ay0 = (r2 - r1) * CELL;
   131	    lastSwap = i2;
   132	    moves--;
   133	    cascade = 0;
   134	    phase = 'swap'; setAnim(0.13);
   135	    T.sfx.swap();
   136	    sel = null;
   137	  }
   138	
   139	  function resolveClear(prefer) {
   140	    var m = board.findMatches(prefer);
   141	    if (!m) return false;
   142	    var exp = board.expandSpecials(m.clear);
   143	    var list = exp.list;
   144	    var spawnAt = Object.create(null), i;
   145	    for (i = 0; i < m.spawns.length; i++) spawnAt[m.spawns[i].i] = m.spawns[i];
   146	    cascade++;
   147	    var gained = 0, cleared = 0;
   148	    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
   149	      var idx = list[i], cell = board.g[idx];
   150	      if (!cell) continue;
   151	      if (spawnAt[idx]) { cell.sp = spawnAt[idx].sp; cell.glow = 1; delete spawnAt[idx]; continue; }
   152	      cell.dead = true; cell.pop = 1;
   153	      cleared++;
   154	      gained += 12 * Math.min(6, cascade);
   155	      for (var q = 0; q < goals.length; q++) if (goals[q].t === cell.t) goals[q].got++;
   156	      var cx = BX + (idx % COLS) * CELL + CELL / 2, cy = BY + ((idx / COLS) | 0) * CELL + CELL / 2;
   157	      if (T.fx.list.length < 180) T.fx.burst(cx, cy, G.GEMS[cell.t].c, 5, 100);
   158	    }
   159	    /* any spawn that survived (not in list) still becomes special */
   160	    for (var key in spawnAt) {
   161	      var sc = board.g[key | 0]; if (sc) { sc.sp = spawnAt[key].sp; sc.glow = 1; }
   162	    }
   163	    score += gained;
   164	    if (cleared) {
   165	      T.sfx.match(cascade);
   166	      if (exp.triggered) { T.sfx.special(); shake = Math.min(10, shake + 6); }
   167	      else shake = Math.min(8, shake + 1.5 + cleared * 0.15);
   168	      if (cascade > 1) {
   169	        T.addFloat(W / 2, BY + 120, 'x' + Math.min(6, cascade) + ' cascade', '#ffe08a');
   170	      }
   171	      flash = Math.min(0.4, flash + 0.12); flashCol = '#ffffff';
   172	    }
   173	    phase = 'clear'; setAnim(0.17);
   174	    return true;
   175	  }
   176	
   177	  function afterSettle() {
   178	    /* win / fail checks */
   179	    var won = true;
   180	    for (var i = 0; i < goals.length; i++) if (goals[i].got < goals[i].need) won = false;
   181	    if (won) {
   182	      result = 'win';
   183	      score += moves * 30;
   184	      var key = String(lvlIdx);
   185	      if (!(typeof st.best[key] === 'number') || score > st.best[key]) { st.best[key] = score; }
   186	      T.store.save(st);
   187	      T.sfx.win();
   188	      for (var p = 0; p < 5; p++) T.fx.burst(40 + p * 78, BY + 160, '#ffe08a', 12, 150);
   189	      resetInput();
   190	      return;
   191	    }
   192	    if (moves <= 0) {
   193	      result = 'fail'; T.sfx.fail(); shake = 10; resetInput(); return;
   194	    }
   195	    if (!board.hasMove()) { board.shuffle(); say('No moves left - the beds were turned over.'); T.sfx.special(); }
   196	  }
   197	
   198	  function updateBoard(dt) {
   199	    if (!board || result) return;
   200	    if (phase === 'idle') return;
   201	    animT += dt;
   202	    var done = animT >= animDur;
   203	    if (!done) return;
   204	    animT = 0;
   205	    var i;
   206	    if (phase === 'bad') {
   207	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) { board.g[i].ax0 = 0; board.g[i].ay0 = 0; }
   208	      phase = 'idle'; return;
   209	    }
   210	    if (phase === 'swap') {
   211	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) { board.g[i].ax0 = 0; board.g[i].ay0 = 0; }
   212	      if (!resolveClear(lastSwap)) { phase = 'idle'; afterSettle(); }
   213	      return;
   214	    }
   215	    if (phase === 'clear') {
   216	      var moved = board.collapse();
   217	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) {
   218	        var c = board.g[i];
   219	        if (!c) continue;
   220	        c.pop = 0; c.dead = false;
   221	        if (c.off) { c.ay0 = -c.off * CELL; c.off = 0; } else { c.ay0 = 0; }
   222	        c.ax0 = 0;
   223	      }
   224	      phase = 'fall'; setAnim(0.20);
   225	      return;
   226	    }
   227	    if (phase === 'fall') {
   228	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) { board.g[i].ay0 = 0; board.g[i].ax0 = 0; }
   229	      if (!resolveClear(null)) { phase = 'idle'; afterSettle(); }
   230	      return;
   231	    }
   232	  }

   234	  /* ---------- gem drawing ---------- */
   235	  function drawGem(x, y, s, t, sp, glow) {
   236	    var col = G.GEMS[t] ? G.GEMS[t].c : '#888';
   237	    ctx.save();
   238	    ctx.translate(x, y);
   239	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   240	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   241	    var k;
   242	    if (t === 0) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.44, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   243	    else if (t === 1) {
   244	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.5); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 0.5, 0, 0, s * 0.5);
   245	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-s * 0.5, 0, 0, -s * 0.5); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   246	    } else if (t === 2) {
   247	      ctx.beginPath();
   248	      for (k = 0; k < 6; k++) { var a = k * 1.0472 - 0.5236; var px2 = Math.cos(a) * s * 0.46, py2 = Math.sin(a) * s * 0.46; if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(px2, py2); else ctx.lineTo(px2, py2); }
   249	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   250	    } else if (t === 3) { T.rr(ctx, -s * 0.4, -s * 0.4, s * 0.8, s * 0.8, 5); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   251	    else if (t === 4) {
   252	      for (k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
   253	        var an = k * 1.2566 - 1.5708;
   254	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(Math.cos(an) * s * 0.26, Math.sin(an) * s * 0.26, s * 0.2, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   255	      }
   256	      ctx.fillStyle = '#f6e6a8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.15, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   257	    } else {
   258	      ctx.beginPath();
   259	      for (k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
   260	        var ang2 = k * 0.6283 - 1.5708, rr = (k % 2 ? s * 0.2 : s * 0.48);
   261	        var xx = Math.cos(ang2) * rr, yy = Math.sin(ang2) * rr;
   262	        if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(xx, yy); else ctx.lineTo(xx, yy);
   263	      }
   264	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   265	    }
   266	    /* highlight */
   267	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3; ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   268	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-s * 0.12, -s * 0.16, s * 0.14, s * 0.09, -0.6, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   269	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   270	    /* special marks */
   271	    if (sp === SP.ROW || sp === SP.COL) {
   272	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
   273	      ctx.beginPath();
   274	      if (sp === SP.ROW) { ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.45, 0); ctx.lineTo(s * 0.45, 0); }
   275	      else { ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.45); ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.45); }
   276	      ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   277	    } else if (sp === SP.BOMB) {
   278	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
   279	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.3, 0, 6.284); ctx.stroke();
   280	    } else if (sp === SP.PRISM) {
   281	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   282	      for (k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   283	        ctx.beginPath();
   284	        var a3 = k * 0.7854 + time;
   285	        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a3) * s * 0.42, Math.sin(a3) * s * 0.42);
   286	        ctx.lineTo(-Math.cos(a3) * s * 0.42, -Math.sin(a3) * s * 0.42);
   287	        ctx.stroke();
   288	      }
   289	    }
   290	    if (glow > 0) {
   291	      ctx.globalAlpha = glow * 0.8; ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   292	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.55, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   293	    }
   294	    ctx.restore();
   295	  }

   299	    ctx.fillStyle = col || 'rgba(18,26,33,0.92)';

   303	  function drawButtons() {
   304	    for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
   305	      var b = buttons[i], foc = i === focusIdx;
   306	      var base = b.style === 'ghost' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)' : (b.style === 'warn' ? '#8a4a3c' : '#3f7a52');

   314	      ctx.fillText(b.label, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2 + 1);
   315	    }
   316	    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   317	  }

   422	  function drawLevel() {
   423	    ctx.fillStyle = '#131a20'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   424	    ctx.save();
   425	    if (shake > 0.1) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
   426	
   427	    /* board frame */
   428	    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a232b';
   429	    T.rr(ctx, BX - 8, BY - 8, COLS * CELL + 16, ROWS * CELL + 16, 14); ctx.fill();
   430	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
   431	
   432	    var e = animDur > 0 ? T.clamp(animT / animDur, 0, 1) : 1;
   433	    var ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - e, 3);
   434	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   435	      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   436	        var cell = board.g[board.i(c, r)];
   437	        if (!cell) continue;
   438	        ctx.fillStyle = ((c + r) % 2) ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.025)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.10)';
   439	        ctx.fillRect(BX + c * CELL, BY + r * CELL, CELL, CELL);
   440	        var x = BX + c * CELL + CELL / 2 + (cell.ax0 || 0) * (1 - ease);
   441	        var y = BY + r * CELL + CELL / 2 + (cell.ay0 || 0) * (1 - ease);
   442	        var s = CELL - 8;
   443	        if (cell.dead) { s *= (1 - ease * 0.9); }
   444	        if (s > 1) drawGem(x, y, s, cell.t, cell.sp, cell.glow || 0);
   445	        if (cell.glow > 0) cell.glow = Math.max(0, cell.glow - 0.04);
   446	      }
   447	    }
   448	    /* cursor + selection */
   449	    if (sel) {
   450	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe08a'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   451	      T.rr(ctx, BX + sel.c * CELL + 3, BY + sel.r * CELL + 3, CELL - 6, CELL - 6, 8); ctx.stroke();
   452	    }
   453	    if (keyMode) {
   454	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   455	      T.rr(ctx, BX + cursor.c * CELL + 2, BY + cursor.r * CELL + 2, CELL - 4, CELL - 4, 8); ctx.stroke();
   456	    }
   457	    T.fx.draw(ctx);
   458	    T.drawFloats(ctx);
   459	    ctx.restore();
   460	
   461	    drawLevelHud();
   462	    /* hint / status line */
   463	    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   464	    ctx.font = '500 14px system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif';
   465	    ctx.fillStyle = '#93a8a0';
   466	    var line = toastT > 0 ? toast : (hintShown ? 'Swipe a gem into its neighbour to make a line of 3+.' : G.BEFORE[lvlIdx]);
   467	    var ls = T.wrap(ctx, line || ' ', W - 40);
   468	    if (ls[0]) ctx.fillText(ls[0], W / 2, 578);
   469	    if (ls[1]) ctx.fillText(ls[1], W / 2, 596);
   470	
   471	    buttons.length = 0;
   472	    if (result) {
   473	      drawResult();
   474	    } else {
   475	      btn(20, 614, 130, 52, 'Garden', function () { goGarden(); }, 'ghost');
   476	      btn(160, 614, 120, 52, 'Retry', function () { startLevel(lvlIdx); }, 'ghost');
   477	      btn(290, 614, 80, 52, T.audio.muted ? 'Mute' : 'Sound', function () { T.audio.toggle(); }, 'ghost');
   478	    }
   479	    drawButtons();
   480	
   481	    if (flash > 0.01) {
   482	      ctx.globalAlpha = flash; ctx.fillStyle = flashCol; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   483	    }
   484	  }

   583	    T.audio.unlock();

   595	  function onMove(e) {
   596	    var rec = pointers[e.pointerId];

   598	    var p = toLocal(e);
   599	    rec.x = p.x; rec.y = p.y;
   600	    if (rec.cell && !rec.used && screen === 'level' && phase === 'idle' && !result) {
   601	      var dx = p.x - rec.sx, dy = p.y - rec.sy;

   605	        var c2 = rec.cell.c, r2 = rec.cell.r;
   606	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) c2 += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else r2 += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   607	        tryMove(rec.cell.c, rec.cell.r, c2, r2);
   608	      }
   609	    }
   610	  }
   611	  function onUp(e) {
   612	    var rec = pointers[e.pointerId];
   613	    delete pointers[e.pointerId];
   614	    if (!rec || paused) return;
   615	    var p = toLocal(e);
   616	    if (rec.btn) {
   617	      if (p.x >= rec.btn.x && p.x <= rec.btn.x + rec.btn.w && p.y >= rec.btn.y && p.y <= rec.btn.y + rec.btn.h) {

   624	    if (rec.cell && !rec.used && screen === 'level' && phase === 'idle' && !result) {
   625	      keyMode = false;

   628	      else if (sel && sel.c === c && sel.r === r) { sel = null; T.sfx.tap(); }
   629	      else { sel = { c: c, r: r }; T.sfx.tap(); }
   630	    }

   673	    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowLeft') { focusIdx = (focusIdx - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length; T.sfx.tap(); return; }

   678	    }

   682	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });

   684	  /* ---------- loop ---------- */
   685	  var last = 0;
   686	  function frame(ts) {
   687	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   688	    if (!last) last = ts;
   689	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   690	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   691	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   692	    if (paused) { return; }
   693	
   694	    time += dt;
   695	    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 34);
   696	    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   697	    if (toastT > 0) toastT -= dt;
   698	    T.fx.update(dt);
   699	    T.updateFloats(dt);
   700	
   701	    if (screen === 'garden' || screen === 'end' || screen === 'choice' || screen === 'boot') {
   702	      st.dayT = (st.dayT + dt / 54) % 1;
   703	      st.night = (1 - Math.cos(st.dayT * 6.28318)) / 2;
   704	    }
   705	    if (screen === 'level') updateBoard(dt);
   706	
   707	    if (screen === 'boot') drawBoot();
   708	    else if (screen === 'garden') drawGarden();
   709	    else if (screen === 'level') drawLevel();
   710	    else if (screen === 'choice') drawChoice();
   711	    else drawEnd();
   712	  }
   713	
   714	  fit();
   715	  if (st.lvl >= 15) st.done = true;
   716	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   717	})(TT);

   183	  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
   184	    var c, r;
   185	    for (r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
   186	      for (c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
   187	        if (c + 1 < this.cols && this.testSwap(c, r, c + 1, r)) return true;
   188	        if (r + 1 < this.rows && this.testSwap(c, r, c, r + 1)) return true;
   189	      }
   190	    }
   191	    return false;
   192	  };
   193	  Board.prototype.swapCells = function (c1, r1, c2, r2) {
   194	    var i1 = this.i(c1, r1), i2 = this.i(c2, r2);
   195	    var t = this.g[i1]; this.g[i1] = this.g[i2]; this.g[i2] = t;
   196	  };
   197	  Board.prototype.testSwap = function (c1, r1, c2, r2) {
   198	    var a = this.at(c1, r1), b = this.at(c2, r2);
   199	    if (!a || !b) return false;
   200	    if (a.sp === SP_PRISM || b.sp === SP_PRISM) return true;
   201	    this.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   202	    var m = this.findMatches();
   203	    this.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   204	    return !!m;
   205	  };
   206	  Board.prototype.shuffle = function () {
   207	    var types = [];
   208	    for (var i = 0; i < this.g.length; i++) types.push(this.g[i].t);
   209	    var tries = 0;
   210	    do {
   211	      for (var k = types.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
   212	        var j = (this.rand() * (k + 1)) | 0, tmp = types[k]; types[k] = types[j]; types[j] = tmp;
   213	      }
   214	      for (var m = 0; m < this.g.length; m++) this.g[m].t = types[m];
   215	      tries++;
   216	    } while ((this.findMatches() || !this.hasMove()) && tries < 60);

   108	  function tryMove(c1, r1, c2, r2) {
   109	    if (phase !== 'idle' || !board || result) return;
   110	    if (c2 < 0 || r2 < 0 || c2 >= COLS || r2 >= ROWS) return;
   111	    var i1 = board.i(c1, r1), i2 = board.i(c2, r2);
   112	    board.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   113	    var m = board.findMatches(i2);
   114	    if (!m) {
   115	      var m2 = board.findMatches(i1);
   116	      if (!m2) {
   117	        /* invalid: revert and bounce */
   118	        board.swapCells(c1, r1, c2, r2);
   119	        var a = board.g[i1], b = board.g[i2];
   120	        a.ax0 = (c2 - c1) * CELL * 0.32; a.ay0 = (r2 - r1) * CELL * 0.32;
   121	        b.ax0 = (c1 - c2) * CELL * 0.32; b.ay0 = (r1 - r2) * CELL * 0.32;
   122	        phase = 'bad'; setAnim(0.18);
   123	        T.sfx.bad();
   124	        sel = null;
   125	        return;
   126	      }
   127	    }
   128	    /* valid swap */
   129	    board.g[i2].ax0 = (c1 - c2) * CELL; board.g[i2].ay0 = (r1 - r2) * CELL;
   130	    board.g[i1].ax0 = (c2 - c1) * CELL; board.g[i1].ay0 = (r2 - r1) * CELL;
   131	    lastSwap = i2;
   132	    moves--;

   139	  function resolveClear(prefer) {
   140	    var m = board.findMatches(prefer);
   141	    if (!m) return false;
   142	    var exp = board.expandSpecials(m.clear);
   143	    var list = exp.list;
   144	    var spawnAt = Object.create(null), i;
   145	    for (i = 0; i < m.spawns.length; i++) spawnAt[m.spawns[i].i] = m.spawns[i];
   146	    cascade++;
   147	    var gained = 0, cleared = 0;
   148	    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
   149	      var idx = list[i], cell = board.g[idx];
   150	      if (!cell) continue;
   151	      if (spawnAt[idx]) { cell.sp = spawnAt[idx].sp; cell.glow = 1; delete spawnAt[idx]; continue; }
   152	      cell.dead = true; cell.pop = 1;
   153	      cleared++;
   154	      gained += 12 * Math.min(6, cascade);
   155	      for (var q = 0; q < goals.length; q++) if (goals[q].t === cell.t) goals[q].got++;
   156	      var cx = BX + (idx % COLS) * CELL + CELL / 2, cy = BY + ((idx / COLS) | 0) * CELL + CELL / 2;
   157	      if (T.fx.list.length < 180) T.fx.burst(cx, cy, G.GEMS[cell.t].c, 5, 100);
   158	    }
   159	    /* any spawn that survived (not in list) still becomes special */
   160	    for (var key in spawnAt) {
   161	      var sc = board.g[key | 0]; if (sc) { sc.sp = spawnAt[key].sp; sc.glow = 1; }
   162	    }
   163	    score += gained;
   164	    if (cleared) {
   165	      T.sfx.match(cascade);
   166	      if (exp.triggered) { T.sfx.special(); shake = Math.min(10, shake + 6); }
   167	      else shake = Math.min(8, shake + 1.5 + cleared * 0.15);
   168	      if (cascade > 1) {
   169	        T.addFloat(W / 2, BY + 120, 'x' + Math.min(6, cascade) + ' cascade', '#ffe08a');
   170	      }
   171	      flash = Math.min(0.4, flash + 0.12); flashCol = '#ffffff';
   172	    }
   173	    phase = 'clear'; setAnim(0.17);
   174	    return true;

   177	  function afterSettle() {
   178	    /* win / fail checks */
   179	    var won = true;
   180	    for (var i = 0; i < goals.length; i++) if (goals[i].got < goals[i].need) won = false;
   181	    if (won) {
   182	      result = 'win';
   183	      score += moves * 30;
   184	      var key = String(lvlIdx);
   185	      if (!(typeof st.best[key] === 'number') || score > st.best[key]) { st.best[key] = score; }
   186	      T.store.save(st);
   187	      T.sfx.win();
   188	      for (var p = 0; p < 5; p++) T.fx.burst(40 + p * 78, BY + 160, '#ffe08a', 12, 150);
   189	      resetInput();
   190	      return;
   191	    }
   192	    if (moves <= 0) {
   193	      result = 'fail'; T.sfx.fail(); shake = 10; resetInput(); return;
   194	    }
   195	    if (!board.hasMove()) { board.shuffle(); say('No moves left - the beds were turned over.'); T.sfx.special(); }
   196	  }

   198	  function updateBoard(dt) {
   199	    if (!board || result) return;
   200	    if (phase === 'idle') return;
   201	    animT += dt;
   202	    var done = animT >= animDur;
   203	    if (!done) return;
   204	    animT = 0;
   205	    var i;
   206	    if (phase === 'bad') {
   207	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) { board.g[i].ax0 = 0; board.g[i].ay0 = 0; }
   208	      phase = 'idle'; return;
   209	    }
   210	    if (phase === 'swap') {
   211	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) { board.g[i].ax0 = 0; board.g[i].ay0 = 0; }
   212	      if (!resolveClear(lastSwap)) { phase = 'idle'; afterSettle(); }
   213	      return;
   214	    }
   215	    if (phase === 'clear') {
   216	      var moved = board.collapse();
   217	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) {
   218	        var c = board.g[i];
   219	        if (!c) continue;
   220	        c.pop = 0; c.dead = false;
   220	        c.pop = 0; c.dead = false;
   221	        if (c.off) { c.ay0 = -c.off * CELL; c.off = 0; } else { c.ay0 = 0; }
   222	        c.ax0 = 0;
   223	      }
   224	      phase = 'fall'; setAnim(0.20);
   225	      return;
   226	    }
   227	    if (phase === 'fall') {
   228	      for (i = 0; i < board.g.length; i++) { board.g[i].ay0 = 0; board.g[i].ax0 = 0; }
   229	      if (!resolveClear(null)) { phase = 'idle'; afterSettle(); }
   230	      return;
   231	    }
   232	  }

   234	  /* ---------- gem drawing ---------- */
   235	  function drawGem(x, y, s, t, sp, glow) {
   236	    var col = G.GEMS[t] ? G.GEMS[t].c : '#888';
   237	    ctx.save();
   238	    ctx.translate(x, y);
   239	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   240	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   241	    var k;
   242	    if (t === 0) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.44, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   243	    else if (t === 1) {
   244	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.5); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 0.5, 0, 0, s * 0.5);
   245	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-s * 0.5, 0, 0, -s * 0.5); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   246	    } else if (t === 2) {
   247	      ctx.beginPath();
   248	      for (k = 0; k < 6; k++) { var a = k * 1.0472 - 0.5236; var px2 = Math.cos(a) * s * 0.46, py2 = Math.sin(a) * s * 0.46; if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(px2, py2); else ctx.lineTo(px2, py2); }
   249	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   250	    } else if (t === 3) { T.rr(ctx, -s * 0.4, -s * 0.4, s * 0.8, s * 0.8, 5); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   251	    else if (t === 4) {
   252	      for (k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
   253	        var an = k * 1.2566 - 1.5708;
   254	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(Math.cos(an) * s * 0.26, Math.sin(an) * s * 0.26, s * 0.2, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   255	      }
   256	      ctx.fillStyle = '#f6e6a8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.15, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   257	    } else {
   258	      ctx.beginPath();
   259	      for (k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
   260	        var ang2 = k * 0.6283 - 1.5708, rr = (k % 2 ? s * 0.2 : s * 0.48);
   261	        var xx = Math.cos(ang2) * rr, yy = Math.sin(ang2) * rr;
   262	        if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(xx, yy); else ctx.lineTo(xx, yy);
   263	      }
   264	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   265	    }
   266	    /* highlight */
   267	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3; ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   268	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-s * 0.12, -s * 0.16, s * 0.14, s * 0.09, -0.6, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   269	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   270	    /* special marks */
   271	    if (sp === SP.ROW || sp === SP.COL) {
   272	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
   273	      ctx.beginPath();
   274	      if (sp === SP.ROW) { ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.45, 0); ctx.lineTo(s * 0.45, 0); }
   275	      else { ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.45); ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.45); }
   276	      ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   277	    } else if (sp === SP.BOMB) {
   278	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
   279	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.3, 0, 6.284); ctx.stroke();
   280	    } else if (sp === SP.PRISM) {
   281	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   282	      for (k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   283	        ctx.beginPath();
   284	        var a3 = k * 0.7854 + time;
   285	        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a3) * s * 0.42, Math.sin(a3) * s * 0.42);
   286	        ctx.lineTo(-Math.cos(a3) * s * 0.42, -Math.sin(a3) * s * 0.42);
   287	        ctx.stroke();
   288	      }
   289	    }
   290	    if (glow > 0) {
   291	      ctx.globalAlpha = glow * 0.8; ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   292	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.55, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   293	    }
   294	    ctx.restore();
   295	  }

   684	  /* ---------- loop ---------- */
   685	  var last = 0;
   686	  function frame(ts) {
   687	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   688	    if (!last) last = ts;
   689	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   690	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   691	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   692	    if (paused) { return; }
   693	
   694	    time += dt;
   695	    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 34);
   696	    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   697	    if (toastT > 0) toastT -= dt;
   698	    T.fx.update(dt);
   699	    T.updateFloats(dt);
   700	
   701	    if (screen === 'garden' || screen === 'end' || screen === 'choice' || screen === 'boot') {
   702	      st.dayT = (st.dayT + dt / 54) % 1;
   703	      st.night = (1 - Math.cos(st.dayT * 6.28318)) / 2;
   704	    }
   705	    if (screen === 'level') updateBoard(dt);
   706	
   707	    if (screen === 'boot') drawBoot();
   708	    else if (screen === 'garden') drawGarden();
   709	    else if (screen === 'level') drawLevel();
   710	    else if (screen === 'choice') drawChoice();
   711	    else drawEnd();
   712	  }
   713	
   714	  fit();
   715	  if (st.lvl >= 15) st.done = true;
   716	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   717	})(TT);

   191	    try {
   192	      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
   193	      const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   194	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();

   196	      oscillator.frequency.value = kind === 'good' ? 610 : kind === 'win' ? 820 : kind === 'bad' ? 150 : 320;

   198	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(kind === 'win' ? 0.08 : 0.045, now + 0.012);
   199	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + (kind === 'win' ? 0.24 : 0.12));
   200	      oscillator.connect(gain);
