   226	      pendingTimers.delete(timer);
   227	      fn();
   228	    }, delay);
   229	    pendingTimers.add(timer);
   230	    return timer;
   231	  }
   232	
   233	  function setMessage(text) {
   234	    message = text;
   235	    messageAge = 0;
   236	    srStatus.textContent = text;
   237	  }
   238	
   239	  function queueAction(action) {
   240	    if (queuedActions.length < 20) queuedActions.push(action);
   241	  }
   242	
   243	  function rand() {
   244	    rngState ^= rngState << 13;
   245	    rngState ^= rngState >>> 17;
   246	    rngState ^= rngState << 5;
   247	    return ((rngState >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000;
   248	  }
   249	
   250	  function randomTile() {
   251	    return Math.floor(rand() * TILE.length) % TILE.length;
   252	  }
   253	
   254	  function indexAt(col, row) {
   255	    return row * COLS + col;
   256	  }
   257	
   258	  function makeBoard(seed) {
   259	    rngState = seed >>> 0 || 1;
   260	    const next = Array(CELL_COUNT).fill(0);
   261	    for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row += 1) {
   262	      for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col += 1) {
   263	        let tile = randomTile();
   264	        let tries = 0;
   265	        while (tries < 12 && ((col >= 2 && next[indexAt(col - 1, row)] === tile && next[indexAt(col - 2, row)] === tile) || (row >= 2 && next[indexAt(col, row - 1)] === tile && next[indexAt(col, row - 2)] === tile))) {
   266	          tile = randomTile();
   267	          tries += 1;
   268	        }
   269	        next[indexAt(col, row)] = tile;
   270	      }
   271	    }
   272	    board = next;
   273	    if (!hasAnyMove()) shuffleBoard();
   274	    return board;
   275	  }
   276	
   277	  function findMatches() {
   278	    const matches = new Set();
   279	    for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row += 1) {
   280	      let start = 0;
   281	      while (start < COLS) {
   282	        const tile = board[indexAt(start, row)];
   283	        let end = start + 1;
   284	        while (end < COLS && tile !== null && board[indexAt(end, row)] === tile) end += 1;
   285	        if (tile !== null && end - start >= 3) for (let col = start; col < end; col += 1) matches.add(indexAt(col, row));
   286	        start = end;
   287	      }
   288	    }
   289	    for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col += 1) {
   290	      let start = 0;
   291	      while (start < ROWS) {
   292	        const tile = board[indexAt(col, start)];
   293	        let end = start + 1;
   294	        while (end < ROWS && tile !== null && board[indexAt(col, end)] === tile) end += 1;
   295	        if (tile !== null && end - start >= 3) for (let row = start; row < end; row += 1) matches.add(indexAt(col, row));
   296	        start = end;
   297	      }
   298	    }
   299	    return matches;
   300	  }
   300	  }
   301	
   302	  function hasAnyMove() {
   303	    for (let i = 0; i < CELL_COUNT; i += 1) {
   304	      const col = i % COLS;
   305	      const row = Math.floor(i / COLS);
   306	      if (col < COLS - 1) {
   307	        const other = i + 1;
   308	        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
   309	        const match = findMatches().size > 0;
   310	        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
   311	        if (match) return true;
   312	      }
   313	      if (row < ROWS - 1) {
   314	        const other = i + COLS;
   315	        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
   316	        const match = findMatches().size > 0;
   317	        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
   318	        if (match) return true;
   319	      }
   320	    }
   321	    return false;
   322	  }
   323	
   324	  function shuffleBoard() {
   325	    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
   326	      for (let i = CELL_COUNT - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
   327	        const j = Math.floor(rand() * (i + 1));
   328	        [board[i], board[j]] = [board[j], board[i]];
   329	      }
   330	      if (findMatches().size === 0 && hasAnyMove()) return;
   331	    }
   332	    board = makeBoard((rngState + 17) >>> 0);
   333	  }
   334	
   335	  function addParticle(x, y, color, amount) {
   336	    const count = Math.min(amount, MAX_PARTICLES - particles.length);
   337	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
   338	      const life = 0.35 + rand() * 0.35;
   339	      particles.push({
   340	        x, y, vx: (rand() - 0.5) * 150, vy: -40 - rand() * 150,
   341	        life, maxLife: life, color, size: 2 + rand() * 4
   342	      });
   343	    }
   344	  }
   345	
   346	  function resolveMatches() {
   347	    let chain = 0;
   348	    let totalCleared = 0;
   349	    while (chain < 8) {
   350	      const matches = findMatches();
   351	      if (matches.size === 0) break;
   352	      chain += 1;
   353	      totalCleared += matches.size;
   354	      for (const i of matches) {
   355	        const col = i % COLS;
   356	        const row = Math.floor(i / COLS);
   357	        const point = tileCenter(col, row);
   358	        addParticle(point.x, point.y, TILE[board[i]].light, 4);
   359	        board[i] = null;
   360	      }
   361	      levelScore += matches.size * 20 * chain;
   362	      totalScore += matches.size * 20 * chain;
   363	      for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col += 1) {
   364	        let writeRow = ROWS - 1;
   365	        for (let row = ROWS - 1; row >= 0; row -= 1) {
   366	          const value = board[indexAt(col, row)];
   367	          if (value !== null) {
   368	            board[indexAt(col, writeRow)] = value;
   369	            if (writeRow !== row) board[indexAt(col, row)] = null;
   370	            writeRow -= 1;
   371	          }
   372	        }
   373	        while (writeRow >= 0) {
   374	          board[indexAt(col, writeRow)] = randomTile();
   375	          writeRow -= 1;
   376	        }
   377	      }
   378	    }
   379	    if (totalCleared > 0) {
   380	      shake = Math.min(9, 3 + totalCleared * 0.18);
   381	      flash = 0.12;
   382	      blip(chain > 1 ? 'win' : 'good');
   383	      setMessage(chain > 1 ? `Chain x${chain}! ${totalCleared} sparks cleared.` : `${totalCleared} sparks cleared. Keep the rhythm.`);
   384	    }
   385	    if (!hasAnyMove()) {
   386	      shuffleBoard();
   387	      setMessage('The board reset its rhythm. Find a fresh spark.');
   388	    }
   389	  }
   390	
   391	  function beginFromSave() {
   392	    clearInputState();
   393	    cancelPendingTimers();
   394	    if (currentLevel >= LEVELS.length) {
   395	      state = 'end';
   396	      roomTab = 0;
   397	      return;
   398	    }
   399	    const room = Math.floor(currentLevel / 6);
   400	    const slot = currentLevel % 6;
   401	    if (saveStage === 'commentary' && validStyle(choices[room][slot]) >= 0) {
   402	      decorStyle = choices[room][slot];
   403	      state = 'commentary';
   404	      setMessage('Choice saved. Your household has opinions.');
   405	      return;
   406	    }
   407	    if (saveStage === 'decorate') {
   408	      decorStyle = validStyle(choices[room][slot]);
   409	      state = 'decorate';
   410	      decorFocus = decorStyle >= 0 ? decorStyle : 0;
   411	      setMessage('A room slot is ready. Pick its mood.');
   412	      return;
   413	    }
   414	    beginLevel(currentLevel);
   415	  }
   416	
   417	  function beginLevel(level) {
   418	    clearInputState();
   419	    cancelPendingTimers();
   420	    currentLevel = finiteInt(level, 0, LEVELS.length - 1, 0);
   421	    const config = LEVELS[currentLevel];
   422	    levelScore = 0;
   423	    moves = config.moves;
   424	    goal = config.goal;
   425	    selectedCell = null;
   426	    cursor = { col: 3, row: 4 };
   427	    boardAnimating = 0;
   428	    state = 'level';
   429	    makeBoard(config.seed);
   430	    saveStage = 'level';
   431	    writeSave('level');
   432	    setMessage('Swipe or tap two neighbors. Match three sparks to build the room.');
   433	  }
   434	
   435	  function restartLevel() {
   436	    unlockAudio();
   437	    const level = currentLevel;
   438	    clearInputState();
   439	    cancelPendingTimers();
   440	    beginLevel(level);
   441	    blip('neutral');
   442	  }
   443	
   444	  function newRun() {
   445	    unlockAudio();
   446	    clearInputState();
   447	    cancelPendingTimers();
   448	    choices = blankChoices();
   449	    currentLevel = 0;
   450	    levelScore = 0;
   451	    totalScore = 0;
   452	    decorStyle = -1;
   453	    saveStage = 'level';
   454	    writeSave('level');
   455	    beginLevel(0);
   456	    blip('neutral');
   457	  }
   458	
   459	  function boardTapCell(col, row) {
   460	    if (state !== 'level' || boardAnimating > 0 || moves <= 0) return;
   461	    const cell = { col, row };
   462	    if (!selectedCell) {
   463	      selectedCell = cell;
   464	      setMessage('Neighbor selected. Tap or swipe a tile beside it.');
   465	      return;
   466	    }
   467	    if (selectedCell.col === col && selectedCell.row === row) {
   468	      selectedCell = null;
   469	      setMessage('Selection cleared.');
   470	      return;
   471	    }
   472	    if (Math.abs(selectedCell.col - col) + Math.abs(selectedCell.row - row) === 1) {
   473	      performSwap(selectedCell.col, selectedCell.row, col, row);
   474	      selectedCell = null;
   475	      return;
   476	    }
   477	    selectedCell = cell;
   478	    setMessage('That tile is not a neighbor. Pick a nearby spark.');
   479	  }
   480	
   481	  function performSwap(colA, rowA, colB, rowB) {
   482	    if (state !== 'level' || boardAnimating > 0 || moves <= 0) return;
   483	    const a = indexAt(colA, rowA);
   484	    const b = indexAt(colB, rowB);
   485	    [board[a], board[b]] = [board[b], board[a]];
   486	    if (findMatches().size === 0) {
   487	      [board[a], board[b]] = [board[b], board[a]];
   488	      moves -= 1;
   489	      blip('bad');
   490	      setMessage(moves > 0 ? 'No spark there. Try a different neighbor.' : 'No sparks left. The room can be retried instantly.');
   491	      if (moves <= 0) state = 'fail';
   492	      return;
   493	    }
   494	    moves -= 1;
   495	    resolveMatches();
   496	    boardAnimating = 0.16;
   497	    if (moves <= 0 && levelScore < goal) setMessage('Last move! Make it a bright one.');
   498	  }
   499	
   500	  function finishLevel() {
   501	    if (state !== 'level' || levelScore < goal) return;
   502	    bestScore = Math.max(bestScore, totalScore);
   503	    const room = Math.floor(currentLevel / 6);
   504	    const slot = currentLevel % 6;
   505	    decorStyle = validStyle(choices[room][slot]);
   506	    state = 'decorate';
   507	    decorFocus = decorStyle >= 0 ? decorStyle : 0;
   508	    saveStage = 'decorate';
   509	    writeSave('decorate');
   510	    blip('win');
   511	    setMessage(`Level clear. Choose the ${FIXTURES[slot].toLowerCase()} mood.`);
   512	  }
   513	
   514	  function chooseStyle(style) {
   515	    if (state !== 'decorate' || !Number.isInteger(style) || style < 0 || style > 2) return;
   516	    unlockAudio();
   517	    const room = Math.floor(currentLevel / 6);
   518	    const slot = currentLevel % 6;
   519	    decorStyle = style;
   520	    decorFocus = style;
   521	    choices[room][slot] = style;
   522	    state = 'commentary';
   523	    saveStage = 'commentary';
   524	    writeSave('commentary');
   525	    setMessage(`${STYLES[style].name} ${FIXTURES[slot].toLowerCase()} chosen. Listen to the room.`);
   526	    addParticle(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, STYLES[style].color, 22);
   527	    blip('good');
   528	  }
   529	
   530	  function advanceAfterCommentary() {
   531	    if (state !== 'commentary') return;
   532	    clearInputState();
   533	    cancelPendingTimers();
   534	    if (currentLevel >= LEVELS.length - 1) {
   535	      currentLevel = LEVELS.length;
   536	      saveStage = 'level';
   537	      writeSave('level');
   538	      state = 'end';
   539	      blip('win');
   540	      setMessage('Both rooms are yours. Every style is part of the story.');
   541	      return;
   542	    }
   543	    currentLevel += 1;
   544	    saveStage = 'level';
   545	    beginLevel(currentLevel);
   546	  }
   547	
   548	  function moveCursor(dx, dy) {
   549	    cursor.col = (cursor.col + dx + COLS) % COLS;
   550	    cursor.row = (cursor.row + dy + ROWS) % ROWS;
   551	    if (state === 'level') setMessage('Cursor moved. Enter selects a tile; Enter again swaps a neighbor.');
   552	  }
   553	
   554	  function updateActions() {
   555	    let count = 0;
   556	    while (queuedActions.length && count < 8) {
   557	      const action = queuedActions.shift();
   558	      count += 1;
   559	      if (orientationBlocked) continue;
   560	      if (action.type === 'start') {
   561	        unlockAudio();
   562	        beginFromSave();
   563	      } else if (action.type === 'retry') {
   564	        restartLevel();
   565	      } else if (action.type === 'new') {
   566	        newRun();
   567	      } else if (action.type === 'swipe') {
   568	        performSwap(action.col, action.row, action.toCol, action.toRow);
   569	      } else if (action.type === 'tap') {
   570	        boardTapCell(action.col, action.row);
   571	      } else if (action.type === 'style') {
   572	        chooseStyle(action.style);
   573	      } else if (action.type === 'continue') {
   574	        advanceAfterCommentary();
   575	      } else if (action.type === 'room') {
   576	        roomTab = action.room;
   577	      }
   578	    }
   579	  }
   580	
   581	  function update(dt) {
   582	    updateActions();
   583	    messageAge += dt;
   584	    if (boardAnimating > 0) {
   585	      boardAnimating -= dt;
   586	      if (boardAnimating <= 0 && levelScore >= goal) finishLevel();
   587	    }
   588	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 28);
   589	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
   590	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   591	      const particle = particles[i];
   592	      particle.life -= dt;
   593	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   594	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   595	      particle.vy += 270 * dt;
   596	      if (particle.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
   597	    }
   598	  }
   599	
   600	  function rr(x, y, w, h, radius) {
   601	    const r = Math.min(radius, Math.abs(w) / 2, Math.abs(h) / 2);
   602	    ctx.beginPath();
   603	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   604	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   605	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   606	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   607	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   608	    ctx.closePath();
   609	  }
   610	
   611	  function panel(x, y, w, h, fill, radius = 16) {
   612	    ctx.fillStyle = C.shadow;
   613	    rr(x + 3, y + 5, w, h, radius);
   614	    ctx.fill();
   615	    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
   616	    rr(x, y, w, h, radius);
   617	    ctx.fill();
   618	  }
   619	
   620	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align = 'left', weight = 700) {
   621	    ctx.fillStyle = color;
   622	    ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
   623	    ctx.textAlign = align;
   624	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   625	    ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   626	  }
   627	
   628	  function textFit(value, x, y, maxWidth, size, color, align = 'left', weight = 700) {
   629	    let actual = size;
   630	    while (actual > 10) {
   631	      ctx.font = `${weight} ${actual}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
   632	      if (ctx.measureText(value).width <= maxWidth) break;
   633	      actual -= 1;
   634	    }
   635	    text(value, x, y, actual, color, align, weight);
   636	  }
   637	
   638	  function button(rect, label, fill, color = C.paper, small = false) {
   639	    panel(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h, fill, 14);
   640	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)';
   641	    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   642	    rr(rect.x + 1, rect.y + 1, rect.w - 2, rect.h - 2, 13);
   643	    ctx.stroke();
   644	    textFit(label, rect.x + rect.w / 2, rect.y + rect.h / 2 + 1, rect.w - 14, small ? 12 : 14, color, 'center', 800);
   645	  }
   646	
   647	  function bg() {
   648	    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   649	    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#13233a');
   650	    gradient.addColorStop(0.56, '#192d46');
   651	    gradient.addColorStop(1, '#0f1a2c');
   652	    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
   653	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   654	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22;
   655	    ctx.fillStyle = C.teal;
   656	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W * 0.08, H * 0.1, 62, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   657	    ctx.fillStyle = C.coral;
   658	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W * 0.94, H * 0.38, 88, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   659	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   660	  }

   662	  function drawTopTitle(label, sub) {
   663	    text('HEARTH & HALLS', 18, 22, 14, C.paper, 'left', 900);
   664	    text(label, W - 18, 20, 13, C.gold, 'right', 800);
   665	    text(sub, W - 18, 43, 11, C.muted, 'right', 700);
   666	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.12)';
   667	    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   668	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(18, 60); ctx.lineTo(W - 18, 60); ctx.stroke();
   669	  }

   671	  function drawHint(value, y = 82) {
   672	    textFit(value, W / 2, y, W - 32, 12, C.cream, 'center', 600);
   673	  }
   674	
   675	  function boardRect() {
   676	    const cell = Math.max(30, Math.min((W - 32) / COLS, (H - 256) / ROWS));
   677	    const w = cell * COLS;
   678	    return { x: (W - w) / 2, y: 112, w, h: cell * ROWS, cell };
   679	  }
   680	
   681	  function tileCenter(col, row) {
   682	    const rect = boardRect();
   683	    return { x: rect.x + (col + 0.5) * rect.cell, y: rect.y + (row + 0.5) * rect.cell };
   684	  }
   685	
   686	  function drawTile(tile, col, row, rect) {
   687	    if (tile === null || tile === undefined) return;
   688	    const x = rect.x + col * rect.cell + 3;
   689	    const y = rect.y + row * rect.cell + 3;
   690	    const size = rect.cell - 6;
   691	    const colors = TILE[tile];
   692	    ctx.fillStyle = colors.dark;
   693	    rr(x + 1, y + 3, size, size, Math.min(12, size * 0.22));
   694	    ctx.fill();
   695	    ctx.fillStyle = colors.fill;
   696	    rr(x, y, size, size - 3, Math.min(12, size * 0.22));
   697	    ctx.fill();
   698	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.72;
   699	    ctx.fillStyle = colors.light;
   700	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + size * 0.29, y + size * 0.25, Math.max(2, size * 0.08), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   700	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + size * 0.29, y + size * 0.25, Math.max(2, size * 0.08), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   701	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   702	    const cx = x + size / 2;
   703	    const cy = y + size / 2 + 1;
   704	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.76)';
   705	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.78)';
   706	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, size * 0.055);
   707	    if (tile === 0) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, size * .17, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
   708	    if (tile === 1) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - size * .22); ctx.lineTo(cx + size * .22, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + size * .22); ctx.lineTo(cx - size * .22, cy); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
   709	    if (tile === 2) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, size * .18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - size * .27); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + size * .27); ctx.stroke(); }
   710	    if (tile === 3) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - size * .23); ctx.lineTo(cx + size * .23, cy + size * .2); ctx.lineTo(cx - size * .23, cy + size * .2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
   711	    if (tile === 4) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - size * .24, cy); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy - size * .3, cx + size * .24, cy); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy + size * .3, cx - size * .24, cy); ctx.fill(); }
   712	    if (tile === 5) { ctx.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) { const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5; const radius = i % 2 ? size * .11 : size * .25; const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * radius; const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * radius; if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py); } ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
   713	  }
   714	
   715	  function drawBoard() {
   716	    const rect = boardRect();
   717	    ctx.save();
   718	    const dx = shake ? Math.sin(shake * 13) * shake * 0.45 : 0;
   719	    const dy = shake ? Math.cos(shake * 9) * shake * 0.45 : 0;
   720	    ctx.translate(dx, dy);
   721	    panel(rect.x - 8, rect.y - 8, rect.w + 16, rect.h + 16, '#203650', 20);
   722	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,16,30,.32)';
   723	    rr(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h, 14); ctx.fill();
   724	    for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row += 1) {
   725	      for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col += 1) {
   726	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.035)';
   727	        rr(rect.x + col * rect.cell + 2, rect.y + row * rect.cell + 2, rect.cell - 4, rect.cell - 4, 10); ctx.fill();
   728	        drawTile(board[indexAt(col, row)], col, row, rect);
   729	      }
   730	    }
   731	    if (selectedCell) {
   732	      ctx.strokeStyle = C.gold;
   733	      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
   734	      rr(rect.x + selectedCell.col * rect.cell + 2, rect.y + selectedCell.row * rect.cell + 2, rect.cell - 4, rect.cell - 7, 11); ctx.stroke();
   735	    }
   736	    ctx.strokeStyle = C.paper;
   737	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.78;
   738	    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   739	    rr(rect.x + cursor.col * rect.cell + 6, rect.y + cursor.row * rect.cell + 6, rect.cell - 12, rect.cell - 15, 8); ctx.stroke();
   740	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   741	    ctx.restore();
   742	  }
   743	
   744	  function drawParticles() {
   745	    for (const particle of particles) {
   746	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, particle.life / particle.maxLife);
   747	      ctx.fillStyle = particle.color;
   748	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(particle.x, particle.y, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   749	    }
   750	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   751	  }

   772	  function drawNpc(x, y, color, name, flip = false) {
   773	    ctx.save();
   774	    ctx.translate(x, y);
   775	    if (flip) ctx.scale(-1, 1);
   776	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(9,18,29,.25)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 22, 28, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   777	    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 17, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   778	    ctx.fillStyle = C.paper; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.arc(5, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   779	    ctx.strokeStyle = C.ink; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 3, 7, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2); ctx.stroke();
   780	    text(name, 0, 31, 10, C.ink, 'center', 900);
   781	    ctx.restore();
   782	  }

   784	  function drawFixture(slot, style, x, y, w, h, active = false) {
   785	    ctx.save();
   786	    if (active) { ctx.strokeStyle = C.gold; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.setLineDash([5, 3]); rr(x - 5, y - 5, w + 10, h + 10, 10); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
   787	    if (style < 0) {
   788	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(23,34,53,.10)'; rr(x, y, w, h, 8); ctx.fill();
   789	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(23,34,53,.42)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); rr(x, y, w, h, 8); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
   790	      text(`+ ${FIXTURES[slot]}`, x + w / 2, y + h / 2, Math.min(10, w / 8), C.ink, 'center', 900);
   791	      ctx.restore(); return;
   792	    }
   793	    const cozy = style === 0;
   794	    const grand = style === 1;
   795	    const quirky = style === 2;
   796	    ctx.fillStyle = cozy ? '#c57552' : grand ? '#ae7d3d' : '#39a8a1';
   797	    ctx.strokeStyle = grand ? '#74502d' : '#633b35';
   798	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, w * .035);
   799	    if (slot === 0) {
   800	      const base = quirky ? 0.12 : grand ? 0.03 : 0.08;
   801	      rr(x + w * base, y + h * .2, w * (1 - base * 2), h * .8, 6); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   802	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#f6bf55' : cozy ? '#ef7559' : '#9fe2c9';
   803	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w / 2 + (quirky ? 4 : 0), y + h * .63, h * .22, Math.PI, 0); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .72, y + h * .85); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .28, y + h * .85); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   804	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc73'; ctx.globalAlpha = cozy ? .9 : .6; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w / 2, y + h * .62, h * .1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   805	    } else if (slot === 1) {
   806	      ctx.fillStyle = cozy ? '#d85f4d' : grand ? '#c69a43' : '#37a5a2';
   807	      if (quirky) { ctx.rotate(-0.08); }
   808	      rr(x, y + h * .2, w, h * .58, 10); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   809	      ctx.strokeStyle = grand ? '#fff0b0' : '#f4c67a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   810	      if (grand) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .15, y + h * .48); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .5, y + h * .26); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .85, y + h * .48); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .5, y + h * .7); ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke(); }
   811	      if (cozy) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .18, y + h * .5, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.arc(x + w * .82, y + h * .5, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#f6bf55'; ctx.fill(); }
   812	      if (quirky) { ctx.fillStyle = '#f6bf55'; ctx.fillRect(x + w * .18, y + h * .35, 7, 7); ctx.fillRect(x + w * .62, y + h * .58, 7, 7); }
   813	    } else if (slot === 2) {
   814	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#c89a50' : cozy ? '#b96e48' : '#49b6ac';
   815	      if (quirky) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .5, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h * .65); ctx.lineTo(x, y + h * .65); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   816	      else { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x + w * .5, y + h * .35, w * .46, h * .22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillRect(x + w * .27, y + h * .38, w * .07, h * .5); ctx.fillRect(x + w * .66, y + h * .38, w * .07, h * .5); }
   817	      if (grand) { ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff1b0'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x + w * .5, y + h * .35, w * .3, h * .1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); }
   818	    } else if (slot === 3) {
   819	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#e2b64d' : cozy ? '#e98759' : '#3faeaa';
   820	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#613b35';
   821	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .5, y + h * .12); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .5, y + h * .78); ctx.stroke();
   822	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .5, y + h * .78, w * .18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   823	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .5 + (quirky ? 5 : 0), y + h * .13, w * (grand ? .35 : .28), Math.PI, 0); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .8, y + h * .32); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .2, y + h * .32); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   824	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#fff0a3' : '#ffc778'; ctx.globalAlpha = .78; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .5, y + h * .23, w * .12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   825	    } else if (slot === 4) {
   826	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#bc873e' : cozy ? '#aa6748' : '#43a39b';
   827	      ctx.save(); if (quirky) ctx.rotate(-0.12); rr(x, y + h * .25, w, h * .12, 4); ctx.fill(); rr(x, y + h * .58, w, h * .12, 4); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
   828	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#603f38'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .12, y + h * .2); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .12, y + h * .83); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .88, y + h * .2); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .88, y + h * .83); ctx.stroke();
   829	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#f3cf72' : '#e1a86a'; ctx.fillRect(x + w * .25, y + h * .34, w * .14, h * .15); ctx.fillRect(x + w * .58, y + h * .68, w * .16, h * .12);
   830	    } else if (slot === 5) {
   831	      ctx.fillStyle = grand ? '#e4bc5e' : cozy ? '#8bbfa8' : '#ef7559';
   832	      if (grand) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w / 2, y + h * .55, Math.min(w, h) * .48, Math.PI, 0); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .98, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .02, y + h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   833	      else { rr(x + w * .04, y + h * .05, w * .92, h * .88, 4); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke(); }
   834	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(23,34,53,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .5, y + h * .08); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .5, y + h * .92); ctx.moveTo(x + w * .08, y + h * .5); ctx.lineTo(x + w * .92, y + h * .5); ctx.stroke();
   835	      if (cozy) { ctx.fillStyle = '#e99a69'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .15, y + h * .42, w * .16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.arc(x + w * .85, y + h * .42, w * .16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
   836	      if (quirky) { ctx.fillStyle = '#f6bf55'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .72, y + h * .22, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
   837	    }
   838	    ctx.restore();
   839	  }

   841	  function roomFixtureRect(slot, x, y, w, h) {
   842	    const layout = [
   843	      [.06, .47, .28, .42], [.19, .78, .62, .15], [.43, .5, .28, .28],
   844	      [.78, .18, .13, .34], [.05, .17, .29, .25], [.55, .13, .32, .27]
   845	    ][slot];
   846	    return { x: x + w * layout[0], y: y + h * layout[1], w: w * layout[2], h: h * layout[3] };
   847	  }

   849	  function tally(room) {
   850	    const counts = [0, 0, 0];
   851	    for (const value of choices[room]) if (validStyle(value) >= 0) counts[value] += 1;
   852	    return counts;
   853	  }
   854	
   855	  function drawTally(room, x, y, small = false) {
   856	    const counts = tally(room);
   857	    const gap = small ? 4 : 7;
   858	    const width = small ? 64 : 76;
   859	    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
   860	      const bx = x + i * (width + gap);
   861	      panel(bx, y, width, small ? 20 : 24, 'rgba(23,34,53,.72)', 8);
   862	      ctx.fillStyle = STYLES[i].color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx + 10, y + (small ? 10 : 12), 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   863	      text(`${STYLES[i].name[0]} ${counts[i]}`, bx + 19, y + (small ? 10 : 12), small ? 9 : 10, C.paper, 'left', 800);
   864	    }
   865	  }

   867	  function drawRoomScene(x, y, w, h, room, activeSlot = -1, previewStyle = -1) {
   868	    const theme = ROOMS[room];
   869	    ctx.save();
   870	    panel(x, y, w, h, theme.wall, 18);
   871	    ctx.save();
   872	    rr(x, y, w, h, 18); ctx.clip();
   873	    ctx.fillStyle = theme.floor; ctx.fillRect(x, y + h * .78, w, h * .22);
   874	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)'; ctx.fillRect(x, y + h * .74, w, 4);
   875	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)'; ctx.fillRect(x + w * .5, y, 2, h * .78);
   876	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(23,34,53,.08)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * .2, y + h * .28, h * .18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   877	    for (let slot = 0; slot < 6; slot += 1) {
   878	      const fixture = roomFixtureRect(slot, x, y, w, h);
   879	      let style = validStyle(choices[room][slot]);
   880	      if (slot === activeSlot && previewStyle >= 0) style = previewStyle;
   881	      drawFixture(slot, style, fixture.x, fixture.y, fixture.w, fixture.h, slot === activeSlot);
   882	    }
   883	    drawNpc(x + w * .16, y + h * .78, theme.npcA, 'Marn');
   884	    drawNpc(x + w * .84, y + h * .78, theme.npcB, 'Pip', true);
   885	    ctx.restore();
   886	    text(theme.name, x + 14, y + 20, 13, C.ink, 'left', 900);
   887	    drawTally(room, x + 14, y + h - 34, true);
   888	    ctx.restore();
   889	  }

  1001	  function draw() {
  1002	    ctx.save();
  1003	    if (state === 'intro') drawIntro();
  1004	    else if (state === 'level') drawLevel();
  1005	    else if (state === 'decorate') drawDecorate();
  1006	    else if (state === 'commentary') drawCommentary();
  1007	    else if (state === 'fail') drawFail();
  1008	    else if (state === 'end') drawEnd();
  1009	    if (orientationBlocked) drawRotateOverlay();
  1010	    ctx.restore();
  1011	  }

  1013	  function pointFromEvent(event) {
  1014	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  1015	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width), y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height) };
  1016	  }
  1017	
  1018	  function inside(point, rect) {
  1019	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
  1020	  }
  1021	
  1022	  function cellFromPoint(point) {
  1023	    const rect = boardRect();
  1024	    if (!inside(point, rect)) return null;
  1025	    const col = Math.floor((point.x - rect.x) / rect.cell);
  1026	    const row = Math.floor((point.y - rect.y) / rect.cell);
  1027	    return col >= 0 && col < COLS && row >= 0 && row < ROWS ? { col, row } : null;
  1028	  }

  1030	  function hitAt(point) {
  1031	    if (state === 'intro') {
  1032	      const buttonRect = { x: 38, y: H - 126, w: W - 76, h: 54 };

  1034	    }

  1036	      const cell = cellFromPoint(point);

  1057	  function handlePointerDown(event) {
  1058	    event.preventDefault();
  1059	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
  1060	    const point = pointFromEvent(event);
  1061	    const hit = hitAt(point);
  1062	    if (!hit) return;
  1063	    if (activePointers.size >= 8) return;
  1064	    if (hit.kind === 'board' && boardPointerId !== null) return;
  1065	    if (hit.kind === 'button') {
  1066	      for (const pressedId of pressedButtonPointers.values()) if (pressedId === hit.id) return;
  1067	    }
  1068	    canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  1069	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1070	    const record = { kind: hit.kind, id: hit.id, startX: point.x, startY: point.y, x: point.x, y: point.y, cell: hit.cell, style: hit.style };
  1071	    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, record);
  1072	    if (hit.kind === 'board') boardPointerId = event.pointerId;
  1073	    if (hit.kind === 'button') pressedButtonPointers.set(event.pointerId, hit.id);
  1074	    unlockAudio();
  1075	  }

  1077	  function handlePointerMove(event) {
  1078	    event.preventDefault();
  1079	    const record = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1080	    if (!record) return;
  1081	    const point = pointFromEvent(event);
  1082	    record.x = point.x; record.y = point.y;
  1083	  }

  1085	  function releasePointer(event, cancelled) {
  1086	    event.preventDefault();
  1087	    const record = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1088	    if (!record) return;
  1089	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1090	    pressedButtonPointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1091	    if (event.pointerId === boardPointerId) boardPointerId = null;
  1092	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1093	    if (cancelled || orientationBlocked) return;
  1094	    const point = pointFromEvent(event);
  1095	    if (record.kind === 'board') {
  1096	      const dx = point.x - record.startX;
  1097	      const dy = point.y - record.startY;
  1098	      const start = record.cell;
  1099	      if (!start) return;
  1100	      if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > 16) {
  1101	        let toCol = start.col;
  1102	        let toRow = start.row;
  1103	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) toCol += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  1104	        else toRow += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  1105	        if (toCol >= 0 && toCol < COLS && toRow >= 0 && toRow < ROWS) queueAction({ type: 'swipe', col: start.col, row: start.row, toCol, toRow });
  1106	      } else {
  1107	        const cell = cellFromPoint(point);
  1108	        if (cell) queueAction({ type: 'tap', col: cell.col, row: cell.row });
  1109	      }
  1110	    } else {
  1111	      const hit = hitAt(point);
  1112	      if (hit && hit.kind === 'button' && hit.id === record.id) {
  1113	        if (record.id === 'start') queueAction({ type: 'start' });
  1114	        if (record.id === 'retry') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1115	        if (record.id === 'new') queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1116	        if (record.id === 'continue') queueAction({ type: 'continue' });
  1117	        if (record.id === 'style') queueAction({ type: 'style', style: record.style });
  1118	      }
  1119	    }
  1120	  }

  1122	  function handleKeyDown(event) {
  1123	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
  1124	    if (heldKeys.size < 64) heldKeys.add(event.key);
  1125	    const key = event.key;
  1126	    const actionKey = key === 'ArrowLeft' || key === 'ArrowRight' || key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key.toLowerCase() === 'r' || key.toLowerCase() === 'n';
  1127	    if (actionKey) event.preventDefault();

  1130	    else if (state === 'level') {
  1131	      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'r') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1132	      else if (key === 'ArrowLeft') moveCursor(-1, 0);
  1133	      else if (key === 'ArrowRight') moveCursor(1, 0);
  1134	      else if (key === 'ArrowUp') moveCursor(0, -1);
  1135	      else if (key === 'ArrowDown') moveCursor(0, 1);
  1136	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'tap', col: cursor.col, row: cursor.row });
  1137	    } else if (state === 'decorate') {
  1138	      if (key === 'ArrowLeft') decorFocus = (decorFocus + 2) % 3;
  1139	      else if (key === 'ArrowRight') decorFocus = (decorFocus + 1) % 3;
  1140	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'style', style: decorFocus });
  1141	    } else if (state === 'commentary' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ type: 'continue' });
  1142	    else if (state === 'fail') {
  1143	      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'n') queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1144	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1145	    } else if (state === 'end' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key.toLowerCase() === 'n')) queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1146	  }

  1148	  function frame(now) {
  1149	    const dt = lastFrame ? Math.min(0.033, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000)) : 0;
  1150	    lastFrame = now;
  1151	    if (!orientationBlocked) update(dt);
  1152	    draw();
  1153	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1154	  }

  1157	  const initialSave = readSave();
  1158	  if (initialSave) {
  1159	    choices = initialSave.choices;
  1160	    currentLevel = initialSave.currentLevel;
  1161	    bestScore = initialSave.bestScore;
  1162	    totalScore = initialSave.totalScore;
  1163	    saveStage = initialSave.stage;
  1164	  }
  1165	  resizeCanvas();

  1167	  window.addEventListener('blur', clearInputState);
  1168	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown, { passive: false });
  1169	  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove, { passive: false });
  1170	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => releasePointer(event, false), { passive: false });

  1172	  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => event.preventDefault());

  1174	  window.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => { heldKeys.delete(event.key); });

  1002	    ctx.save();
  1003	    if (state === 'intro') drawIntro();
  1004	    else if (state === 'level') drawLevel();
  1005	    else if (state === 'decorate') drawDecorate();
  1006	    else if (state === 'commentary') drawCommentary();
  1007	    else if (state === 'fail') drawFail();

  1013	  function pointFromEvent(event) {
  1014	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  1015	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width), y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height) };
  1016	  }
  1017	
  1018	  function inside(point, rect) {
  1019	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
  1020	  }
  1021	
  1022	  function cellFromPoint(point) {
  1023	    const rect = boardRect();
  1024	    if (!inside(point, rect)) return null;
  1025	    const col = Math.floor((point.x - rect.x) / rect.cell);
  1026	    const row = Math.floor((point.y - rect.y) / rect.cell);
  1027	    return col >= 0 && col < COLS && row >= 0 && row < ROWS ? { col, row } : null;
  1028	  }
  1029	
  1030	  function hitAt(point) {
  1031	    if (state === 'intro') {
  1032	      const buttonRect = { x: 38, y: H - 126, w: W - 76, h: 54 };
  1033	      return inside(point, buttonRect) ? { kind: 'button', id: 'start' } : null;
  1034	    }
  1035	    if (state === 'level') {
  1036	      const cell = cellFromPoint(point);
  1037	      if (cell) return { kind: 'board', cell };
  1038	      return inside(point, levelRetryRect()) ? { kind: 'button', id: 'retry' } : null;
  1039	    }
  1040	    if (state === 'decorate') {
  1041	      const rects = decorateRects();
  1042	      for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i += 1) if (inside(point, rects[i])) return { kind: 'button', id: 'style', style: i };
  1043	      if (decorStyle >= 0 && inside(point, continueRect())) return { kind: 'button', id: 'continue' };
  1044	      return null;
  1045	    }
  1046	    if (state === 'commentary') return inside(point, continueRect()) ? { kind: 'button', id: 'continue' } : null;
  1047	    if (state === 'fail') {
  1048	      const boxY = H * .27;
  1049	      if (inside(point, { x: 44, y: boxY + 116, w: W - 88, h: 52 })) return { kind: 'button', id: 'retry' };
  1050	      if (inside(point, { x: 44, y: boxY + 178, w: W - 88, h: 44 })) return { kind: 'button', id: 'new' };
  1051	      return null;
  1052	    }
  1053	    if (state === 'end') return inside(point, { x: 18, y: H - 58, w: W - 36, h: 48 }) ? { kind: 'button', id: 'new' } : null;
  1054	    return null;
  1055	  }

  1057	  function handlePointerDown(event) {
  1058	    event.preventDefault();
  1059	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
  1060	    const point = pointFromEvent(event);
  1061	    const hit = hitAt(point);
  1062	    if (!hit) return;
  1063	    if (activePointers.size >= 8) return;
  1064	    if (hit.kind === 'board' && boardPointerId !== null) return;
  1065	    if (hit.kind === 'button') {
  1066	      for (const pressedId of pressedButtonPointers.values()) if (pressedId === hit.id) return;
  1067	    }
  1068	    canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  1069	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1070	    const record = { kind: hit.kind, id: hit.id, startX: point.x, startY: point.y, x: point.x, y: point.y, cell: hit.cell, style: hit.style };
  1071	    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, record);
  1072	    if (hit.kind === 'board') boardPointerId = event.pointerId;
  1073	    if (hit.kind === 'button') pressedButtonPointers.set(event.pointerId, hit.id);
  1074	    unlockAudio();
  1075	  }
  1076	
  1077	  function handlePointerMove(event) {
  1078	    event.preventDefault();
  1079	    const record = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1080	    if (!record) return;
  1081	    const point = pointFromEvent(event);
  1082	    record.x = point.x; record.y = point.y;
  1083	  }
  1084	
  1085	  function releasePointer(event, cancelled) {
  1086	    event.preventDefault();
  1087	    const record = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1088	    if (!record) return;
  1089	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1090	    pressedButtonPointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1091	    if (event.pointerId === boardPointerId) boardPointerId = null;
  1092	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1093	    if (cancelled || orientationBlocked) return;
  1094	    const point = pointFromEvent(event);
  1095	    if (record.kind === 'board') {
  1096	      const dx = point.x - record.startX;
  1097	      const dy = point.y - record.startY;
  1098	      const start = record.cell;
  1099	      if (!start) return;
  1100	      if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > 16) {
  1101	        let toCol = start.col;
  1102	        let toRow = start.row;
  1103	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) toCol += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  1104	        else toRow += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  1105	        if (toCol >= 0 && toCol < COLS && toRow >= 0 && toRow < ROWS) queueAction({ type: 'swipe', col: start.col, row: start.row, toCol, toRow });
  1106	      } else {
  1107	        const cell = cellFromPoint(point);
  1108	        if (cell) queueAction({ type: 'tap', col: cell.col, row: cell.row });
  1109	      }
  1110	    } else {
  1111	      const hit = hitAt(point);
  1112	      if (hit && hit.kind === 'button' && hit.id === record.id) {
  1113	        if (record.id === 'start') queueAction({ type: 'start' });
  1114	        if (record.id === 'retry') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1115	        if (record.id === 'new') queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1116	        if (record.id === 'continue') queueAction({ type: 'continue' });
  1117	        if (record.id === 'style') queueAction({ type: 'style', style: record.style });
  1118	      }
  1119	    }
  1120	  }
  1121	
  1122	  function handleKeyDown(event) {
  1123	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
  1124	    if (heldKeys.size < 64) heldKeys.add(event.key);
  1125	    const key = event.key;
  1126	    const actionKey = key === 'ArrowLeft' || key === 'ArrowRight' || key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key.toLowerCase() === 'r' || key.toLowerCase() === 'n';
  1127	    if (actionKey) event.preventDefault();
  1128	    if (event.repeat) return;
  1129	    if (state === 'intro' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ type: 'start' });
  1130	    else if (state === 'level') {
  1131	      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'r') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1132	      else if (key === 'ArrowLeft') moveCursor(-1, 0);
  1133	      else if (key === 'ArrowRight') moveCursor(1, 0);
  1134	      else if (key === 'ArrowUp') moveCursor(0, -1);
  1135	      else if (key === 'ArrowDown') moveCursor(0, 1);
  1136	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'tap', col: cursor.col, row: cursor.row });
  1137	    } else if (state === 'decorate') {
  1138	      if (key === 'ArrowLeft') decorFocus = (decorFocus + 2) % 3;
  1139	      else if (key === 'ArrowRight') decorFocus = (decorFocus + 1) % 3;
  1140	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'style', style: decorFocus });
  1141	    } else if (state === 'commentary' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ type: 'continue' });
  1142	    else if (state === 'fail') {
  1143	      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'n') queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1144	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1145	    } else if (state === 'end' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key.toLowerCase() === 'n')) queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1146	  }
  1147	
  1148	  function frame(now) {
  1149	    const dt = lastFrame ? Math.min(0.033, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000)) : 0;
  1150	    lastFrame = now;
  1151	    if (!orientationBlocked) update(dt);
  1152	    draw();
  1153	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1154	  }
  1155	
  1156	  let boardPointerId = null;
  1157	  const initialSave = readSave();
  1158	  if (initialSave) {
  1159	    choices = initialSave.choices;
  1160	    currentLevel = initialSave.currentLevel;
  1161	    bestScore = initialSave.bestScore;
  1162	    totalScore = initialSave.totalScore;
  1163	    saveStage = initialSave.stage;
  1164	  }
  1165	  resizeCanvas();
  1166	  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas, { passive: true });
  1167	  window.addEventListener('blur', clearInputState);
  1168	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown, { passive: false });
  1169	  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove, { passive: false });
  1170	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => releasePointer(event, false), { passive: false });
  1171	  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', (event) => releasePointer(event, true), { passive: false });
  1172	  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => event.preventDefault());
  1173	  window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, { passive: false });
  1174	  window.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => { heldKeys.delete(event.key); });
  1175	  window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1176	})();

   229	    if (!Number.isInteger(slot) || slot < 0 || slot >= BUILDINGS.length) return;
   230	    const tier = state.buildings[slot];
   231	    if (tier >= 3) { setMessage(BUILDINGS[slot].name + ' is fully fortified.', 2.5); return; }
   232	    const cost = buildingCost(slot);
   233	    if (state.coins < cost) {
   234	      setMessage('Need ' + cost + ' coins for ' + BUILDINGS[slot].name + '. Spin for more.', 3);
   235	      bump(2); audio.hit(); return;
   236	    }
   237	    state.coins -= cost;
   238	    state.buildings[slot]++;
   239	    const newTier = state.buildings[slot];
   240	    const msg = BUILDINGS[slot].name + ' reached tier ' + newTier + '.';
   241	    setMessage(msg, 3);
   242	    burst(buildX(slot) + 52, 445, COLORS.acid, 18);
   243	    audio.good(); bump(4);
   244	    if (state.buildings.every((value) => value >= 3)) winVillage();
   245	  }
   246	
   247	  function winVillage() {
   248	    state.phase = 'win';
   249	    state.winBanner = 4;
   250	    profile.completed = Math.max(profile.completed, Math.min(20, state.village + 1));
   251	    profile.best = Math.max(profile.best, profile.completed);
   252	    saveProfile();
   253	    setMessage(profile.completed >= 20 ? 'Ladder complete. You own the skyline.' : 'Village complete. Next rung unlocked.', 6);
   254	    burst(W * .5, 270, COLORS.gold, 38);
   255	    audio.good(); bump(8);
   256	  }
   257	
   258	  function openRaid() {
   259	    if (!started || orientationPaused || state.gameOver || state.phase !== 'build') return;
   260	    if (state.raids <= 0) {
   260	    if (state.raids <= 0) {
   261	      setMessage('No raid charges. Spin until the wheel shows RAID.', 3);
   262	      bump(2); return;
   263	    }
   264	    state.raids--;
   265	    state.phase = 'raid';
   266	    state.raidState = makeRaid(state.village, state.totalRaids);
   267	    state.raidFound = [];
   268	    state.raidPicks = 0;
   269	    setMessage('Pick 3 vault spots. The map hints at the hot route.', 5);
   270	    audio.beep(260, .12, 'triangle', .035);
   271	    burst(W * .5, 370, COLORS.violet, 20);
   272	  }
   273	
   274	  function makeRaid(village, raidNumber) {
   275	    const hot = (village * 5 + raidNumber * 3 + 2) % 12;
   276	    const second = (hot + 5 + (village % 3)) % 12;
   277	    const third = (hot + 9) % 12;
   278	    const values = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i === hot ? 36 : i === second ? 22 : i === third ? 14 : (i % 3) + 3);
   279	    return { hot, second, third, values, picked: new Array(12).fill(false) };
   280	  }
   281	
   282	  function dig(index) {
   283	    if (!started || orientationPaused || state.phase !== 'raid' || !state.raidState) return;
   284	    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= 12) return;
   285	    const raid = state.raidState;
   286	    if (raid.picked[index] || state.raidPicks >= 3) return;
   287	    raid.picked[index] = true;
   288	    state.raidPicks++;
   289	    state.raidFound.push(index);
   290	    state.raidLoot += raid.values[index];
   291	    const isHot = index === raid.hot;
   292	    burst(digX(index) + 17, digY(index) + 17, isHot ? COLORS.gold : COLORS.violet, isHot ? 18 : 8);
   293	    if (isHot) { setMessage('HOT SPOT! +' + raid.values[index] + ' coins.', 2.5); audio.good(); bump(5); }
   294	    else { setMessage('Dig ' + state.raidPicks + '/3: +' + raid.values[index] + ' coins.', 2); audio.coin(); }
   295	    if (state.raidPicks >= 3) finishRaid();
   296	  }
   297	
   298	  function finishRaid() {
   299	    const loot = state.raidLoot;
   300	    state.coins += loot;
   301	    state.spins = Math.min(15, state.spins + 2);
   302	    state.totalRaids++;
   303	    state.phase = 'raidDone';
   304	    setMessage('Raid banked +' + loot + ' coins and +2 spins. Back to the village.', 5);
   305	    announce('Raid complete. Two spins recharged.');
   306	    audio.good(); bump(6);
   307	    burst(W * .5, 350, COLORS.gold, 28);
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function leaveRaid() {
   311	    if (state.phase === 'raidDone') {
   312	      state.phase = 'build';
   313	      state.raidState = null;
   314	      state.raidLoot = 0;
   315	      state.raidFound = [];
   316	      setMessage('The vault is empty. Spend your haul on a build slot.', 4);
   317	    }
   318	  }
   319	
   320	  function nextVillage() {
   321	    if (state.phase !== 'win') return;
   322	    if (state.village >= 19) {
   323	      state.gameOver = true;
   324	      setMessage('Ladder complete. Restart to run it again.', 8);
   325	      return;
   326	    }
   327	    const next = state.village + 1;
   328	    restart(next);
   329	    state.spins = 10;
   330	    state.coins = 95 + next * 3;
   331	    state.message = 'Rung ' + (next + 1) + '/20. Bots are getting clever.';
   332	    state.messageTime = 5;
   333	    announce(state.message);
   334	  }
   335	
   336	  function attackBot() {
   337	    if (!started || orientationPaused || state.phase !== 'build' || state.spinBusy || state.gameOver) return;
   338	    if (state.attack <= 0) { setMessage('No attack tokens. Spin for an ATTACK reel.', 3); bump(2); return; }
   339	    state.attack--;
   340	    const target = botTarget(state.village);
   341	    if (target.shielded) {
   342	      setMessage(target.name + ' blocked the hit with a shield.', 3.5);
   343	      audio.hit(); bump(4); burst(W * .78, 352, COLORS.blue, 14);
   344	    } else {
   345	      setMessage('Direct hit on ' + target.name + ' — ' + target.building + ' cracked.', 3.5);
   346	      audio.hit(); bump(7); burst(W * .78, 352, COLORS.orange, 24);
   347	    }
   348	  }
   349	
   350	  function botTarget(village) {
   351	    const index = (village * 7 + state.totalRaids * 2 + state.buildings.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)) % 5;
   352	    const name = BOT_NAMES[village % BOT_NAMES.length];
   353	    const tier = Math.min(3, 1 + Math.floor(village / 7));
   354	    const shielded = ((village * 11 + state.totalRaids + index) % 4) === 0;
   355	    return { name, building: BUILDINGS[index].name + ' T' + tier, shielded };
   356	  }
   357	
   358	  function buildX(i) { return 18 + (i % 3) * 119 + (i >= 3 ? 59 : 0); }
   359	  function buildY(i) { return i >= 3 ? 442 : 442; }
   360	  function digX(i) { return 42 + (i % 4) * 77; }
   361	  function digY(i) { return 310 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 58; }
   362	
   363	  function hitTest(x, y) {
   364	    if (state.phase === 'raid') {
   365	      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) if (x >= digX(i)-10 && x <= digX(i)+46 && y >= digY(i)-10 && y <= digY(i)+46) return { type:'dig', index:i };
   366	      return null;
   367	    }
   368	    if (state.phase === 'raidDone') {
   369	      return { type:'leaveRaid' };
   370	    }
   371	    if (state.phase === 'win') return { type:'next' };
   372	    if (x >= 28 && x <= W-28 && y >= 174 && y <= 274) return { type:'spin' };
   373	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   374	      const bx = buildX(i), by = buildY(i);
   375	      if (x >= bx-6 && x <= bx+104 && y >= by-8 && y <= by+92) return { type:'build', index:i };
   376	    }
   377	    if (x >= 23 && x <= W*.5-5 && y >= 558 && y <= 616) return { type:'raid' };
   378	    if (x >= W*.5+5 && x <= W-23 && y >= 558 && y <= 616) return { type:'attack' };
   379	    if (x >= W-96 && x <= W-16 && y >= 22 && y <= 68) return { type:'restart' };
   380	    return null;
   381	  }
   382	
   383	  function dispatchHit(hit) {
   384	    if (!hit) return;
   385	    if (hit.type === 'spin') spin();
   386	    if (hit.type === 'build') build(hit.index);
   387	    if (hit.type === 'raid') openRaid();
   388	    if (hit.type === 'attack') attackBot();
   389	    if (hit.type === 'dig') dig(hit.index);
   390	    if (hit.type === 'leaveRaid') leaveRaid();
   391	    if (hit.type === 'next') nextVillage();
   392	    if (hit.type === 'restart') restart(state.village);
   393	  }
   394	
   395	  function pointerPosition(e) {
   396	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   397	    return { x:(e.clientX - rect.left) * W / rect.width, y:(e.clientY - rect.top) * H / rect.height };
   398	  }
   399	
   400	  function pointerDown(e) {
   401	    e.preventDefault();
   402	    if (!started || orientationPaused) return;
   403	    const p = pointerPosition(e);
   404	    const hit = hitTest(p.x, p.y);
   405	    if (!hit) return;
   406	    const control = hit.type + (hit.index == null ? '' : ':' + hit.index);
   407	    if (controlPointers.has(control)) return;
   408	    controlPointers.set(control, e.pointerId);
   409	    pointers.set(e.pointerId, { control, hit });
   410	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   411	    dispatchHit(hit);
   412	  }
   413	
   414	  function pointerUp(e) {
   415	    e.preventDefault();
   416	    const tracked = pointers.get(e.pointerId);
   417	    if (tracked) controlPointers.delete(tracked.control);
   418	    pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
   419	  }
   420	
   421	  function pointerCancel(e) {
   422	    const tracked = pointers.get(e.pointerId);
   423	    if (tracked) controlPointers.delete(tracked.control);
   424	    pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
   425	  }
   426	
   427	  function keyDown(e) {
   428	    if (['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
   429	    if (e.repeat) return;
   430	    keys.add(e.code);
   431	    if (!started) return;
   432	    if (e.code === 'Space') spin();
   433	    if (e.code === 'KeyR') restart(state.village);
   434	    if (e.code === 'KeyV') openRaid();
   435	    if (e.code === 'KeyA') attackBot();
   436	    if (e.code === 'Enter' && state.phase === 'win') nextVillage();
   437	    if (state.phase === 'build' && /^Digit[1-5]$/.test(e.code)) build(Number(e.code.slice(-1))-1);
   438	    if (state.phase === 'raid' && /^Digit([1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(e.code)) dig(Number(e.code.slice(5))-1);
   439	  }
   440	
   441	  function keyUp(e) { keys.delete(e.code); }
   442	
   443	  function resize() {
   444	    W = Math.max(320, Math.min(540, window.innerWidth));
   445	    H = Math.max(568, Math.min(900, window.innerHeight));
   446	    orientationPaused = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   447	    rotateScreen.hidden = !orientationPaused;
   448	    const maxAxis = 960;
   449	    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   450	    scale = Math.min(maxAxis / Math.max(W, H), 1);
   451	    canvas.width = Math.round(W * dpr * scale);
   452	    canvas.height = Math.round(H * dpr * scale);
   453	    ctx.setTransform(dpr * scale, 0, 0, dpr * scale, 0, 0);
   454	  }
   455	
   456	  function update(dt) {
   457	    if (!started || orientationPaused || document.hidden) return;
   458	    state.elapsed += dt;
   459	    state.messageTime = Math.max(0, state.messageTime - dt);
   460	    screenShake = Math.max(0, screenShake - dt * 20);
   461	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 3);
   462	    if (state.spinBusy) {
   463	      state.spinTime += dt;
   464	      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   465	        if (state.spinTime < state.reelStop[i]) state.reels[i] = Math.floor(state.spinTime * (15+i*3)) % SYMBOLS.length;
   466	        else state.reels[i] = state.reelFinal[i];
   467	      }
   468	      if (state.spinTime >= 1.0) resolveSpin();
   469	    }
   470	    if (state.winBanner > 0) state.winBanner -= dt;
   471	    updateParticles(dt);
   472	  }
   473	
   474	  function bump(amount) { screenShake = Math.min(14, screenShake + amount); flash = Math.min(1, flash + .16); }
   475	
   476	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   477	    const room = Math.max(0, MAX_PARTICLES - particles.length);
   478	    const total = Math.min(count, room);
   479	    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
   480	      const angle = Math.random() * TAU, speed = 20 + Math.random() * 120;
   481	      particles.push({ x, y, vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed, vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed-35, life:.35+Math.random()*.7, max:.7, size:2+Math.random()*4, color });
   482	    }
   483	  }
   484	
   485	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   486	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   487	      const p = particles[i];
   488	      p.life -= dt;
   489	      if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   490	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 115 * dt;
   491	    }
   492	  }
   493	
   494	  function roundedRect(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke) {
   495	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);
   496	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   497	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   498	  }
   499	
   500	  function text(value, x, y, size, color=COLORS.ink, align='left', weight=700) {
   501	    ctx.font = weight + ' ' + size + 'px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
   502	    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.textAlign = align; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   503	  }
   504	
   505	  function wrap(value, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, size, color) {
   506	    ctx.font = '700 ' + size + 'px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
   507	    ctx.fillStyle = color;
   508	    const words = value.split(' '); let line = ''; let yy = y;
   509	    words.forEach((word) => { const test = line ? line + ' ' + word : word; if (ctx.measureText(test).width > maxWidth && line) { ctx.fillText(line, x, yy); line = word; yy += lineHeight; } else line = test; });
   510	    if (line) ctx.fillText(line, x, yy);
   511	  }
   512	
   513	  function draw() {
   514	    ctx.save();
   515	    const sx = screenShake ? (Math.random()-.5)*screenShake : 0;
   516	    const sy = screenShake ? (Math.random()-.5)*screenShake : 0;
   517	    ctx.translate(sx, sy);
   518	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1713'; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);
   519	    drawBackground();
   520	    if (!started) drawAttract();
   521	    else if (state.phase === 'raid' || state.phase === 'raidDone') drawRaid();
   522	    else drawVillage();
   523	    drawParticles();
   524	    if (flash > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(245,240,222,' + (flash*.055) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }
   525	    ctx.restore();
   526	  }
   527	
   528	  function drawBackground() {
   529	    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
   530	    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#1b3026'); gradient.addColorStop(.55, '#12231d'); gradient.addColorStop(1, '#0b1512');
   531	    ctx.fillStyle = gradient; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   532	    ctx.globalAlpha = .13; ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.acid; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   533	    for (let x = -H; x < W + H; x += 34) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x+H,H); ctx.stroke(); }
   534	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   535	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(215,243,106,.035)';
   536	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*.14, H*.28, 120, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   537	  }

   542	    text('Tap START above to unlock the soundboard', W*.5, 251, 12, COLORS.muted, 'center', 700);
   543	    drawTinySpinner(W*.5, 360);
   544	  }

   618	  function drawHint() {

   212	    if (!audio) return;
   213	    try {
   214	      const now = audio.currentTime;
   215	      const osc = audio.createOscillator();

   325	      line(x - size * .16, y - size * .4, x + size * .16, y - size * .4, COLORS.forest2, 3);
   326	      line(x - size * .12, y - size * .1, x + size * .12, y - size * .1, COLORS.white, 2);
   327	    } else if (id === 'bread') {
   328	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.orange;
   329	      rr(x - size * .4, y - size * .18, size * .8, size * .42, size * .16); ctx.fill();
   330	      line(x - size * .16, y - size * .08, x - size * .06, y + size * .1, '#c86d43', 2);
   331	      line(x + size * .08, y - size * .1, x + size * .18, y + size * .08, '#c86d43', 2);
   332	    } else if (id === 'cheese') {
   333	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.gold; ctx.strokeStyle = '#bd8c38'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   334	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - size * .4, y + size * .26); ctx.lineTo(x + size * .38, y + size * .26); ctx.lineTo(x + size * .16, y - size * .32); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   335	      ctx.fillStyle = '#bd8c38'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + size * .03, y + size * .05, size * .05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   336	    } else if (id === 'jam') {
   337	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.berry; ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.forest2; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   338	      rr(x - size * .3, y - size * .22, size * .6, size * .52, 5); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   339	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.gold; rr(x - size * .24, y - size * .38, size * .48, size * .1, 3); ctx.fill();
   340	    }
   341	    ctx.restore();
   342	  }

   347	    const col = index % 4;
   348	    const row = Math.floor(index / 4);
   349	    return { x: 20 + col * 88, y: 132 + row * 65, w: 82, h: 57 };

   366	  function inRect(x, y, rect, pad = 0) {
   367	    return x >= rect.x - pad && x <= rect.x + rect.w + pad && y >= rect.y - pad && y <= rect.y + rect.h + pad;
   368	  }

   402	  function drawField() {
   403	    panel(14, 98, 362, 235, COLORS.cream);
   404	    text('FIELD ROWS', 25, 113, 11, COLORS.forest, 900);
   405	    text(`${unlockedPlots()} plots`, 365, 113, 10, COLORS.leaf, 800, 'right');
   406	    for (let i = 0; i < unlockedPlots(); i += 1) {
   407	      const p = plots[i];
   408	      const r = plotRect(i);
   409	      const crop = p.crop ? cropById(p.crop) : null;
   410	      ctx.fillStyle = crop ? crop.color : COLORS.mint;
   411	      rr(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 11); ctx.fill();
   412	      ctx.strokeStyle = p.stage === 2 ? COLORS.orange : 'rgba(43,51,40,.16)';
   413	      ctx.lineWidth = p.stage === 2 ? 3 : 1;
   414	      ctx.stroke();
   415	      if (!crop) {
   416	        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
   417	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(43,51,40,.28)';
   418	        ctx.stroke();
   419	        ctx.setLineDash([]);
   420	        text('+ drag seed', r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + 29, 10, COLORS.leaf, 800, 'center');
   421	      } else {
   422	        drawIcon(crop.icon, r.x + 23, r.y + 27, 28, .95);
   423	        text(crop.label, r.x + 45, r.y + 19, 10, COLORS.ink, 850);
   424	        if (p.stage === 1) {
   425	          text('WAKE', r.x + 45, r.y + 38, 9, COLORS.forest2, 800);
   426	          line(r.x + 46, r.y + 47, r.x + 68, r.y + 47, COLORS.leaf, 3);
   427	        } else {
   428	          text('READY', r.x + 45, r.y + 38, 9, COLORS.forest, 900);
   429	          line(r.x + 46, r.y + 47, r.x + 70, r.y + 47, COLORS.orange, 4);
   430	        }
   431	      }
   432	      if (p.pulse > 0) {
   433	        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,248,231,${Math.min(.8, p.pulse)})`;
   434	        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   435	        rr(r.x + 2, r.y + 2, r.w - 4, r.h - 4, 9); ctx.stroke();
   436	      }
   437	    }
   438	    text('SEED CART', 25, 267, 9, COLORS.leaf, 900);
   439	    crops.forEach((crop, i) => {
   440	      const r = seedRect(i);
   441	      ctx.fillStyle = crop.color;

   445	      text(crop.label, r.x + 34, r.y + 24, 9, COLORS.ink, 850);

   482	  function drawRail() {
   483	    panel(14, 596, 362, 91, COLORS.forest2);
   484	    const order = currentOrder();
   485	    text(`RAIL ORDER · ${order.title}`, 25, 611, 10, COLORS.cream, 900);
   486	    text(`${filledCount()}/${carCapacity()} loaded`, 365, 611, 10, COLORS.sage, 800, 'right');
   487	    const car = carRect();
   488	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.forest;
   489	    rr(car.x, car.y, car.w, car.h, 12); ctx.fill();
   490	    const capacity = carCapacity();
   491	    const gap = 3;
   492	    const bayW = (car.w - gap * (capacity + 1)) / capacity;
   493	    const required = Object.keys(order.goods);
   494	    for (let i = 0; i < capacity; i += 1) {
   495	      const x = car.x + gap + i * (bayW + gap);
   496	      const id = required[i];
   497	      const need = id ? order.goods[id] : 0;
   498	      const have = id ? (loaded[id] || 0) : 0;
   499	      ctx.fillStyle = id ? (have >= need ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.cream) : 'rgba(255,248,231,.13)';
   500	      rr(x, car.y + 5, bayW, car.h - 10, 8); ctx.fill();
   501	      if (id) {
   502	        drawIcon(goodInfo[id].icon, x + bayW / 2, car.y + 20, Math.min(21, bayW * .42), have >= need ? .9 : .65);
   503	        text(`${have}/${need}`, x + bayW / 2, car.y + 43, 10, COLORS.ink, 900, 'center');
   504	      } else {
   505	        text('space', x + bayW / 2, car.y + 29, 8, COLORS.sage, 800, 'center');
   506	      }
   507	    }
   508	  }

   510	  function drawFocus() {
   511	    if (mode === 'town') {
   512	      const r = townRect(townFocus);
   513	      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.orange;
   514	      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   515	      rr(r.x - 3, r.y - 3, r.w + 6, r.h + 6, 16); ctx.stroke();
   516	      return;
   517	    }
   518	    let r = null;
   519	    if (focus.zone === 'seed') r = seedRect(focus.index);
   520	    if (focus.zone === 'plot') r = plotRect(focus.index);
   521	    if (focus.zone === 'factory') r = factoryRect(focus.index);
   522	    if (focus.zone === 'pantry') r = pantryRect(focus.index);
   523	    if (focus.zone === 'car') r = carRect();
   524	    if (!r) return;
   525	    ctx.save();
   526	    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.orange;
   527	    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   528	    ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
   529	    rr(r.x - 3, r.y - 3, r.w + 6, r.h + 6, 14); ctx.stroke();
   530	    ctx.setLineDash([]);
   531	    ctx.restore();
   532	  }

   565	  function drawDragGhost() {
   566	    if (!pointers.size) return;
   567	    pointers.forEach((pointer) => {
   568	      if (!pointer.dragging || !pointer.kind) return;
   569	      const id = pointer.kind === 'seed' ? crops[pointer.index].icon : pointer.kind === 'pantry' ? goods[pointer.index] : pointer.kind === 'plot' ? (plots[pointer.index].crop && cropById(plots[pointer.index].crop).icon) : null;
   570	      if (!id) return;
   571	      ctx.save();
   572	      ctx.globalAlpha = .85;
   573	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.cream;
   574	      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(43,51,40,.25)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
   575	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pointer.x, pointer.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   576	      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
   577	      drawIcon(id, pointer.x, pointer.y, 31);
   578	      ctx.restore();
   579	    });
   580	  }

   605	  function render() {
   606	    ctx.save();
   607	    const offsetX = shake > 0 ? Math.sin(shake * 44) * Math.min(3, shake * 3) : 0;
   608	    const offsetY = shake > 0 ? Math.cos(shake * 39) * Math.min(2, shake * 2) : 0;
   609	    ctx.translate(offsetX, offsetY);
   610	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.paper;
   611	    ctx.fillRect(-5, -5, W + 10, H + 10);
   612	    drawTopBar();
   613	    drawHint();
   614	    if (mode === 'town') {
   615	      drawTown();
   616	    } else {
   617	      drawField();
   618	      drawFactories();
   619	      drawPantry();
   620	      drawRail();
   621	      drawFocus();
   622	      drawParticles();
   623	      drawDragGhost();
   624	      drawComplete();
   625	    }
   626	    drawToast();
   627	    ctx.restore();
   628	  }
   629	
   630	  function drawParticles() {
   631	    particles.forEach((particle) => {
   632	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, particle.life / particle.maxLife);
   633	      ctx.fillStyle = particle.color;
   634	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(particle.x, particle.y, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   635	    });
   636	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   637	  }
   638	
   639	  function spawnBurst(x, y, color = COLORS.gold, count = 8) {
   640	    const room = Math.max(0, MAX_PARTICLES - particles.length);
   641	    const total = Math.min(count, room);
   642	    for (let i = 0; i < total; i += 1) {
   643	      const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / Math.max(1, total) + Math.random() * .3;
   644	      const speed = 20 + Math.random() * 45;
   645	      particles.push({
   646	        x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18,
   647	        life: .45 + Math.random() * .45, maxLife: .9, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color
   648	      });
   649	    }
   650	  }
   651	
   652	  function update(dt) {
   653	    if (toast) {
   654	      toast.ttl -= dt;
   655	      if (toast.ttl <= 0) toast = null;
   656	    }
   657	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
   658	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
   659	    completePulse += dt;
   660	    particles.forEach((particle) => {
   661	      particle.life -= dt;
   662	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   663	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   664	      particle.vy += 80 * dt;
   665	    });
   666	    particles = particles.filter((particle) => particle.life > 0).slice(-MAX_PARTICLES);
   667	    plots.forEach((plot) => { plot.pulse = Math.max(0, plot.pulse - dt * 1.7); });
   668	  }

   670	  function pointerPosition(event) {
   671	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   672	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left) / logicalScale, y: (event.clientY - rect.top) / logicalScale };
   673	  }

   708	  function plantPlot(index, cropId) {
   709	    if (index < 0 || index >= unlockedPlots()) return false;
   710	    const plot = plots[index];
   711	    if (plot.crop) {
   712	      setToast('That row is already growing.');
   713	      return false;
   714	    }
   715	    const crop = cropById(cropId);
   716	    plot.crop = crop.id;
   717	    plot.stage = 1;
   718	    plot.pulse = 1;
   719	    focus = { zone: 'plot', index };
   720	    spawnBurst(plotRect(index).x + 41, plotRect(index).y + 28, crop.color, 7);
   721	    tone(430, .07);
   722	    setToast(`${crop.label} planted · tap to wake it`, COLORS.forest2);
   723	    return true;
   724	  }
   725	
   726	  function harvestPlot(index) {
   727	    const plot = plots[index];
   728	    if (!plot || !plot.crop || plot.stage !== 2) return false;
   729	    const crop = cropById(plot.crop);
   730	    inventory[crop.output] += 1;
   731	    plot.crop = null;
   732	    plot.stage = 0;
   733	    plot.pulse = 1;
   734	    const r = plotRect(index);
   735	    spawnBurst(r.x + 41, r.y + 28, crop.color, 12);

   877	  function classifyPointer(pos) {
   878	    if (mode === 'town') {
   879	      if (hitBack(pos.x, pos.y)) return { kind: 'back' };
   880	      const building = hitTownCard(pos.x, pos.y);
   881	      return building >= 0 ? { kind: 'town', index: building } : { kind: 'none' };
   882	    }
   883	    if (hitTownButton(pos.x, pos.y)) return { kind: 'townButton' };
   884	    if (hitReset(pos.x, pos.y)) return { kind: 'reset' };
   885	    const seed = hitSeed(pos.x, pos.y);
   886	    if (seed >= 0) return { kind: 'seed', index: seed };
   887	    const plot = hitPlot(pos.x, pos.y);
   888	    if (plot >= 0) return { kind: 'plot', index: plot };
   889	    const factory = hitFactory(pos.x, pos.y);
   890	    if (factory >= 0) return { kind: 'factory', index: factory };
   891	    const pantry = hitPantry(pos.x, pos.y);
   892	    if (pantry >= 0) return { kind: 'pantry', index: pantry };
   893	    if (hitCar(pos.x, pos.y)) return { kind: 'car' };
   894	    return { kind: 'none' };
   895	  }

   897	  function pointerDown(event) {

   914	    pointer.dragging = pointer.dragging || Math.hypot(pos.x - pointer.startX, pos.y - pointer.startY) > 8;
   915	  }

   917	  function pointerUp(event) {
   918	    event.preventDefault();

   921	    const pos = pointerPosition(event);
   922	    pointer.x = pos.x; pointer.y = pos.y;

   927	    if (pointer.kind === 'townButton' && !pointer.dragging) { toggleTown(); return; }
   928	    if (pointer.kind === 'reset' && !pointer.dragging) { restart(); return; }
   929	    if (pointer.kind === 'back' && !pointer.dragging) { toggleTown(); return; }
   930	    if (pointer.kind === 'town' && !pointer.dragging) { buyBuilding(pointer.index); return; }
   931	    if (pointer.kind === 'seed') {

   933	      else if (!pointer.dragging) setToast('Drop that seed into an empty row.');

   938	      else if (!pointer.dragging) actPlot(pointer.index);

   941	    if (pointer.kind === 'factory' && !pointer.dragging) { useFactory(pointer.index); return; }

   948	      }
   949	      return;
   950	    }
   951	    if (pointer.kind === 'car' && !pointer.dragging) attemptOrder();
   952	  }

   981	  function moveFocus(dx, dy) {
   982	    if (mode === 'town') {
   983	      if (dy !== 0) townFocus = Math.max(0, Math.min(buildings.length - 1, townFocus + dy * 2));
   984	      if (dx !== 0) townFocus = Math.max(0, Math.min(buildings.length - 1, townFocus + dx));
   985	      focus = { zone: 'town', index: townFocus };
   986	      return;
   987	    }
   988	    let zoneIndex = zones.indexOf(focus.zone);
   989	    if (zoneIndex < 0) zoneIndex = 0;
   990	    if (dy !== 0) zoneIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(zones.length - 1, zoneIndex + (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1)));
   991	    focus.zone = zones[zoneIndex];
   992	    if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
   993	      const len = zoneLength(focus.zone);
   994	      if (dy !== 0) focus.index = Math.min(focus.index, len - 1);
   995	      if (dx !== 0) focus.index = Math.max(0, Math.min(len - 1, focus.index + dx));
   996	    }
   997	  }

   999	  function keyboardAct() {
  1000	    if (mode === 'town') { buyBuilding(townFocus); return; }
  1001	    if (focus.zone === 'seed') {
  1002	      carry = { kind: 'seed', id: crops[focus.index].id };
  1003	      setToast(`${crops[focus.index].label} picked · move to a row and press Space.`);
  1004	    } else if (focus.zone === 'plot') actPlot(focus.index);
  1005	    else if (focus.zone === 'factory') useFactory(focus.index);
  1006	    else if (focus.zone === 'pantry') {
  1007	      const id = goods[focus.index];

  1009	      else if (inventory[id] > 0) { carry = { kind: 'good', id }; setToast('Good picked up · move to the car and press Space.'); }
  1010	    } else if (focus.zone === 'car') {
  1011	      if (carry && carry.kind === 'good') loadGood(carry.id);
  1012	      else attemptOrder();
  1013	    }
  1014	  }

  1016	  function keyDown(event) {
  1017	    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
  1018	    const accepted = ['arrowleft', 'arrowright', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown', ' ', 'r', 't', 'escape'];
  1019	    if (!accepted.includes(key) && event.code !== 'Space') return;
  1020	    event.preventDefault();
  1021	    initAudio();
  1022	    if (keys.has(key)) return;
  1023	    keys.add(key);
  1024	    if (key === 'r') { restart(); return; }
  1025	    if (key === 't') { toggleTown(); return; }
  1026	    if (key === 'escape' && mode === 'town') { toggleTown(); return; }
  1027	    if (key === 'arrowleft') moveFocus(-1, 0);
  1028	    else if (key === 'arrowright') moveFocus(1, 0);
  1029	    else if (key === 'arrowup') moveFocus(0, -1);
  1030	    else if (key === 'arrowdown') moveFocus(0, 1);
  1031	    else if (key === ' ' || event.code === 'Space') keyboardAct();
  1032	  }
