    66	    const safe = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number.isFinite(seconds) ? seconds : 0));
    67	    return `${String(Math.floor(safe / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(safe % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    68	  }
    69	
    70	  function safeStorageRead() {
    71	    try {
    72	      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    73	      if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length > 24000) return null;
    74	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    75	      return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : null;
    76	    } catch (_) { return null; }
    77	  }
    78	
    79	  function safeStorageWrite(value) {
    80	    try { window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (_) { /* storage is optional */ }
    81	  }
    82	
    83	  function validSlot(slot) { return slot === 'weapon' || slot === 'armor' || slot === 'charm'; }
    84	
    85	  function defaultItem(slot) {
    86	    const power = slot === 'weapon' ? 5 : slot === 'armor' ? 5 : 2;
    87	    return { slot, rarity: 0, score: 10, power, name: SLOT_NAMES[slot], id: `starter-${slot}` };
    88	  }
    89	
    90	  function freshGear() {
    91	    return { weapon: defaultItem('weapon'), armor: defaultItem('armor'), charm: defaultItem('charm') };
    92	  }
    93	
    94	  function sanitizeItem(raw, slot) {
    95	    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || !validSlot(slot)) return defaultItem(slot);
    96	    const rarity = clamp(Number.isInteger(raw.rarity) ? raw.rarity : 0, 0, RARITIES.length - 1);
    97	    const score = Number.isFinite(raw.score) ? clamp(Math.round(raw.score), 1, 9999) : 10;
    98	    const power = Number.isFinite(raw.power) ? clamp(Math.round(raw.power * 10) / 10, 1, 9999) : 5;
    99	    const name = typeof raw.name === 'string' && raw.name.length > 0 && raw.name.length < 80 ? raw.name : SLOT_NAMES[slot];
   100	    const id = typeof raw.id === 'string' && raw.id.length < 100 ? raw.id : `saved-${slot}`;
   101	    return { slot, rarity, score, power, name, id };
   102	  }
   103	
   104	  function loadSave() {
   105	    const raw = safeStorageRead();
   106	    const gear = freshGear();
   107	    if (!raw) return { depth: 1, highestFloor: 1, bestTime: 0, gear };
   108	    for (const slot of Object.keys(gear)) gear[slot] = sanitizeItem(raw.gear && raw.gear[slot], slot);
   109	    const depth = Number.isFinite(raw.depth) ? clamp(Math.floor(raw.depth), 1, 30) : 1;
   110	    const highestFloor = Number.isFinite(raw.highestFloor) ? clamp(Math.floor(raw.highestFloor), 1, 30) : depth;
   111	    const bestTime = Number.isFinite(raw.bestTime) && raw.bestTime > 0 ? clamp(raw.bestTime, 1, 999999) : 0;
   112	    return { depth, highestFloor: Math.max(depth, highestFloor), bestTime, gear };
   113	  }
   114	
   115	  function saveProgress() {
   116	    safeStorageWrite({
   117	      depth: clamp(Math.floor(state.floor), 1, 30),
   118	      highestFloor: clamp(Math.floor(state.highestFloor), 1, 30),
   119	      bestTime: Number.isFinite(state.bestTime) ? state.bestTime : 0,
   120	      gear: state.gear
   121	    });
   122	  }
   123	
   124	  function recalculateStats() {
   125	    state.gearScore = Object.values(state.gear).reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0);
   126	    state.hero.maxHp = 100 + state.gear.armor.power * 7 + state.gear.charm.power * 2;
   127	    state.hero.hp = clamp(state.hero.hp, 0, state.hero.maxHp);
   128	  }
   129	
   130	  function currentDps() {
   131	    return Math.max(1, state.gear.weapon.power * (1 + state.gear.charm.power * .04));
   132	  }
   133	
   134	  function doorRequirement(nextFloor) {
   135	    return Math.ceil(20 + nextFloor * 7.5);
   136	  }
   137	
   138	  function createFloorProfile(floor) {
   139	    const boss = floor % 10 === 0;
   140	    const minions = boss ? Math.min(4, 2 + Math.floor(floor / 10)) : Math.min(6, 2 + Math.floor(floor / 6));
   141	    const queue = [];
   142	    for (let i = 0; i < minions; i += 1) queue.push('shade');
   143	    if (boss) queue.push('warden');
   144	    return { floor, boss, minions, queue, baseHp: 32 + floor * 9, baseDamage: 5 + floor * .9 };
   145	  }
   146	
   147	  function makeEnemy(kind) {
   148	    const p = state.floorProfile;
   149	    const isBoss = kind === 'warden';
   150	    const hp = isBoss ? p.baseHp * (8 + p.floor * .08) : p.baseHp * rand(.9, 1.15);
   151	    const edge = Math.random() < .5 ? -1 : 1;
   152	    return {
   153	      kind,
   154	      x: viewW * .5 + edge * rand(42, 105),
   155	      y: rand(198, 295),
   156	      hp,
   157	      maxHp: hp,
   158	      radius: isBoss ? 31 : rand(16, 22),
   159	      speed: isBoss ? 22 + p.floor * .2 : 28 + p.floor * .7,
   160	      damage: isBoss ? p.baseDamage * 2.2 : p.baseDamage,
   161	      attackClock: rand(.5, 1.3),
   162	      attackGap: isBoss ? 1.8 : 1.35,
   163	      stun: 0,
   164	      phase: rand(0, TAU),
   165	      dead: false
   166	    };
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  function clearPendingTimers() {
   170	    for (const timer of pendingTimeouts) window.clearTimeout(timer);
   171	    pendingTimeouts.clear();
   172	  }
   173	
   174	  function schedule(fn, delay) {
   175	    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
   176	      pendingTimeouts.delete(timer);
   177	      fn();
   178	    }, delay);
   179	    pendingTimeouts.add(timer);
   180	    return timer;
   181	  }
   182	
   183	  function showToast(text, color = '#f3b66d', duration = 3000) {
   184	    state.toast = { text, color, until: performance.now() + duration };
   185	    $('toast').textContent = text;
   186	    $('toast').style.borderLeftColor = color;
   187	    $('toast').classList.add('visible');
   188	  }
   189	
   190	  function hideToast() {
   191	    $('toast').classList.remove('visible');
   192	  }
   193	
   194	  function unlockAudio() {
   195	    if (!audioContext) {
   196	      const AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   197	      if (!AudioCtor) return;
   198	      try { audioContext = new AudioCtor(); } catch (_) { audioContext = null; }
   199	    }
   200	    if (audioContext && audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume().catch(() => {});
   201	  }
   202	
   203	  function tone(frequency, duration, type = 'sine', volume = .035) {
   204	    if (!audioContext || audioContext.state !== 'running') return;
   205	    try {
   206	      const osc = audioContext.createOscillator();
   207	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   208	      osc.type = type;
   209	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, audioContext.currentTime);
   210	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioContext.currentTime);
   211	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, audioContext.currentTime + duration);
   212	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
   213	      osc.start();
   214	      osc.stop(audioContext.currentTime + duration);
   215	    } catch (_) { /* sound is decorative */ }
   216	  }
   217	
   218	  function releaseAllInput() {
   219	    pressedKeys.clear();
   220	    surfacePointers.clear();
   221	    for (const button of controlButtons) {
   222	      if (button._activePointerId !== null) {
   223	        try { button.releasePointerCapture(button._activePointerId); } catch (_) {}
   224	      }
   225	      button._activePointerId = null;
   226	      button.classList.remove('pressed');
   227	    }
   228	  }
   229	
   230	  function bindControl(button, action) {
   231	    button._action = action;
   232	    button._activePointerId = null;
   233	    button._lastPointerAction = -1000;
   234	    controlButtons.push(button);
   235	    button.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   236	      if (button._activePointerId !== null) return;
   237	      event.preventDefault();
   238	      unlockAudio();
   239	      button._activePointerId = event.pointerId;
   240	      button._lastPointerAction = performance.now();
   241	      button.classList.add('pressed');
   242	      try { button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   243	      if (typeof button._action === 'function' && !button.disabled) button._action();
   244	    }, { passive: false });
   245	    const release = (event) => {
   246	      if (button._activePointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
   247	      event.preventDefault();
   248	      button._activePointerId = null;
   249	      button.classList.remove('pressed');
   250	    };
   251	    button.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   252	    button.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   253	    button.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', () => { button._activePointerId = null; button.classList.remove('pressed'); });
   254	    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
   255	      if (performance.now() - button._lastPointerAction < 450) return;
   256	      unlockAudio();
   257	      if (typeof button._action === 'function' && !button.disabled) button._action();
   258	    });
   259	  }
   260	
   261	  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count = 8, speed = 80) {
   262	    const amount = Math.min(count, MAX_PARTICLES - state.particles.length);
   263	    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i += 1) {
   264	      const angle = rand(0, TAU);
   265	      const velocity = rand(speed * .35, speed);
   266	      pushLimited(state.particles, { x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * velocity, vy: Math.sin(angle) * velocity, life: rand(.25, .65), maxLife: .65, size: rand(1.5, 4), color }, MAX_PARTICLES);
   267	    }
   268	  }
   269	
   270	  function addDamageNumber(x, y, text, color) {
   271	    pushLimited(state.damageNumbers, { x, y, text, color, life: .8, maxLife: .8, drift: rand(8, 18) }, MAX_DAMAGE_NUMBERS);
   272	  }
   273	
   274	  function rollRarity() {
   275	    const value = Math.random();
   276	    let sum = 0;
   277	    for (let i = 0; i < RARITIES.length; i += 1) {
   278	      sum += RARITIES[i].chance;
   279	      if (value <= sum) return i;
   280	    }
   281	    return 0;
   282	  }
   283	
   284	  function createLootItem(slot) {
   285	    const rarity = rollRarity();
   286	    const r = RARITIES[rarity];
   287	    const floor = state.floor;
   288	    const base = 8 + floor * 1.55 + rand(0, floor * 1.4 + 2);
   289	    const score = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * r.mult));
   290	    const powerBase = slot === 'weapon' ? 4 + floor * .62 : slot === 'armor' ? 4 + floor * .78 : 2 + floor * .34;
   291	    const power = Math.max(1, Math.round(powerBase * r.mult + rand(0, 2)));
   292	    return { slot, rarity, score, power, name: `${r.short} ${SLOT_NAMES[slot]}`, id: `${floor}-${slot}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}` };
   293	  }
   294	
   295	  function collectLoot(enemy) {
   296	    if (!enemy || (enemy.kind !== 'warden' && Math.random() > .45)) return;
   297	    const item = createLootItem(pick(['weapon', 'armor', 'charm']));
   298	    const old = state.gear[item.slot];
   299	    const rarity = RARITIES[item.rarity];
   300	    if (item.score > old.score) {
   301	      state.gear[item.slot] = item;
   302	      recalculateStats();
   303	      saveProgress();
   304	      showToast(`AUTO-EQUIP  ${SLOT_LABELS[item.slot]} +${item.score - old.score}  |  ${old.score} → ${item.score}`, rarity.color, 3400);
   305	      tone(item.rarity >= 2 ? 660 : 440, .12, 'triangle', .04);
   306	    } else {
   307	      showToast(`LOOT  ${rarity.short} ${SLOT_LABELS[item.slot]}  ${item.score} score  |  kept ${old.score}`, rarity.color, 1900);
   308	      tone(330, .07, 'sine', .018);
   309	    }
   310	  }
   311	
   312	  function startFloor(floor) {
   313	    clearPendingTimers();
   314	    releaseAllInput();
   315	    state.floor = clamp(Math.floor(floor), 1, 30);
   316	    state.floorProfile = createFloorProfile(state.floor);
   317	    state.spawnQueue = state.floorProfile.queue.slice(0, 16);
   318	    state.spawnClock = .25;
   319	    state.enemies.length = 0;
   320	    state.particles.length = 0;
   321	    state.damageNumbers.length = 0;
   322	    state.floorTime = 0;
   323	    state.phase = 'playing';
   324	    state.statusPhase = '';
   325	    state.skills.pulse = 0;
   326	    state.skills.hook = 0;
   327	    state.hero.x = viewW * .5;
   328	    state.hero.y = viewH * .69;
   329	    state.hero.rollTime = 0;
   330	    state.hero.rollCooldown = 0;
   331	    state.hero.invuln = 0;
   332	    state.hero.attackClock = .3;
   333	    recalculateStats();
   334	    state.hero.hp = state.hero.maxHp;
   335	    state.highestFloor = Math.max(state.highestFloor, state.floor);
   336	    saveProgress();
   337	    hideToast();
   338	    syncStatusPanel();
   339	  }
   340	
   341	  function startAgain() {
   342	    clearPendingTimers();
   343	    releaseAllInput();
   344	    state.runSeconds = 0;
   345	    startFloor(1);
   346	  }
   347	
   348	  function spawnNextEnemy() {
   349	    if (!state.spawnQueue.length || state.enemies.length >= MAX_ENEMIES) return;
   350	    const kind = state.spawnQueue.shift();
   351	    pushLimited(state.enemies, makeEnemy(kind), MAX_ENEMIES);
   352	    spawnParticles(viewW * .5 + rand(-80, 80), rand(185, 285), kind === 'warden' ? '#c19cff' : '#75e6df', kind === 'warden' ? 20 : 8, 45);
   353	    tone(kind === 'warden' ? 130 : 190, kind === 'warden' ? .25 : .08, 'sawtooth', .025);
   354	  }
   355	
   356	  function nearestEnemy() {
   357	    let best = null;
   358	    let bestDistance = Infinity;
   359	    for (const enemy of state.enemies) {
   360	      if (enemy.dead) continue;
   361	      const distance = Math.hypot(enemy.x - state.hero.x, enemy.y - state.hero.y);
   362	      if (distance < bestDistance) { best = enemy; bestDistance = distance; }
   363	    }
   364	    return best;
   365	  }
   366	
   367	  function defeatEnemy(enemy) {
   368	    if (!enemy || enemy.dead) return;
   369	    enemy.dead = true;
   370	    spawnParticles(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.kind === 'warden' ? '#c19cff' : '#75e6df', enemy.kind === 'warden' ? 34 : 15, enemy.kind === 'warden' ? 130 : 95);
   371	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, enemy.kind === 'warden' ? 12 : 4);
   372	    addDamageNumber(enemy.x, enemy.y - enemy.radius - 7, 'CLEARED', enemy.kind === 'warden' ? '#c19cff' : '#75e6df');
   373	    collectLoot(enemy);
   374	    tone(enemy.kind === 'warden' ? 260 : 200, enemy.kind === 'warden' ? .22 : .08, 'triangle', .035);
   375	  }
   376	
   377	  function damageEnemy(enemy, amount, color = '#f0e8d9') {
   378	    if (!enemy || enemy.dead || state.phase !== 'playing') return;
   379	    const safeAmount = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0);
   380	    enemy.hp -= safeAmount;
   381	    enemy.stun = Math.max(enemy.stun, color === '#c19cff' ? .8 : 0);
   382	    addDamageNumber(enemy.x + rand(-4, 4), enemy.y - enemy.radius, `-${Math.max(1, Math.round(safeAmount))}`, color);
   383	    spawnParticles(enemy.x, enemy.y, color, Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor(safeAmount / 20)), 58);
   384	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, color === '#c19cff' ? 7 : 2);
   385	    if (enemy.hp <= 0) defeatEnemy(enemy);
   386	  }
   387	
   388	  function usePulse() {
   389	    if (state.phase !== 'playing' || state.manualOpen || state.orientationPaused || state.tabPaused || state.skills.pulse > 0) return;
   390	    state.skills.pulse = 7;
   391	    const power = currentDps() * 2.4;
   392	    let hits = 0;
   393	    for (const enemy of state.enemies) {
   394	      if (Math.hypot(enemy.x - state.hero.x, enemy.y - state.hero.y) < 205) { damageEnemy(enemy, power, '#75e6df'); hits += 1; }
   395	    }
   396	    spawnParticles(state.hero.x, state.hero.y, '#75e6df', 32, 180);
   397	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 9);
   398	    tone(520, .18, 'square', .03);
   399	    if (hits === 0) showToast('RIFT PULSE  ready when a shade enters the ring', '#75e6df', 1300);
   400	  }
   401	
   402	  function useHook() {
   403	    if (state.phase !== 'playing' || state.manualOpen || state.orientationPaused || state.tabPaused || state.skills.hook > 0) return;
   404	    const enemy = nearestEnemy();
   405	    if (!enemy) return;
   406	    state.skills.hook = 11;
   407	    damageEnemy(enemy, currentDps() * 4.2, '#c19cff');
   408	    enemy.stun = 1.8;
   409	    enemy.x = state.hero.x + clamp(enemy.x - state.hero.x, -82, 82);
   410	    enemy.y = state.hero.y - 116;
   411	    spawnParticles(state.hero.x, state.hero.y - 45, '#c19cff', 24, 160);
   412	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 12);
   413	    tone(250, .25, 'sawtooth', .035);
   414	  }
   415	
   416	  function dodge(dx, dy) {
   417	    if (state.phase !== 'playing' || state.manualOpen || state.orientationPaused || state.tabPaused || state.hero.rollCooldown > 0 || state.hero.rollTime > 0) return;
   418	    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   419	    state.hero.rollDx = dx / length;
   420	    state.hero.rollDy = dy / length;
   421	    state.hero.rollTime = .34;
   422	    state.hero.rollCooldown = 1.35;
   423	    state.hero.invuln = .44;
   424	    spawnParticles(state.hero.x, state.hero.y, '#f3b66d', 15, 110);
   425	    tone(380, .08, 'triangle', .025);
   426	  }
   427	
   428	  function takeDamage(amount) {
   429	    if (state.hero.invuln > 0 || state.phase !== 'playing') return;
   430	    state.hero.hp = clamp(state.hero.hp - Math.max(1, amount), 0, state.hero.maxHp);
   431	    state.hitFlash = .15;
   432	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 10);
   433	    spawnParticles(state.hero.x, state.hero.y, '#f76f73', 12, 105);
   434	    addDamageNumber(state.hero.x, state.hero.y - 35, `-${Math.round(amount)}`, '#f76f73');
   435	    tone(90, .12, 'sawtooth', .04);
   436	    if (state.hero.hp <= 0) enterDeath();
   437	  }
   438	
   439	  function enterDeath() {
   440	    releaseAllInput();
   441	    clearPendingTimers();
   442	    state.phase = 'dead';
   443	    saveProgress();
   444	    syncStatusPanel();
   445	  }
   446	
   447	  function enterClear() {
   448	    state.phase = state.floor === 30 ? 'win' : 'clear';
   449	    state.highestFloor = Math.max(state.highestFloor, state.floor);
   450	    if (state.floor === 30 && (!state.bestTime || state.runSeconds < state.bestTime)) state.bestTime = state.runSeconds;
   451	    saveProgress();
   452	    releaseAllInput();
   453	    syncStatusPanel();
   454	    tone(state.floor === 30 ? 760 : 480, .32, 'triangle', .045);
   455	  }
   456	
   457	  function update(dt) {
   458	    if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;
   459	    state.runSeconds += dt;
   460	    state.floorTime += dt;
   461	    state.skills.pulse = Math.max(0, state.skills.pulse - dt);
   462	    state.skills.hook = Math.max(0, state.skills.hook - dt);
   463	    state.hero.rollCooldown = Math.max(0, state.hero.rollCooldown - dt);
   464	    state.hero.invuln = Math.max(0, state.hero.invuln - dt);
   465	    state.hitFlash = Math.max(0, state.hitFlash - dt);
   466	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 26);
   467	
   468	    if (state.hero.rollTime > 0) {
   469	      state.hero.rollTime = Math.max(0, state.hero.rollTime - dt);
   470	      state.hero.x += state.hero.rollDx * 250 * dt;
   471	      state.hero.y += state.hero.rollDy * 180 * dt;
   472	      state.hero.x = clamp(state.hero.x, 48, viewW - 48);
   473	      state.hero.y = clamp(state.hero.y, 155, viewH - 160);
   474	    }
   475	
   476	    state.spawnClock -= dt;
   477	    if (state.spawnClock <= 0 && state.spawnQueue.length && state.enemies.length < 4) {
   478	      spawnNextEnemy();
   479	      state.spawnClock = .72;
   480	    }
   481	
   482	    state.hero.attackClock -= dt;
   483	    if (state.hero.attackClock <= 0) {
   484	      const target = nearestEnemy();
   485	      if (target) {
   486	        const attackInterval = .72;
   487	        damageEnemy(target, currentDps() * attackInterval, '#f0e8d9');
   488	        state.hero.attackClock = attackInterval;
   489	        spawnParticles(state.hero.x, state.hero.y - 20, '#f0e8d9', 3, 35);
   490	        tone(290, .045, 'sine', .012);
   491	      } else state.hero.attackClock = .15;
   492	    }
   493	
   494	    for (const enemy of state.enemies) {
   495	      if (enemy.dead) continue;
   496	      enemy.phase += dt;
   497	      enemy.stun = Math.max(0, enemy.stun - dt);
   498	      if (enemy.stun > 0) continue;
   499	      const dx = state.hero.x - enemy.x;
   500	      const dy = state.hero.y - enemy.y;
   501	      const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   502	      if (distance > 112) {
   503	        enemy.x += dx / distance * enemy.speed * dt;
   504	        enemy.y += dy / distance * enemy.speed * dt;
   505	      } else {
   506	        enemy.attackClock -= dt;
   507	        if (enemy.attackClock <= 0) {
   508	          enemy.attackClock = enemy.attackGap;
   509	          takeDamage(enemy.damage);
   510	        }
   511	      }
   512	    }
   513	
   514	    state.enemies = state.enemies.filter((enemy) => !enemy.dead);
   515	    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   516	      const particle = state.particles[i];
   517	      particle.life -= dt;
   518	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   519	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   520	      particle.vx *= .96;

   759	  function handleSurfaceDown(event) {
   760	    if (state.manualOpen || state.orientationPaused || surfacePointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS) return;
   761	    event.preventDefault();

   763	    surfacePointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, time: performance.now() });

   765	  }

   767	  function handleSurfaceMove(event) {
   768	    if (!surfacePointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;
   769	    event.preventDefault();
   770	  }
   771	
   772	  function handleSurfaceUp(event) {
   773	    const start = surfacePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   774	    if (!start) return;
   775	    event.preventDefault();
   776	    surfacePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   777	    const dx = event.clientX - start.x;
   778	    const dy = event.clientY - start.y;
   779	    if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) >= 38 && performance.now() - start.time < 900) dodge(dx, dy);
   780	  }

   784	  function keyDown(event) {
   785	    if (state.manualOpen || state.orientationPaused) return;
   786	    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
   787	    if (['j', 'k', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown'].includes(key)) event.preventDefault();
   788	    if (!['j', 'k', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown'].includes(key)) return;
   789	    if (event.repeat) { pressedKeys.add(key); return; }
   790	    if (pressedKeys.size < 8) pressedKeys.add(key);
   791	    unlockAudio();
   792	    if (key === 'j') usePulse();
   793	    if (key === 'k') useHook();
   794	    if (key === 'arrowleft') dodge(-1, 0);
   795	    if (key === 'arrowright') dodge(1, 0);
   796	    if (key === 'arrowup') dodge(0, -1);
   797	    if (key === 'arrowdown') dodge(0, 1);
   798	  }
   799	
   800	  function keyUp(event) { pressedKeys.delete(event.key.toLowerCase()); }

   802	  function loop(now) {

  // random-playout validation: bump the move budget until a random bot clears it often enough
  BC.getLevel = function (n) {

      if (lv.target > 900) lv.target = Math.round(lv.target * 0.94);

    LEVEL_CACHE[n] = lv;
    return lv;
  };

/* Chroma Tap - board model, level generation, collapse / special resolution */
(function (g) {
  'use strict';

  var COLS = 7, ROWS = 8, MAXLV = 25;
  var SP_NONE = 0, SP_ROCKET = 1, SP_BOMB = 2, SP_ORB = 3;

  /* ---------- level generation (seeded, deterministic) ---------- */
  function levelDef(n) {
    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAXLV, n | 0));
    var r = g.CT.rng(9176 + n * 7919);
    var colors = n <= 2 ? 4 : (n <= 8 ? 5 : (n % 4 === 0 ? 6 : 5));
    var goals = { crate: 0, balloon: 0, gear: 0, pop: 0 };
    var popColor = 0;

    goals.crate = Math.min(8, 3 + Math.floor(n / 3));
    if (n >= 4) goals.balloon = Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor((n - 4) / 6));
    if (n >= 7) goals.gear = Math.min(3, 1 + Math.floor((n - 7) / 7));
    if (n >= 10 && n % 3 === 1) { goals.pop = 24 + ((n * 5) % 16); popColor = r.int(colors); }

    mv = mv * (1.34 - n * 0.008) * (colors === 6 ? 1.18 : 1);
    mv = Math.round(mv);
    var moves = Math.max(15, Math.min(72, mv));

    return {
      n: n, colors: colors, moves: moves, goals: goals, popColor: popColor,
      seed: 9176 + n * 7919
    };
  }

  var uid = 1;

    return { k: 'b', c: c, sp: SP_NONE, oy: 0, vy: 0, sc: 1, dead: 0, flash: 0, id: uid++ };

  function mkObj(kind, c) {
    return { k: kind, c: c || 0, sp: SP_NONE, oy: 0, vy: 0, sc: 1, dead: 0, flash: 0, hp: 1, id: uid++ };
  }

  function Board(def) {
    this.def = def;
    this.cols = COLS; this.rows = ROWS;
    this.rng = g.CT.rng(def.seed);
    this.cells = new Array(COLS * ROWS);
    this.queue = [];          // per column: array of upcoming colors
    this.movesLeft = def.moves;
    this.movesUsed = 0;
    this.score = 0;
    this.prog = { crate: 0, balloon: 0, gear: 0, pop: 0 };
    this.over = 0;            // 0 running, 1 win, -1 lose
    this.stars = 0;
    this.events = [];         // visual events for the renderer
    this.shuffles = 0;
    this.build();
  }

  Board.prototype.idx = function (x, y) { return y * this.cols + x; };
  Board.prototype.at = function (x, y) {
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= this.cols || y >= this.rows) return null;
    return this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
  };
  Board.prototype.set = function (x, y, v) { this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = v; };

  Board.prototype.rc = function () { return this.rng.int(this.def.colors); };

  Board.prototype.build = function () {
    var x, y, i;
    for (i = 0; i < COLS * ROWS; i++) this.cells[i] = mkBlock(this.rc());
    this.queue = [];
    for (x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
      var q = [];
      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) q.push(this.rc());
      this.queue.push(q);
    }
    // obstacles. Gears go first and keep a clear chute of plain blocks beneath
    // them, so digging a gear out is always a solvable line of play.
    var gl = this.def.goals, k, tries, blocked = {}, usedCol = {};
    for (k = 0; k < gl.gear; k++) {
      for (tries = 0; tries < 80; tries++) {
        x = this.rng.int(COLS);
        y = 1 + this.rng.int(3);
        if (usedCol[x]) continue;
        var gc = this.at(x, y);
        if (!gc || gc.k !== 'b') continue;
        usedCol[x] = 1;
        this.set(x, y, mkObj('gear'));
        for (var yy = y + 1; yy < ROWS; yy++) blocked[x + ',' + yy] = 1;
        break;
      }
    }
    var spots = [];
    for (k = 0; k < gl.crate; k++) spots.push(['crate', 2, ROWS - 2]);
    for (k = 0; k < gl.balloon; k++) spots.push(['balloon', ROWS - 3, ROWS - 1]);
    for (k = 0; k < spots.length; k++) {
      for (tries = 0; tries < 90; tries++) {
        x = this.rng.int(COLS);
        y = spots[k][1] + this.rng.int(spots[k][2] - spots[k][1] + 1);
        if (blocked[x + ',' + y]) continue;
        var c = this.at(x, y);
        if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
        // keep obstacles apart: a crate ringed by crates can become unreachable
        if (tries < 70 && this.neighborObstacles(x, y) > 0) continue;
        this.set(x, y, mkObj(spots[k][0]));
        break;
      }
    }
    // guarantee a legal opening move
    for (tries = 0; tries < 30 && !this.hasMove(); tries++) this.shuffleColors();
  };

  Board.prototype.neighborObstacles = function (x, y) {
    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      var c = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
      if (c && c.k !== 'b') n++;
    }
    return n;
  };

  /* ---------- groups ---------- */
  Board.prototype.groupAt = function (x, y) {
    var c = this.at(x, y);
    if (!c || c.k !== 'b' || c.sp !== SP_NONE) return [];
    var seen = {}, out = [], st = [[x, y]];
    seen[x + ',' + y] = 1;
    while (st.length) {
      var p = st.pop(), px = p[0], py = p[1];
      out.push(p);
      var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        var nx = px + d[i][0], ny = py + d[i][1], key = nx + ',' + ny;
        if (seen[key]) continue;
        var q = this.at(nx, ny);
        if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE && q.c === c.c) { seen[key] = 1; st.push([nx, ny]); }
      }
    }
    return out;
  };

  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      var c = this.at(x, y);
      if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
      if (c.sp !== SP_NONE) return true;
      var r = this.at(x + 1, y), d = this.at(x, y + 1);
      if (r && r.k === 'b' && r.sp === SP_NONE && r.c === c.c) return true;
      if (d && d.k === 'b' && d.sp === SP_NONE && d.c === c.c) return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  Board.prototype.shuffleColors = function () {
    var list = [], i, x, y;
    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      var c = this.at(x, y);
      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) list.push(c);
    }
    for (i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      var j = this.rng.int(i + 1), t = list[i].c; list[i].c = list[j].c; list[j].c = t;
    }
    this.shuffles++;
  };

  /* ---------- clearing ---------- */
  Board.prototype._mark = function (x, y, set) {
    var c = this.at(x, y);
    if (!c || set[c.id]) return null;
    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
    return c;
  };

  // Damage obstacles neighbouring a set of coords
  Board.prototype._splash = function (coords, set) {
    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
    for (var i = 0; i < coords.length; i++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < d.length; j++) {
        var nx = coords[i][0] + d[j][0], ny = coords[i][1] + d[j][1];
        var c = this.at(nx, ny);
        if (!c) continue;
        if (c.k === 'crate' || c.k === 'balloon') this._mark(nx, ny, set);
      }
    }
  };

  Board.prototype.blastOf = function (x, y, c, set, queue) {
    var i, j;
    if (c.sp === SP_ROCKET) {
      if (c.rot) { for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) this._hit(x, j, set, queue); }
      if (c.rot) { for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) this._hit(x, j, set, queue); }
      else { for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) this._hit(i, y, set, queue); }
    } else if (c.sp === SP_BOMB) {
      for (i = -2; i <= 2; i++) for (j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
        if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 3) this._hit(x + i, y + j, set, queue);
      }
    } else if (c.sp === SP_ORB) {
      var col = (typeof c.orbColor === 'number') ? c.orbColor : this.commonColor();
      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
        var t = this.at(i, j);
        if (t && t.k === 'b' && (t.c === col || t.sp !== SP_NONE)) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
      }
    }
  };

  Board.prototype._hit = function (x, y, set, queue) {
    var c = this.at(x, y);
    if (!c || set[c.id]) return;
    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
      if (queue.length < 96) queue.push([x, y, c]);
      return;
    }
    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
  };

  Board.prototype.commonColor = function () {
    var cnt = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], x, y, best = 0;
    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      var c = this.at(x, y);
      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) cnt[c.c]++;
    }
    for (x = 1; x < 6; x++) if (cnt[x] > cnt[best]) best = x;
    return best;
  };

  // Fire one or more specials, chaining. Returns cleared set map.
  Board.prototype.fireSpecials = function (starts) {
    var set = {}, queue = starts.slice(), guard = 0;
    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
      var e = queue.shift(), x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
      if (set[c.id]) continue;
      set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
      this.events.push({ t: c.sp === SP_ORB ? 'orb' : (c.sp === SP_BOMB ? 'bomb' : 'rocket'), x: x, y: y, rot: c.rot || 0 });
      this.blastOf(x, y, c, set, queue);
    }
    var coords = [], k;
    for (k in set) coords.push([set[k][0], set[k][1]]);
    this._splash(coords, set);
    return set;
  };

  // Combine two adjacent specials into a bigger effect
  Board.prototype.combo = function (a, b) {
    var set = {}, queue = [], lo = Math.min(a[2].sp, b[2].sp), hi = Math.max(a[2].sp, b[2].sp);
    var ax = a[0], ay = a[1], i, j;
    set[a[2].id] = a; set[b[2].id] = b;
    this.events.push({ t: 'combo', x: ax, y: ay, kind: lo + '' + hi });
    if (lo === SP_ROCKET && hi === SP_ROCKET) {
      for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) { this._hit(i, ay, set, queue); this._hit(i, b[1], set, queue); }
      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) { this._hit(ax, j, set, queue); this._hit(b[0], j, set, queue); }
    } else if (lo === SP_ROCKET && hi === SP_BOMB) {
      for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) for (j = -1; j <= 1; j++) this._hit(i, ay + j, set, queue);
      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = -1; i <= 1; i++) this._hit(ax + i, j, set, queue);
    } else if (lo === SP_BOMB && hi === SP_BOMB) {
      for (i = -3; i <= 3; i++) for (j = -3; j <= 3; j++)
        if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 4) this._hit(ax + i, ay + j, set, queue);
    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_ORB) {
      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_ROCKET) {
      var col = this.commonColor();
      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
        var t = this.at(i, j);
        if (t && t.k === 'b' && t.c === col) {
          var k2;
          for (k2 = 0; k2 < this.cols; k2++) this._hit(k2, j, set, queue);
          for (k2 = 0; k2 < this.rows; k2++) this._hit(i, k2, set, queue);
        }
      }
    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_BOMB) {
      var col2 = this.commonColor();
      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
        var t2 = this.at(i, j);
        if (t2 && t2.k === 'b' && t2.c === col2) {
          for (var di = -1; di <= 1; di++) for (var dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) this._hit(i + di, j + dj, set, queue);
        }
      }
    }
    // chain any specials swept up
    var guard = 0;
    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
      var e = queue.shift();
      if (set[e[2].id]) continue;
      set[e[2].id] = e;
      this.events.push({ t: e[2].sp === SP_ORB ? 'orb' : (e[2].sp === SP_BOMB ? 'bomb' : 'rocket'), x: e[0], y: e[1], rot: e[2].rot || 0 });
      this.blastOf(e[0], e[1], e[2], set, queue);
    }
    var coords = [], k;
    for (k in set) coords.push([set[k][0], set[k][1]]);
    this._splash(coords, set);
    return set;
  };

  /* ---------- player action ---------- */
  // returns null (illegal) or {cleared:[cells], made:cellOrNull}
  Board.prototype.tap = function (x, y) {
    if (this.over) return null;
    var c = this.at(x, y);
    if (!c) return null;
    this.events.length = 0;

    var set = null, made = null, n = 0;

    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
      // adjacent special => combo
      var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], partner = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
        if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp !== SP_NONE) { partner = [x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1], q]; break; }
      }
      if (c.sp === SP_ORB && !partner) c.orbColor = this.bestNeighborColor(x, y);
      set = partner ? this.combo([x, y, c], partner) : this.fireSpecials([[x, y, c]]);
    } else {
      var grp = this.groupAt(x, y);
      if (grp.length < 2) return null;
      n = grp.length;
      set = {};
      var sp = n >= 9 ? SP_ORB : (n >= 7 ? SP_BOMB : (n >= 5 ? SP_ROCKET : SP_NONE));
      for (var k = 0; k < grp.length; k++) {
        var gx = grp[k][0], gy = grp[k][1];
        if (sp && gx === x && gy === y) continue;   // seed cell survives as the special
        var cc = this.at(gx, gy);
        set[cc.id] = [gx, gy, cc];
      }
      this._splash(grp, set);
      if (sp) {
        made = this.at(x, y);
        made.sp = sp;
        made.rot = (x + y) % 2;
        if (sp === SP_ORB) made.orbColor = made.c;
        made.flash = 1;
        this.events.push({ t: 'make', x: x, y: y, sp: sp });
      }
      this.events.push({ t: 'pop', x: x, y: y, n: n });
    }

    var cleared = this.applyClear(set);
    if (!cleared.length && !made) return null;

    var base = Math.max(cleared.length, n);
    this.score += base * base * 6 + cleared.length * 12;
    this.movesLeft--; this.movesUsed++;

    this.settle();
    this.endOfMove();
    return { cleared: cleared, made: made, n: cleared.length };
  };

  Board.prototype.bestNeighborColor = function (x, y) {
    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], best = -1, bn = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
      if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE) {
        var n = this.groupAt(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]).length;
        if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = q.c; }
      }
    }
    return best < 0 ? this.commonColor() : best;
  };

  // Remove all cells in set, tally goals. Returns list of [x,y,cell]
  Board.prototype.applyClear = function (set) {
    var out = [], k;
    for (k in set) {
      var e = set[k], x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
      if (this.at(x, y) !== c) continue;
      if (c.k === 'crate') this.prog.crate++;
      else if (c.k === 'balloon') this.prog.balloon++;
      else if (c.k === 'gear') {
        // plain collapses never touch a gear (see _splash); only a blast knocks it loose
        this.prog.gear++;
        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: y });
      }
      else if (c.k === 'b' && c.c === this.def.popColor) this.prog.pop++;
      this.set(x, y, null);
      out.push(e);
    }
    return out;
  };

  /* ---------- gravity + refill ---------- */
  Board.prototype.settle = function () {
    var x, y, CELL = 1;
    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      var write = this.rows - 1;
      for (y = this.rows - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
        var c = this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
        if (!c) continue;
        if (write !== y) {
          this.cells[write * this.cols + x] = c;
          this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = null;
          c.oy = (y - write) * CELL;   // rows above (negative), scaled by renderer
          c.vy = 0;
        }
        write--;
      }
      for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
        var q = this.queue[x];
        while (q.length < 4) q.push(this.rc());
        if (q.length > 8) q.length = 8;
        var nb = mkBlock(q.shift());
        q.push(this.rc());
        nb.oy = -(write - y + 1);
        nb.vy = 0;
        this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = nb;
      }
    }
  };

  /* ---------- end of move ---------- */
  Board.prototype.endOfMove = function () {
    var x, y, c;
    // gears are heavy: each move they sink one row through a plain block
    for (y = this.rows - 2; y >= 0; y--) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      c = this.at(x, y);
      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
        var dn = this.at(x, y + 1);
        if (dn && dn.k === 'b' && dn.sp === SP_NONE) {
          this.set(x, y + 1, c); this.set(x, y, dn);
          c.oy = -1; dn.oy = 1;
        }
      }
    }
    // gears reaching the floor are collected
    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      c = this.at(x, this.rows - 1);
      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
        this.prog.gear++;
        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: this.rows - 1 });
        this.set(x, this.rows - 1, null);
      }
    }
    // balloons rise one cell (swap with a plain block above)
    var risers = [];
    for (y = 1; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
      c = this.at(x, y);
      if (c && c.k === 'balloon' && !c._rose) {
        var up = this.at(x, y - 1);
        if (up && up.k === 'b') {
          this.set(x, y - 1, c); this.set(x, y, up);
          c.oy = 1; up.oy = -1; c._rose = 1; risers.push(c);
        }
      }
    }
    for (x = 0; x < risers.length; x++) risers[x]._rose = 0;
    this.settle();

    // goal / fail evaluation
    var gl = this.def.goals, done =
      this.prog.crate >= gl.crate && this.prog.balloon >= gl.balloon &&
      this.prog.gear >= gl.gear && this.prog.pop >= gl.pop;
    if (done) {
      this.over = 1;
      var ratio = this.movesLeft / Math.max(1, this.def.moves);
      this.stars = ratio >= 0.38 ? 3 : (ratio >= 0.15 ? 2 : 1);
      this.score += this.movesLeft * 120;
    } else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) {
      this.over = -1;
    } else {
      var guard = 0;
      while (!this.hasMove() && guard++ < 30) this.shuffleColors();
    }
    if (this.score > 99999999) this.score = 99999999;
  };

  Board.prototype.goalsLeft = function () {
    var gl = this.def.goals, out = [];
    if (gl.crate) out.push({ k: 'crate', need: gl.crate, have: Math.min(gl.crate, this.prog.crate) });
    if (gl.balloon) out.push({ k: 'balloon', need: gl.balloon, have: Math.min(gl.balloon, this.prog.balloon) });
    if (gl.gear) out.push({ k: 'gear', need: gl.gear, have: Math.min(gl.gear, this.prog.gear) });
    if (gl.pop) out.push({ k: 'pop', need: gl.pop, have: Math.min(gl.pop, this.prog.pop), c: this.def.popColor });
    return out;
/* Reef Tiles - match-3 board + level screen */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var G = window.G;
  var COLS = 7, ROWS = 8, NT = 6;
  var GEM = [
    { c: '#ff7a63', d: '#b8402f', n: 'Coral' },
    { c: '#5fd97a', d: '#2b8a45', n: 'Kelp' },
    { c: '#4fc9ef', d: '#1c7fa4', n: 'Bubble' },
    { c: '#ffd75e', d: '#c39118', n: 'Star' },
    { c: '#a98bff', d: '#6248b8', n: 'Pebble' },
    { c: '#ff8ad0', d: '#c0478d', n: 'Shell' }
  ];
  G.GEM = GEM;

  /* ---- deterministic level table ---- */
  G.LEVELS = 15;
  G.levelCfg = function (i) {
    var r = G.mulberry32(4242 + i * 911);
    var order = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    for (var k = order.length - 1; k > 0; k--) { var j = Math.floor(r() * (k + 1)); var t = order[k]; order[k] = order[j]; order[j] = t; }
    var n = i < 4 ? 1 : (i < 9 ? 2 : 3);
    var moves = 24 + (i % 3) * 2 + (n === 3 ? 4 : n === 2 ? 2 : 0);
    var per = Math.max(8, Math.round(moves * (0.40 + 0.008 * i)));
    var goals = [];
    for (var g = 0; g < n; g++) goals.push({ t: order[g], need: per, got: 0 });
    var base = 1100 + i * 110;
    return {
      idx: i, seed: 9001 + i * 137, moves: moves, goals: goals,
      stars: [base, Math.round(base * 1.8), Math.round(base * 2.6)],
      pearls: 18 + i * 3
    };
  };
  G.bandOf = function (i) { return i < 5 ? 0 : i < 10 ? 1 : 2; };
  G.BAND_COMFORT = [0, 30, 60];

  /* ---- board ---- */
  var B = G.board = {
    grid: [], rng: null, cfg: null, phase: 'idle', ph: 0,
    sel: null, cur: { r: 4, c: 3 }, swapA: null, swapB: null,
    score: 0, moves: 0, chain: 0, over: 0, pearlsWon: 0, starsWon: 0,
    flash: 0, dragId: -1, popped: []
  };

  function mk(t) { return { t: t, sp: 0, ox: 0, oy: 0, sc: 1, pop: 0 }; }

  function fill() {
    B.grid = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      var row = [];
      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        var t, guard = 0;
        do {
          t = Math.floor(B.rng() * NT);
          guard++;
        } while (guard < 24 && (
          (c >= 2 && row[c - 1] && row[c - 2] && row[c - 1].t === t && row[c - 2].t === t) ||
          (r >= 2 && B.grid[r - 1][c].t === t && B.grid[r - 2][c].t === t)
        ));
        row.push(mk(t));
      }
      B.grid.push(row);
    }
    var guard2 = 0;
    while (!hasMove() && guard2++ < 30) shuffle();
  }

  function shuffle() {
    var list = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) list.push(B.grid[r][c].t);
    for (var i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { var j = Math.floor(B.rng() * (i + 1)); var t = list[i]; list[i] = list[j]; list[j] = t; }
    var k = 0;
    for (r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (c = 0; c < COLS; c++) { B.grid[r][c].t = list[k++]; B.grid[r][c].sp = 0; }
  }

  function matchRuns() {
    var runs = [];
    var r, c, s, i;
    for (r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      s = 0;
      for (c = 1; c <= COLS; c++) {
        var same = c < COLS && B.grid[r][c].t === B.grid[r][s].t;
        if (!same) {
          if (c - s >= 3) { var cells = []; for (i = s; i < c; i++) cells.push(r * COLS + i); runs.push({ cells: cells, len: c - s, h: true }); }
          s = c;
        }
      }
    }
    for (c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      s = 0;
      for (r = 1; r <= ROWS; r++) {
        var same2 = r < ROWS && B.grid[r][c].t === B.grid[s][c].t;
        if (!same2) {
          if (r - s >= 3) { var cl = []; for (i = s; i < r; i++) cl.push(i * COLS + c); runs.push({ cells: cl, len: r - s, h: false }); }
          s = r;
        }
      }
    }
    return runs;
  }
/* Terrace Tales - match-3 board model */
(function (T) {
  'use strict';

  var SP_NONE = 0, SP_ROW = 1, SP_COL = 2, SP_BOMB = 3, SP_PRISM = 4;
  T.SP = { NONE: SP_NONE, ROW: SP_ROW, COL: SP_COL, BOMB: SP_BOMB, PRISM: SP_PRISM };

  function Board(cols, rows, ntypes, seed) {
    this.cols = cols; this.rows = rows; this.n = ntypes;
    this.rand = T.rng(seed);
    this.g = new Array(cols * rows);
    this.reset();
  }
  Board.prototype.i = function (c, r) { return r * this.cols + c; };
  Board.prototype.at = function (c, r) {
    if (c < 0 || r < 0 || c >= this.cols || r >= this.rows) return null;
    return this.g[r * this.cols + c];
  };
  Board.prototype.mk = function (t) { return { t: t, sp: SP_NONE, off: 0, pop: 0, dead: false, glow: 0 }; };

  Board.prototype.reset = function () {
    var tries = 0;
    do {
      for (var r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
        for (var c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
          var bad, t, guard = 0;
          do {
            t = (this.rand() * this.n) | 0;

  function rand() {
    rngState ^= rngState << 13;
    rngState ^= rngState >>> 17;
    rngState ^= rngState << 5;
    return ((rngState >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000;

  function randomTile() {
    return Math.floor(rand() * TILE.length) % TILE.length;
  }

  function indexAt(col, row) {
    return row * COLS + col;
  }

  function makeBoard(seed) {
    rngState = seed >>> 0 || 1;
    const next = Array(CELL_COUNT).fill(0);
    for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row += 1) {
      for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col += 1) {
        let tile = randomTile();
        let tries = 0;
        while (tries < 12 && ((col >= 2 && next[indexAt(col - 1, row)] === tile && next[indexAt(col - 2, row)] === tile) || (row >= 2 && next[indexAt(col, row - 1)] === tile && next[indexAt(col, row - 2)] === tile))) {
          tile = randomTile();
          tries += 1;
        }
        next[indexAt(col, row)] = tile;
      }
    }
    board = next;
    if (!hasAnyMove()) shuffleBoard();
    return board;
  }

  function findMatches() {
    const matches = new Set();
    for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row += 1) {
      let start = 0;
      while (start < COLS) {
        const tile = board[indexAt(start, row)];
        let end = start + 1;
        while (end < COLS && tile !== null && board[indexAt(end, row)] === tile) end += 1;
        if (tile !== null && end - start >= 3) for (let col = start; col < end; col += 1) matches.add(indexAt(col, row));
        start = end;
      }
    }
    for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col += 1) {
      let start = 0;
      while (start < ROWS) {
        const tile = board[indexAt(col, start)];
        let end = start + 1;
        while (end < ROWS && tile !== null && board[indexAt(col, end)] === tile) end += 1;
        if (tile !== null && end - start >= 3) for (let row = start; row < end; row += 1) matches.add(indexAt(col, row));
        start = end;
      }
    }
    return matches;
  }

  function hasAnyMove() {
    for (let i = 0; i < CELL_COUNT; i += 1) {
      const col = i % COLS;
      const row = Math.floor(i / COLS);
      if (col < COLS - 1) {
        const other = i + 1;
        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
        const match = findMatches().size > 0;
        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
        if (match) return true;
      }
      if (row < ROWS - 1) {
        const other = i + COLS;
        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
        const match = findMatches().size > 0;
        [board[i], board[other]] = [board[other], board[i]];
        if (match) return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function shuffleBoard() {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
      for (let i = CELL_COUNT - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
        const j = Math.floor(rand() * (i + 1));
        [board[i], board[j]] = [board[j], board[i]];
      }
      if (findMatches().size === 0 && hasAnyMove()) return;
    }
    board = makeBoard((rngState + 17) >>> 0);
  }

        x, y, vx: (rand() - 0.5) * 150, vy: -40 - rand() * 150,
        life, maxLife: life, color, size: 2 + rand() * 4
      });
    }
  }

   110	function canRoll() { return G.state === 'idle' && G.winner < 0; }

   112	function doRoll() {
   113	  if (G.state !== 'idle' && G.state !== 'rival') return;
   114	  var p = G.players[G.cur];
   115	  G.state = 'rolling';
   116	  G.diceSpin = 0.62;
   117	  Snd.play('roll');
   118	  TM.add(0.62, function () {
   119	    var a = 1 + rint(6), b = 1 + rint(6);
   120	    G.dice = [a, b];
   121	    G.doubles = (a === b);

   127	    beginMove(p, a + b);
   128	  });
   129	}

   373	/* ---------- end of a landing ---------- */
   374	function finishLanding(p) {
   375	  if (checkWin(p)) return;
   376	  G.state = 'wait';
   377	  TM.add(p.ai ? 0.45 : 0.3, function () { endTurn(p); });
   378	}
   379	
   380	function checkWin(p) {
   381	  if (p.dist[0] === 3 && p.dist[1] === 3 && p.dist[2] === 3 && p.dist[3] === 3) {
   382	    G.winner = p.i;
   383	    G.state = 'over';
   384	    TM.clear();
   385	    if (p.i === 0) {
   386	      G.boardsWon++;
   387	      if (G.bestTurns === 0 || G.turns < G.bestTurns) G.bestTurns = G.turns;
   388	      Store.write({ boardsWon: G.boardsWon, bestTurns: G.bestTurns, level: G.level + 1 });
   389	      Snd.play('win'); shake(16);
   390	      if (typeof parts !== 'undefined') parts.burst(195, 300, '#ffd24a', 40, 260, 1.1);
   391	    } else {
   392	      Store.write({ boardsWon: G.boardsWon, bestTurns: G.bestTurns, level: G.level });
   393	      Snd.play('lose'); shake(10);
   394	    }
   395	    logAdd(p.name + ' completes the row.');
   396	    return true;
   397	  }
   398	  return false;
   399	}
   400	
   401	function endTurn(p) {
   402	  if (G.winner >= 0) return;
   403	  if (G.doubles) {
   404	    G.doubles = false;
   405	    logAdd(p.name + ' rolled doubles - rolls again.');
   406	    if (p.ai) { G.state = 'rival'; TM.add(0.4, doRoll); }
   407	    else G.state = 'idle';
   408	    return;
   409	  }
   410	  G.doubles = false; G.extra = 0;
   411	  G.cur = (G.cur + 1) % 4;
   412	  if (G.cur === 0) {
   413	    G.turns++;
   414	    G.state = 'idle';
   415	  } else {
   416	    G.state = 'rival';
   417	    Snd.play('rival');
   418	    TM.add(0.5, doRoll);
   419	  }
   420	}

   422	/* ---------- per-frame sim ---------- */
   423	function stepGame(dt) {
   424	  if (G.state === 'start' || G.state === 'over') { TM.update(dt); return; }
   425	  G.elapsed += dt;
   426	  if (G.diceSpin > 0) G.diceSpin -= dt;
   427	  if (G.stickerT > 0) G.stickerT -= dt;
   428	  if (G.state === 'moving') {
   429	    G.hopT += dt;
   430	    while (G.hopT >= 0.12 && G.moveLeft > 0) {
   431	      G.hopT -= 0.12;
   432	      stepHop(G.players[G.cur]);
   433	    }
   434	  }
   435	  TM.update(dt);
   436	}

    73	var lastT = 0;
    74	function frame(now) {
    75	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    76	  var dt = (now - lastT) / 1000;
    77	  lastT = now;
    78	  if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
    79	  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
    80	  if (Game.paused || document.hidden) return;

    86	function update(dt) {
    87	  if (Game.state === 'run') {
    88	    Run.update(dt);
    89	    if (Run.done) {
    90	      if (Run.wiped) { Base.cleared = 0; gameOver('wiped'); Sfx.lose(); }
    91	      else { Game.state = 'arrive'; Game.arriveT = 1.5; Game.survivors = Run.n; Sfx.win(); Fx.bang('#7ee0a8', 0.5); }
    92	    }
    93	  } else if (Game.state === 'arrive') {
    94	    Game.arriveT -= dt;

    96	    var ps = Input.list();

    98	    if (Game.arriveT <= 0) toBase(Game.survivors);
    99	  } else if (Game.state === 'base') {
   100	    Base.update(dt);
   101	    if (Base.result) gameOver(Base.result);
   102	  } else if (Game.state === 'over') {
   103	    var t = Input.consumeTap();
   104	    Input.releases.length = 0;
   105	    if (t && Game.overBtn && inRect(t, Game.overBtn)) newGame();
   106	    else if (t) newGame();
   107	  }
   108	  Fx.update(dt);
   109	}

     1	/* Aftergate - RUN phase: steer the marching squad through gates. */
     2	'use strict';
     3	
     4	var LANE_L = 46, LANE_R = 494, SQUAD_Y = 742, TOTAL = 5200, RUN_SPEED = 252;
     5	var MAX_SQUAD = 300;
     6	
     7	var Run = {
     8	  objs: [], prog: 0, n: 0, x: 270, vx: 0, done: false, wiped: false,
     9	  hint: 0, inv: 0, flashT: 0, tail: [],
    10	
    11	  init: function (startN) {
    12	    this.objs.length = 0; this.tail.length = 0;
    13	    this.prog = 0; this.n = startN || 5; this.x = (LANE_L + LANE_R) / 2;
    14	    this.vx = 0; this.done = false; this.wiped = false; this.hint = 5.5;
    15	    this.inv = 0; this.flashT = 0;
    16	    this.gen();
    17	  },
    18	
    19	  gen: function () {
    20	    var y = 620, i = 0, guard = 0;
    21	    while (y < TOTAL - 380 && guard++ < 64) {
    22	      var t = y / TOTAL, k = i % 4;
    23	      if (k === 0 || k === 2) this.objs.push(this.mkGate(y, t));
    24	      else if (k === 1) this.objs.push(this.mkMob(y, t));
    25	      else this.objs.push(this.mkSaw(y, t));
    26	      y += 330 + rndi(0, 90);
    27	      i++;
    28	    }
    29	    // guaranteed final reward gate before the wall
    30	    this.objs.push(this.mkGate(TOTAL - 300, 1));
    31	    if (this.objs.length > 40) this.objs.length = 40;
    32	  },
    33	
    34	  mkGate: function (y, t) {
    35	    var goods = [
    36	      { op: 'mul', v: 2, s: '×2' },
    37	      { op: 'add', v: 7 + Math.round(15 * t), s: '' },
    38	      { op: 'add', v: 10 + Math.round(22 * t), s: '' },
    39	      { op: 'add', v: 9 + Math.round(18 * t), s: '' }
    40	    ];
    41	    if (t > 0.7) goods.push({ op: 'mul', v: 3, s: '×3' });
    42	    var bads = [
    43	      { op: 'div', v: 2, s: '÷2' },
    44	      { op: 'sub', v: 8 + Math.round(20 * t), s: '' },
    45	      { op: 'div', v: 2, s: '÷2' },
    46	      { op: 'sub', v: 12 + Math.round(26 * t), s: '' }
    47	    ];
    48	    var a, b;
    49	    if (Math.random() < 0.66) { a = pick(goods); b = pick(bads); }
    50	    else {
    51	      a = pick(goods); b = pick(goods);
    52	      if (a === b) b = { op: 'add', v: 6 + Math.round(10 * t), s: '' };
    53	    }
    54	    a = this.lbl(a); b = this.lbl(b);
    55	    if (Math.random() < 0.5) { var tmp = a; a = b; b = tmp; }
    56	    return { k: 'gate', y: y, L: a, R: b, hit: false };
    57	  },
    58	  lbl: function (o) {
    59	    var c = { op: o.op, v: o.v, s: o.s };
    60	    if (!c.s) c.s = (o.op === 'add' ? '+' : '−') + o.v;
    61	    c.good = (o.op === 'add' || o.op === 'mul');
    62	    return c;
    63	  },
    64	
    65	  mkMob: function (y, t) {
    66	    var r = Math.random(), side;
    67	    if (r < 0.29) side = 'L'; else if (r < 0.58) side = 'R'; else side = 'F';
    68	    return { k: 'mob', y: y, side: side, size: -1, dead: false, hurt: 0 };
    69	  },
    70	  mkSaw: function (y, t) {
    71	    return { k: 'saw', y: y, ph: rnd(0, 6.28), spd: 1.1 + t * 0.9, hit: false };
    72	  },
    73	
    74	  /* -------- update -------- */
    75	  update: function (dt) {
    76	    if (this.done) return;
    77	    this.hint = Math.max(0, this.hint - dt);
    78	    this.inv = Math.max(0, this.inv - dt);
    79	    this.flashT = Math.max(0, this.flashT - dt);
    80	
    81	    // steering: every pointer contributes its own delta (own pointerId)
    82	    var ps = Input.list(), i;
    83	    for (i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) { this.x += ps[i].dx * 1.06; ps[i].dx = 0; ps[i].dy = 0; }
    84	    var kv = 0;
    85	    if (Input.keys['ArrowLeft'] || Input.keys['a'] || Input.keys['A']) kv -= 1;
    86	    if (Input.keys['ArrowRight'] || Input.keys['d'] || Input.keys['D']) kv += 1;
    87	    this.x += kv * 430 * dt;
    88	    this.x = clamp(this.x, LANE_L + 20, LANE_R - 20);
    89	
    90	    var prev = this.prog;
    91	    this.prog += RUN_SPEED * dt;
    92	
    93	    // trail
    94	    this.tail.push({ x: this.x, y: this.prog });
    95	    if (this.tail.length > 26) this.tail.shift();
    96	
    97	    for (i = 0; i < this.objs.length; i++) {
    98	      var o = this.objs[i];
    99	      if (o.k === 'gate') {
   100	        if (!o.hit && prev < o.y && this.prog >= o.y) {
   101	          o.hit = true;
   102	          var side = (this.x < (LANE_L + LANE_R) / 2) ? o.L : o.R;
   103	          this.applyOp(side, o.y);
   104	        }
   105	      } else if (o.k === 'mob') {
   106	        if (o.size < 0 && o.y - this.prog < 900) o.size = Math.max(3, Math.round(this.n * (o.side === 'F' ? 0.32 : 0.44)));
   107	        if (!o.dead && prev < o.y && this.prog >= o.y) {
   108	          var span = this.mobSpan(o);
   109	          if (this.x > span[0] - 14 && this.x < span[1] + 14) {
   110	            o.dead = true;
   111	            this.n -= o.size;
   112	            Fx.pop(this.x, SQUAD_Y - 90, '−' + o.size, '#ff6b6b');
   113	            Fx.burst(this.x, SQUAD_Y - 40, 18, '#ff5555', 300);
   114	            Fx.kick(11); Fx.bang('#ff3b3b', 0.4); Sfx.thud();
   115	            this.flashT = 0.25;
   116	          }
   117	        }
   118	      } else if (o.k === 'saw') {
   119	        o.ph += dt * o.spd;
   120	        var sy = SQUAD_Y - (o.y - this.prog);
   121	        if (!this.inv && Math.abs(sy - SQUAD_Y) < 40) {
   122	          var bx = this.sawX(o, 0), bx2 = this.sawX(o, 1);
   123	          if (Math.abs(bx - this.x) < 46 || Math.abs(bx2 - this.x) < 46) {
   124	            var loss = Math.max(3, Math.round(this.n * 0.16));
   125	            this.n -= loss; this.inv = 0.75;
   126	            Fx.pop(this.x, SQUAD_Y - 90, '−' + loss, '#ffa04d');
   127	            Fx.burst(this.x, SQUAD_Y, 14, '#ffa04d', 260);
   128	            Fx.kick(9); Sfx.hit();
   129	          }
   130	        }
   131	      }
   132	    }
   133	
   134	    if (this.n > MAX_SQUAD) this.n = MAX_SQUAD;
   135	    if (this.n <= 0) { this.n = 0; this.done = true; this.wiped = true; return; }
   136	    if (this.prog >= TOTAL) { this.done = true; this.wiped = false; }
   137	  },
   138	
   139	  applyOp: function (o, gy) {
   140	    var before = this.n;
   141	    if (o.op === 'mul') this.n = Math.round(this.n * o.v);
   142	    else if (o.op === 'div') this.n = Math.floor(this.n / o.v);
   143	    else if (o.op === 'add') this.n += o.v;
   144	    else this.n -= o.v;
   145	    if (this.n > MAX_SQUAD) this.n = MAX_SQUAD;
   146	    var d = this.n - before;
   147	    Fx.pop(this.x, SQUAD_Y - 100, (d >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(d), d >= 0 ? '#7ee0a8' : '#ff6b6b');
   148	    Fx.burst(this.x, SQUAD_Y - 30, d >= 0 ? 16 : 12, d >= 0 ? '#7ee0a8' : '#ff6b6b', 260);
   149	    if (d >= 0) { Sfx.good(); Fx.bang('#7ee0a8', 0.22); }
   150	    else { Sfx.bad(); Fx.kick(7); Fx.bang('#ff3b3b', 0.3); }
   151	  },
   152	
   153	  mobSpan: function (o) {
   154	    var mid = (LANE_L + LANE_R) / 2;
   155	    if (o.side === 'L') return [LANE_L, mid];
   156	    if (o.side === 'R') return [mid, LANE_R];
   157	    return [LANE_L, LANE_R];
   158	  },
   159	  sawX: function (o, idx) {
   160	    var mid = (LANE_L + LANE_R) / 2, amp = (LANE_R - LANE_L) / 2 - 40;
   161	    return mid + Math.sin(o.ph + idx * Math.PI) * amp;
   162	  },
   163

   165	  draw: function (g) {
   166	    // road
   167	    g.fillStyle = '#171b25'; g.fillRect(0, 0, DW, DH);
   168	    g.fillStyle = '#232a38'; g.fillRect(LANE_L, 0, LANE_R - LANE_L, DH);

   110	      var q = r * 0.88;
   111	      g.moveTo(cx - q + 5, cy - q); g.arcTo(cx + q, cy - q, cx + q, cy + q, 6);
   112	      g.arcTo(cx + q, cy + q, cx - q, cy + q, 6); g.arcTo(cx - q, cy + q, cx - q, cy - q, 6);
   113	      g.arcTo(cx - q, cy - q, cx + q, cy - q, 6); g.closePath();
   114	    }
   115	    else if (shape === 2) {
   116	      g.moveTo(cx, cy - r * 1.05);
   117	      g.lineTo(cx + r * 0.98, cy + r * 0.75);
   118	      g.lineTo(cx - r * 0.98, cy + r * 0.75);
   119	      g.closePath();
   120	    }
   560	      BC.Fx.burst(crc.x + CS / 2, crc.y + CS / 2, '#fff', 10, 200);
   561	    }
   562	    P.phase = 'pop'; P.t = 0;
   563	  }
   564	
   565	  function doGravity() {
   566	    var b = P.b, i;
   567	    var before = P.st.acorns;
   568	    var gr = BC.gravity(b, P.rand, P.lv, P.st);
   569	    for (i = 0; i < b.n; i++) { P.oy[i] = 0; P.vy[i] = 0; }
   570	    for (var key in gr.falls) {
   571	      var k = key | 0;
   572	      if (k >= 0 && k < b.n) P.oy[k] = -Math.min(gr.falls[key], BC.H + 2) * CS;
   573	    }
   574	    var got = P.st.acorns - before;
   575	    if (got > 0) {
   576	      BC.Audio.acorn();
   577	      P.st.score += got * 500;
   578	      for (i = 0; i < gr.acorns.length; i++) {
   579	        var rc = cellRect(gr.acorns[i]);
   580	        BC.Fx.burst(rc.x + CS / 2, rc.y + CS / 2, '#c98a3c', 16, 220);
   581	      }
   582	      BC.Fx.pop(BX + CS * BC.W / 2, BY + CS * BC.H - 40, 'ACORN SAVED!', '#ffb020');
   583	      BC.Fx.kick(7);
   584	    }
   585	    P.phase = 'fall'; P.t = 0;
   586	  }
   587	
   588	  function settle() {
   589	    var lv = P.lv, st = P.st;
   590	    if (P.endless) {
   591	      // each refill costs more score than the last, so the run always tightens
   592	      while (st.score >= P.nextBonus && P.bonusCount < 200) {
   593	        P.bonusCount++;
   594	        P.nextBonus += 3000 + P.bonusCount * 1800;
   595	        st.moves += 2;
   596	        BC.Fx.pop(W / 2, BY + 40, '+2 MOVES', '#7bd94a');
   597	      }
   598	      var stage = Math.min(8, Math.floor(st.score / 14000));
   599	      if (stage > P.stage) { P.stage = stage; lv.colors = stage < 1 ? 4 : (stage < 3 ? 5 : 6); BC.Fx.pop(W / 2, BY + 70, 'DIFFICULTY UP', '#ff6b83'); }
   600	      if (st.moves <= 0) { endGame(0); return; }
   601	    } else {
   602	      if (BC.goalsMet(lv, st)) { endGame(1); return; }
   603	      if (st.moves <= 0) { endGame(0); return; }
   604	    }
   605	    if (!BC.listMoves(P.b).length) {
   606	      BC.shuffle(P.b, P.rand, lv);
   607	      BC.Fx.pop(W / 2, BY + CS * BC.H / 2, 'NO MOVES — SHUFFLE', '#8fe3ff');
   608	      BC.Audio.swap();
   609	    }
   610	    P.phase = 'idle'; P.chain = 0; P.t = 0;
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  function endGame(won) {
   614	    P.over = won ? 1 : 2;
   615	    P.phase = 'over';
   616	    P.sel = -1;
   617	    if (P.endless) {
   618	      if (P.st.score > save.endless) { save.endless = P.st.score; BC.Store.write(save); }
   619	      BC.Audio.lose();
   620	      return;
   621	    }
   622	    if (won) {
   623	      var s = 1, lv = P.lv;
   624	      if (P.st.score >= lv.stars[1]) s = 2;
   625	      if (P.st.score >= lv.stars[2]) s = 3;
   626	      P.stars = s;
   627	      var n = lv.n;
   628	      if ((save.stars[n] | 0) < s) save.stars[n] = s;
   629	      if ((save.best[n] | 0) < P.st.score) save.best[n] = P.st.score;
   630	      if (save.unlocked < Math.min(30, n + 2)) save.unlocked = Math.min(30, n + 2);
   631	      BC.Store.write(save);
   632	      BC.Audio.win();
   633	      BC.Fx.kick(10);
   634	      for (var k = 0; k < 40; k++) BC.Fx.burst(Math.random() * W, H * 0.35 + Math.random() * 120, COL[k % 6], 2, 200);
   635	    } else {
   636	      BC.Audio.lose();
   637	      BC.Fx.kick(9);
   638	    }
   639	  }
   640	
   641	  function attemptSwap(i, j) {
   642	    if (P.phase !== 'idle' || P.over) return false;
   643	    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= P.b.n || j >= P.b.n) return false;
   644	    var b = P.b;
   645	    if (b.c[i] === ACORN || b.c[j] === ACORN || b.c[i] === EMPTY || b.c[j] === EMPTY) { BC.Audio.deny(); return false; }
   646	    P.sel = -1;
   647	    P.swapA = i; P.swapB = j; P.t = 0;
   648	    P.pendingValid = BC.canSwap(b, i, j);
   649	    P.phase = 'swap';
   650	    BC.Audio.swap();
   651	    return true;
   652	  }
   653	
   654	  function updatePlay(dt) {
   655	    var i;
   656	    if (P.phase === 'swap') {
   657	      P.t += dt;
   658	      if (P.t >= 0.13) {
   659	        BC.doSwap(P.b, P.swapA, P.swapB);
   660	        if (!P.pendingValid) { P.phase = 'unswap'; P.t = 0; BC.Audio.deny(); }
   661	        else {
   662	          P.st.moves--;
   663	          P.chain = 0;
   664	          var step = BC.swapClear(P.b, P.swapA, P.swapB, P.rand);
   665	          if (step) startPop(step);
   666	          else { P.phase = 'idle'; P.t = 0; }
   667	        }
   668	      }
   669	    } else if (P.phase === 'unswap') {
   670	      P.t += dt;
   671	      if (P.t >= 0.13) { BC.doSwap(P.b, P.swapA, P.swapB); P.phase = 'idle'; P.swapA = P.swapB = -1; P.t = 0; }
   672	    } else if (P.phase === 'pop') {
   673	      P.t += dt;
   674	      for (i = 0; i < P.popping.length; i++) P.popping[i].t += dt;
   675	      if (P.t >= 0.16) { P.popping.length = 0; doGravity(); }
   676	    } else if (P.phase === 'fall') {
   677	      P.t += dt;
   678	      var moving = false;
   679	      for (i = 0; i < P.b.n; i++) {
   680	        if (P.oy[i] < 0) {
   681	          P.vy[i] += 3600 * dt;
   682	          P.oy[i] += P.vy[i] * dt;
   683	          if (P.oy[i] >= 0) { P.oy[i] = 0; P.vy[i] = 0; P.sq[i] = 1; }
   684	          else moving = true;
   685	        }
   686	        if (P.sq[i] > 0) { P.sq[i] -= dt * 5.5; if (P.sq[i] < 0) P.sq[i] = 0; }
   687	      }
   688	      if (!moving || P.t > 2.2) {
   689	        for (i = 0; i < P.b.n; i++) { if (P.oy[i] < 0) { P.oy[i] = 0; P.vy[i] = 0; } }
   690	        var st2 = BC.stepClear(P.b, -1, P.rand);
   691	        if (st2) { P.chain++; startPop(st2); }
   692	        else settle();
   693	      }
   694	    } else {
   695	      for (i = 0; i < P.b.n; i++) if (P.sq[i] > 0) { P.sq[i] -= dt * 5.5; if (P.sq[i] < 0) P.sq[i] = 0; }
   696	    }
   697	    P.hintT += dt;
   698	  }
   699	
   700	  /* ---------------- input ---------------- */
   701	  var kbActive = false;
   702	
   703	  function cellAt(px, py) {
   704	    var x = Math.floor((px - BX) / CS), y = Math.floor((py - BY) / CS);
   705	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= BC.W || y >= BC.H) return -1;
   706	    return y * BC.W + x;
   707	  }
   708	
   709	  function fireButton(id) {
   710	    BC.Audio.unlock();
   711	    if (id === 'mute') { save.mute = save.mute ? 0 : 1; BC.Audio.setMute(save.mute); BC.Store.write(save); return; }
   712	    if (id === 'endless') { newPlay(0, true); scene = 'play'; return; }
   713	    if (id === 'crown') { scene = 'crown'; BC.Audio.crown(); return; }
   714	    if (id === 'menu' || id === 'back') { BC.Timers.clearAll(); BC.Input.reset(); BC.Fx.reset(); pending = -1; scene = 'map'; P = null; centerMapOn(save.unlocked - 1); return; }
   715	    if (id === 'retry' || id === 'again') {
   716	      if (!P) return;
   717	      if (P.endless) newPlay(0, true); else newPlay(P.lv.n, false);
   718	      return;
   719	    }
   720	    if (id === 'next') {
   721	      var n = P.lv.n + 1;
   722	      if (n > 29) { scene = 'crown'; return; }
   723	      queueLevel(n); return;
   724	    }
   725	  }
   720	    if (id === 'next') {
   721	      var n = P.lv.n + 1;
   722	      if (n > 29) { scene = 'crown'; return; }
   723	      queueLevel(n); return;
   724	    }
   725	  }
   726	
   727	  function centerMapOn(i) {
   728	    i = BC.clamp(i, 0, 29);
   729	    map.sel = i;
   730	    map.scroll = BC.clamp(i * STEP - (H - 70) + (H + MAPTOP) / 2, 0, map.maxScroll);
   731	  }
   732	
   733	  function onDown(e) {
   734	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   735	    var x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY;
   736	    BC.Audio.unlock();
   737	    var b = hitBtn(x, y);
   738	    if (b) { BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'btn', btn: b.id, x: x, y: y }; return; }
   739	    if (paused) return;
   740	    if (scene === 'map') {
   741	      BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'map', x: x, y: y, sx: x, sy: y, s0: map.scroll, moved: false };
   742	      return;
   743	    }
   744	    if (scene === 'play' && P && !P.over) {
   745	      var c = cellAt(x, y);
   746	      if (c >= 0) {
   747	        kbActive = false;
   748	        BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'board', cell: c, sx: x, sy: y, moved: false };
   749	        if (P.sel >= 0 && P.sel !== c && adjacent(P.sel, c)) { attemptSwap(P.sel, c); BC.Input.pointers[id].done = true; }
   750	        else if (P.phase === 'idle') P.sel = (P.sel === c ? -1 : c);
   751	      } else { BC.Input.pointers[id] = { kind: 'none' }; }
   752	    }
   753	  }
   754	  function adjacent(a, b) {
   755	    var ax = a % BC.W, ay = (a / BC.W) | 0, bx = b % BC.W, by = (b / BC.W) | 0;
   756	    return Math.abs(ax - bx) + Math.abs(ay - by) === 1;
   757	  }
   758	  function onMove(e) {
   759	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   760	    var p = BC.Input.pointers[id];
   761	    if (!p) return;
   762	    var x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY;
   763	    if (p.kind === 'map') {
   764	      map.scroll = BC.clamp(p.s0 + (y - p.sy), 0, map.maxScroll);
   765	      if (Math.abs(y - p.sy) > 8 || Math.abs(x - p.sx) > 8) p.moved = true;
   766	      return;
   767	    }
   768	    if (p.kind === 'board' && !p.done && P && P.phase === 'idle') {
   769	      var dx = x - p.sx, dy = y - p.sy;
   770	      if (Math.abs(dx) > 16 || Math.abs(dy) > 16) {
   771	        var cx = p.cell % BC.W, cy = (p.cell / BC.W) | 0, tx = cx, ty = cy;
   772	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) tx += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else ty += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   773	        p.done = true;
   774	        if (tx >= 0 && tx < BC.W && ty >= 0 && ty < BC.H) attemptSwap(p.cell, ty * BC.W + tx);
   775	        P.sel = -1;
   776	      }
   777	    }
   778	  }
   779	  function onUp(e) {
   780	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   781	    var p = BC.Input.pointers[id];
   782	    delete BC.Input.pointers[id];
   783	    if (!p || paused) return;
   784	    if (p.kind === 'btn') {
   785	      var b2 = hitBtn(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   786	      if (b2 && b2.id === p.btn) fireButton(p.btn);
   787	      return;
   788	    }
   789	    if (p.kind === 'map' && !p.moved) {
   790	      for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   791	        var ny = nodeScreenY(i);
   792	        if (ny < 40 || ny > H + 40) continue;
   793	        var dx = e.clientX - map.nodes[i].x, dy = e.clientY - ny;
   794	        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= 30 * 30) {
   795	          if (i < save.unlocked) { map.sel = i; BC.Audio.unlock(); queueLevel(i); }
   796	          else BC.Audio.deny();
   797	          return;
   798	        }
   799	      }
   800	    }
   801	  }
   802	  function onCancel(e) {
   803	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   804	    delete BC.Input.pointers[id];
   805	  }
   806	
   807	  function onKey(e) {
   808	    var k = e.key;
   809	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'Enter'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   810	    BC.Audio.unlock();
   811	    BC.Input.keys[k] = 1;
   812	    if (paused) return;
   813	    if (scene === 'crown') { if (k === 'Enter' || k === 'Escape' || k === ' ') fireButton('menu'); return; }
   814	    if (scene === 'map') {
   815	      if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowRight') { map.sel = BC.clamp(map.sel + 1, 0, save.unlocked - 1); centerMapOn(map.sel); }
   816	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowLeft') { map.sel = BC.clamp(map.sel - 1, 0, 29); centerMapOn(map.sel); }
   817	      else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { if (map.sel < save.unlocked) queueLevel(map.sel); else BC.Audio.deny(); }
   818	      else if (k === 'e' || k === 'E') fireButton('endless');
   819	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') fireButton('mute');
   820	      return;
   821	    }
   822	    if (scene === 'play' && P) {
   823	      if (k === 'Escape') { fireButton('menu'); return; }
   824	      if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { fireButton('again'); return; }
   825	      if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { fireButton('mute'); return; }
   826	      if (P.over) {
   827	        if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   828	          if (P.over === 1 && !P.endless && P.lv.n < 29) fireButton('next');
   829	          else if (P.over === 1 && !P.endless) fireButton('crown');
   830	          else fireButton('again');
   831	        }
   832	        return;
   833	      }
   834	      kbActive = true;
   835	      if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown') {
   836	        var dx = (k === 'ArrowRight') - (k === 'ArrowLeft');
   837	        var dy = (k === 'ArrowDown') - (k === 'ArrowUp');
   838	        if (P.sel >= 0) {
   839	          var tx = (P.sel % BC.W) + dx, ty = ((P.sel / BC.W) | 0) + dy;
   840	          if (tx >= 0 && tx < BC.W && ty >= 0 && ty < BC.H) { attemptSwap(P.sel, ty * BC.W + tx); P.cx = BC.clamp(tx, 0, BC.W - 1); P.cy = BC.clamp(ty, 0, BC.H - 1); }
   841	          P.sel = -1;
   842	        } else {
   843	          P.cx = BC.clamp(P.cx + dx, 0, BC.W - 1);
   844	          P.cy = BC.clamp(P.cy + dy, 0, BC.H - 1);
   845	        }
   846	      } else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   847	        var ci = P.cy * BC.W + P.cx;
   848	        P.sel = (P.sel === ci) ? -1 : ci;
   849	      }
   850	    }
   851	  }
   852	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete BC.Input.keys[e.key]; }
   853	
   854	  function releaseAll() { BC.Input.reset(); }

   856	  /* ---------------- orientation / pause (hardening #1) ---------------- */
   857	  function checkOrientation() {
   858	    var landscape = W > H && H < 460;
   859	    if (landscape !== paused) {
   860	      paused = landscape;
   861	      if (paused) releaseAll();
   862	      lastT = 0;
   863	    }
   864	    var el = document.getElementById('rotate');
   865	    if (el) el.style.display = paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
   866	  }

   868	  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
   869	  function resize() {
   870	    W = Math.max(240, window.innerWidth);
   871	    H = Math.max(320, window.innerHeight);
   872	    var d = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   873	    var longAxis = Math.max(W, H);
   874	    if (longAxis * d > 960) d = 960 / longAxis;
   875	    dpr = d;
   876	    canvas.width = Math.round(W * d);
   877	    canvas.height = Math.round(H * d);
   878	    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
   879	    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
   880	    g.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
   881	    buildMapNodes();
   882	    if (P) layoutBoard();
   883	    checkOrientation();
   884	  }
   885	
   886	  function frame(ts) {
   887	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   888	    if (!lastT) lastT = ts;
   889	    var dt = (ts - lastT) / 1000;
   890	    lastT = ts;
   891	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   892	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   893	    if (paused) { return; }
   894	    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   895	    if (booted) {
   896	      BC.Fx.update(dt);
   897	      if (scene === 'play' && P && !P.over) updatePlay(dt);
   898	      if (scene === 'loading') {
   899	        if (pendingDrawn) { var pn = pending; pending = -1; newPlay(pn, false); scene = 'play'; drawPlay(); }
   900	        else { drawLoading(); pendingDrawn = true; }
   901	      }
   902	      else if (scene === 'map') drawMap();
   903	      else if (scene === 'play') drawPlay();
   904	      else drawCrown();
   905	      if (BC.Fx.flash > 0) {
   906	        g.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.35, BC.Fx.flash * 0.4);
   907	        g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); g.globalAlpha = 1;
   908	      }
   909	    }
   910	  }
   911	
   912	  /* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
   913	  function boot() {
   914	    canvas = document.getElementById('cv');
   915	    g = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
   916	    BC.Audio.setMute(save.mute);
   917	    resize();
   918	    centerMapOn(save.unlocked - 1);
   919	
   920	    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   921	    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { BC.Timers.set(resize, 120); });
   922	
   923	    var opts = { passive: false };
   924	    if (window.PointerEvent) {
   925	      canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onDown(e); }, opts);
   926	      window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (BC.Input.pointers[e.pointerId] !== undefined) e.preventDefault(); onMove(e); }, opts);
   927	      window.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { onUp(e); }, opts);
   928	      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel, opts);
   929	    } else {
   930	      canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; onDown({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY }); } }, opts);
   931	      canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; onMove({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY }); } }, opts);
   932	      canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; onUp({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY }); } }, opts);
   933	      canvas.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) onCancel({ pointerId: e.changedTouches[i].identifier }); }, opts);
   934	      canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
   935	      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
   936	      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
   937	    }
   938	    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
   939	      if (scene === 'map') { e.preventDefault(); map.scroll = BC.clamp(map.scroll - e.deltaY, 0, map.maxScroll); }
   940	    }, opts);
   941	    canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   942	    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
   943	    window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
   944	    window.addEventListener('blur', releaseAll);
   945	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) { releaseAll(); lastT = 0; } });
   946	
   947	    var ov = document.getElementById('tap');
   948	    function start() {
   949	      BC.Audio.unlock();
   950	      if (ov && ov.parentNode) ov.parentNode.removeChild(ov);
   951	      booted = true;
   952	      lastT = 0;
   953	    }
