   320	  // Compacts + refills until nothing is left falling and no acorn is sitting on the floor.
   321	  // Returns {falls: {finalIndex: cellsFallen}, acorns:[index]} so the view can animate the drop.
   322	  BC.gravity = function (b, rand, cfg, st) {
   323	    var w = b.w, x, y, i, falls = {}, acorns = [], pass = 0, again = true;
   324	    while (again && pass++ < 12) {
   325	      again = false;
   326	      // 1. anything resting on the floor that is an acorn gets delivered
   327	      for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
   328	        var bi = (b.h - 1) * w + x;
   329	        if (b.c[bi] === ACORN) {
   330	          acorns.push(bi); b.c[bi] = EMPTY; b.sp[bi] = SP.NONE;
   331	          delete falls[bi];
   332	          if (st) st.acorns++;
   333	        }
   334	      }
   335	      // 2. compact each column, then refill the gap at the top
   336	      for (x = 0; x < w; x++) {
   337	        var write = b.h - 1;
   338	        for (y = b.h - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   339	          i = y * w + x;
   340	          if (b.c[i] === EMPTY) continue;
   341	          if (write !== y) {
   342	            var to = write * w + x;
   343	            b.c[to] = b.c[i]; b.sp[to] = b.sp[i];
   344	            b.c[i] = EMPTY; b.sp[i] = SP.NONE;
   345	            falls[to] = (falls[i] || 0) + (write - y);
   346	            delete falls[i];
   347	          }
   348	          write--;
   349	        }
   350	        for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   351	          var idx = y * w + x;
   352	          var makeAcorn = false;
   353	          if (cfg && cfg.acorns > 0 && st && st.acornSpawned < cfg.acorns) {
   354	            var inplay = st.acornSpawned - st.acorns;
   355	            if (inplay < 3 && rand() < 0.34) makeAcorn = true;
   356	          }
   357	          if (makeAcorn) { b.c[idx] = ACORN; b.sp[idx] = SP.NONE; st.acornSpawned++; }
   358	          else { b.c[idx] = (rand() * cfg.colors) | 0; b.sp[idx] = SP.NONE; }
   359	          falls[idx] = y + 1.4;
   360	        }
   361	      }
   362	      // 3. a freshly landed acorn on the floor means another delivery pass
   363	      for (x = 0; x < w; x++) if (b.c[(b.h - 1) * w + x] === ACORN) { again = true; break; }
   364	    }
   365	    return { falls: falls, acorns: acorns };
   366	  };

   113	  Board.prototype.neighborObstacles = function (x, y) {
   114	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], n = 0;
   115	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   116	      var c = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   117	      if (c && c.k !== 'b') n++;
   118	    }
   119	    return n;
   120	  };

   122	  /* ---------- groups ---------- */
   123	  Board.prototype.groupAt = function (x, y) {
   124	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   125	    if (!c || c.k !== 'b' || c.sp !== SP_NONE) return [];
   126	    var seen = {}, out = [], st = [[x, y]];
   127	    seen[x + ',' + y] = 1;
   128	    while (st.length) {
   129	      var p = st.pop(), px = p[0], py = p[1];
   130	      out.push(p);
   131	      var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
   132	      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   133	        var nx = px + d[i][0], ny = py + d[i][1], key = nx + ',' + ny;
   134	        if (seen[key]) continue;
   135	        var q = this.at(nx, ny);
   136	        if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE && q.c === c.c) { seen[key] = 1; st.push([nx, ny]); }
   137	      }
   138	    }
   139	    return out;
   140	  };

   142	  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
   143	    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   144	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   145	      if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   146	      if (c.sp !== SP_NONE) return true;
   147	      var r = this.at(x + 1, y), d = this.at(x, y + 1);
   148	      if (r && r.k === 'b' && r.sp === SP_NONE && r.c === c.c) return true;
   149	      if (d && d.k === 'b' && d.sp === SP_NONE && d.c === c.c) return true;
   150	    }
   151	    return false;
   152	  };
   153	
   154	  Board.prototype.shuffleColors = function () {
   155	    var list = [], i, x, y;
   156	    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   157	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   158	      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) list.push(c);
   159	    }
   160	    for (i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   161	      var j = this.rng.int(i + 1), t = list[i].c; list[i].c = list[j].c; list[j].c = t;
   162	    }
   163	    this.shuffles++;
   164	  };

   169	    if (!c || set[c.id]) return null;
   170	    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];

   174	  // Damage obstacles neighbouring a set of coords
   175	  Board.prototype._splash = function (coords, set) {
   176	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
   177	    for (var i = 0; i < coords.length; i++) {
   178	      for (var j = 0; j < d.length; j++) {

   180	        var c = this.at(nx, ny);

   391	          c.vy = 0;
   392	        }
   393	        write--;
   394	      }
   395	      for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   396	        var q = this.queue[x];
   397	        while (q.length < 4) q.push(this.rc());
   398	        if (q.length > 8) q.length = 8;
   399	        var nb = mkBlock(q.shift());
   400	        q.push(this.rc());
   401	        nb.oy = -(write - y + 1);
   402	        nb.vy = 0;
   403	        this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = nb;
   404	      }
   405	    }
   406	  };

   408	  /* ---------- end of move ---------- */
   409	  Board.prototype.endOfMove = function () {
   410	    var x, y, c;
   411	    // gears are heavy: each move they sink one row through a plain block
   412	    for (y = this.rows - 2; y >= 0; y--) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   413	      c = this.at(x, y);
   414	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   415	        var dn = this.at(x, y + 1);
   416	        if (dn && dn.k === 'b' && dn.sp === SP_NONE) {
   417	          this.set(x, y + 1, c); this.set(x, y, dn);
   418	          c.oy = -1; dn.oy = 1;
   419	        }
   420	      }
   421	    }
   422	    // gears reaching the floor are collected
   423	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   424	      c = this.at(x, this.rows - 1);
   425	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   426	        this.prog.gear++;
   427	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: this.rows - 1 });
   428	        this.set(x, this.rows - 1, null);
   429	      }
   430	    }
   431	    // balloons rise one cell (swap with a plain block above)
   432	    var risers = [];
   433	    for (y = 1; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   434	      c = this.at(x, y);
   435	      if (c && c.k === 'balloon' && !c._rose) {
   436	        var up = this.at(x, y - 1);
   437	        if (up && up.k === 'b') {
   438	          this.set(x, y - 1, c); this.set(x, y, up);
   439	          c.oy = 1; up.oy = -1; c._rose = 1; risers.push(c);
   440	        }
   441	      }
   442	    }
   443	    for (x = 0; x < risers.length; x++) risers[x]._rose = 0;
   444	    this.settle();
   445	
   446	    // goal / fail evaluation
   447	    var gl = this.def.goals, done =
   448	      this.prog.crate >= gl.crate && this.prog.balloon >= gl.balloon &&
   449	      this.prog.gear >= gl.gear && this.prog.pop >= gl.pop;
   450	    if (done) {
   451	      this.over = 1;
   452	      var ratio = this.movesLeft / Math.max(1, this.def.moves);
   453	      this.stars = ratio >= 0.38 ? 3 : (ratio >= 0.15 ? 2 : 1);
   454	      this.score += this.movesLeft * 120;
   455	    } else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) {
   456	      this.over = -1;
   457	    } else {
   458	      var guard = 0;
   459	      while (!this.hasMove() && guard++ < 30) this.shuffleColors();
   460	    }
   461	    if (this.score > 99999999) this.score = 99999999;
   462	  };
   463	
   464	  Board.prototype.goalsLeft = function () {
   465	    var gl = this.def.goals, out = [];
   466	    if (gl.crate) out.push({ k: 'crate', need: gl.crate, have: Math.min(gl.crate, this.prog.crate) });
   467	    if (gl.balloon) out.push({ k: 'balloon', need: gl.balloon, have: Math.min(gl.balloon, this.prog.balloon) });
   468	    if (gl.gear) out.push({ k: 'gear', need: gl.gear, have: Math.min(gl.gear, this.prog.gear) });
   469	    if (gl.pop) out.push({ k: 'pop', need: gl.pop, have: Math.min(gl.pop, this.prog.pop), c: this.def.popColor });
   470	    return out;

   186	
   187	  Board.prototype.blastOf = function (x, y, c, set, queue) {
   188	    var i, j;
   189	    if (c.sp === SP_ROCKET) {
   190	      if (c.rot) { for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) this._hit(x, j, set, queue); }
   191	      else { for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) this._hit(i, y, set, queue); }
   192	    } else if (c.sp === SP_BOMB) {
   193	      for (i = -2; i <= 2; i++) for (j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
   194	        if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 3) this._hit(x + i, y + j, set, queue);
   195	      }
   196	    } else if (c.sp === SP_ORB) {
   197	      var col = (typeof c.orbColor === 'number') ? c.orbColor : this.commonColor();
   198	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   199	        var t = this.at(i, j);
   200	        if (t && t.k === 'b' && (t.c === col || t.sp !== SP_NONE)) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
   201	      }
   202	    }
   203	  };
   204	
   205	  Board.prototype._hit = function (x, y, set, queue) {
   206	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   207	    if (!c || set[c.id]) return;
   208	    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
   209	      if (queue.length < 96) queue.push([x, y, c]);
   210	      return;
   211	    }
   212	    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
   213	  };
   214	
   215	  Board.prototype.commonColor = function () {
   216	    var cnt = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], x, y, best = 0;
   217	    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   218	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   219	      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) cnt[c.c]++;
   220	    }
   221	    for (x = 1; x < 6; x++) if (cnt[x] > cnt[best]) best = x;
   222	    return best;
   223	  };
   224	
   225	  // Fire one or more specials, chaining. Returns cleared set map.
   226	  Board.prototype.fireSpecials = function (starts) {
   227	    var set = {}, queue = starts.slice(), guard = 0;
   228	    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
   229	      var e = queue.shift(), x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   230	      if (set[c.id]) continue;
   231	      set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
   232	      this.events.push({ t: c.sp === SP_ORB ? 'orb' : (c.sp === SP_BOMB ? 'bomb' : 'rocket'), x: x, y: y, rot: c.rot || 0 });
   233	      this.blastOf(x, y, c, set, queue);
   234	    }
   235	    var coords = [], k;
   236	    for (k in set) coords.push([set[k][0], set[k][1]]);
   237	    this._splash(coords, set);
   238	    return set;
   239	  };
   240	
   241	  // Combine two adjacent specials into a bigger effect
   242	  Board.prototype.combo = function (a, b) {
   243	    var set = {}, queue = [], lo = Math.min(a[2].sp, b[2].sp), hi = Math.max(a[2].sp, b[2].sp);
   244	    var ax = a[0], ay = a[1], i, j;
   245	    set[a[2].id] = a; set[b[2].id] = b;
   246	    this.events.push({ t: 'combo', x: ax, y: ay, kind: lo + '' + hi });
   247	    if (lo === SP_ROCKET && hi === SP_ROCKET) {
   248	      for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) { this._hit(i, ay, set, queue); this._hit(i, b[1], set, queue); }
   249	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) { this._hit(ax, j, set, queue); this._hit(b[0], j, set, queue); }
   250	    } else if (lo === SP_ROCKET && hi === SP_BOMB) {
   251	      for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) for (j = -1; j <= 1; j++) this._hit(i, ay + j, set, queue);
   252	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = -1; i <= 1; i++) this._hit(ax + i, j, set, queue);
   253	    } else if (lo === SP_BOMB && hi === SP_BOMB) {
   254	      for (i = -3; i <= 3; i++) for (j = -3; j <= 3; j++)
   255	        if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 4) this._hit(ax + i, ay + j, set, queue);
   256	    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_ORB) {
   257	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
   258	    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_ROCKET) {
   259	      var col = this.commonColor();
   260	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   261	        var t = this.at(i, j);
   262	        if (t && t.k === 'b' && t.c === col) {
   263	          var k2;
   264	          for (k2 = 0; k2 < this.cols; k2++) this._hit(k2, j, set, queue);
   265	          for (k2 = 0; k2 < this.rows; k2++) this._hit(i, k2, set, queue);
   266	        }
   267	      }
   268	    } else if (hi === SP_ORB && lo === SP_BOMB) {
   269	      var col2 = this.commonColor();
   270	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   270	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   271	        var t2 = this.at(i, j);
   272	        if (t2 && t2.k === 'b' && t2.c === col2) {
   273	          for (var di = -1; di <= 1; di++) for (var dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) this._hit(i + di, j + dj, set, queue);
   274	        }
   275	      }
   276	    }
   277	    // chain any specials swept up
   278	    var guard = 0;
   279	    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
   280	      var e = queue.shift();
   281	      if (set[e[2].id]) continue;
   282	      set[e[2].id] = e;
   283	      this.events.push({ t: e[2].sp === SP_ORB ? 'orb' : (e[2].sp === SP_BOMB ? 'bomb' : 'rocket'), x: e[0], y: e[1], rot: e[2].rot || 0 });
   284	      this.blastOf(e[0], e[1], e[2], set, queue);
   285	    }
   286	    var coords = [], k;
   287	    for (k in set) coords.push([set[k][0], set[k][1]]);
   288	    this._splash(coords, set);
   289	    return set;
   290	  };
   291	
   292	  /* ---------- player action ---------- */
   293	  // returns null (illegal) or {cleared:[cells], made:cellOrNull}
   294	  Board.prototype.tap = function (x, y) {
   295	    if (this.over) return null;
   296	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   297	    if (!c) return null;
   298	    this.events.length = 0;
   299	
   300	    var set = null, made = null, n = 0;
   301	
   302	    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
   303	      // adjacent special => combo
   304	      var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], partner = null;
   305	      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   306	        var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   307	        if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp !== SP_NONE) { partner = [x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1], q]; break; }
   308	      }
   309	      if (c.sp === SP_ORB && !partner) c.orbColor = this.bestNeighborColor(x, y);
   310	      set = partner ? this.combo([x, y, c], partner) : this.fireSpecials([[x, y, c]]);
   311	    } else {
   312	      var grp = this.groupAt(x, y);
   313	      if (grp.length < 2) return null;
   314	      n = grp.length;
   315	      set = {};
   316	      var sp = n >= 9 ? SP_ORB : (n >= 7 ? SP_BOMB : (n >= 5 ? SP_ROCKET : SP_NONE));
   317	      for (var k = 0; k < grp.length; k++) {
   318	        var gx = grp[k][0], gy = grp[k][1];
   319	        if (sp && gx === x && gy === y) continue;   // seed cell survives as the special
   320	        var cc = this.at(gx, gy);
   321	        set[cc.id] = [gx, gy, cc];
   322	      }
   323	      this._splash(grp, set);
   324	      if (sp) {
   325	        made = this.at(x, y);
   326	        made.sp = sp;
   327	        made.rot = (x + y) % 2;
   328	        if (sp === SP_ORB) made.orbColor = made.c;
   329	        made.flash = 1;
   330	        this.events.push({ t: 'make', x: x, y: y, sp: sp });
   331	      }
   332	      this.events.push({ t: 'pop', x: x, y: y, n: n });
   333	    }
   334	
   335	    var cleared = this.applyClear(set);
   336	    if (!cleared.length && !made) return null;
   337	
   338	    var base = Math.max(cleared.length, n);
   339	    this.score += base * base * 6 + cleared.length * 12;
   340	    this.movesLeft--; this.movesUsed++;
   341	
   342	    this.settle();
   343	    this.endOfMove();
   344	    return { cleared: cleared, made: made, n: cleared.length };
   345	  };
   346	
   347	  Board.prototype.bestNeighborColor = function (x, y) {
   348	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], best = -1, bn = 0;
   349	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   350	      var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   351	      if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE) {
   352	        var n = this.groupAt(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]).length;
   353	        if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = q.c; }
   354	      }
   355	    }
   356	    return best < 0 ? this.commonColor() : best;
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  // Remove all cells in set, tally goals. Returns list of [x,y,cell]
   360	  Board.prototype.applyClear = function (set) {
   361	    var out = [], k;
   362	    for (k in set) {
   363	      var e = set[k], x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   364	      if (this.at(x, y) !== c) continue;
   365	      if (c.k === 'crate') this.prog.crate++;
   366	      else if (c.k === 'balloon') this.prog.balloon++;
   367	      else if (c.k === 'gear') {
   368	        // plain collapses never touch a gear (see _splash); only a blast knocks it loose
   369	        this.prog.gear++;
   370	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: y });
   371	      }
   372	      else if (c.k === 'b' && c.c === this.def.popColor) this.prog.pop++;
   373	      this.set(x, y, null);
   374	      out.push(e);
   375	    }
   376	    return out;
   377	  };

   663	        T.sfx.tap(); return;

   665	      if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { startLevel(lvlIdx); return; }
   666	      if (k === 'Escape') { goGarden(); return; }
   667	      if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { T.audio.toggle(); return; }
   668	      return;
   669	    }
   670	    /* menus / overlays: focus navigation */
   671	    if (!buttons.length) return;
   672	    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'Tab') { focusIdx = (focusIdx + 1) % buttons.length; T.sfx.tap(); return; }
   673	    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowLeft') { focusIdx = (focusIdx - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length; T.sfx.tap(); return; }
   674	    if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   675	      var b = buttons[focusIdx >= 0 ? focusIdx : 0];
   676	      if (b) { T.sfx.tap(); b.fn(); }
   677	      return;
   678	    }
   679	    if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') T.audio.toggle();
   680	    if (k === 'Escape' && screen === 'choice') return;
   681	  });
   682	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });
   683	
   684	  /* ---------- loop ---------- */
   685	  var last = 0;
   686	  function frame(ts) {
   687	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   688	    if (!last) last = ts;
   689	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   690	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   691	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   692	    if (paused) { return; }
   693	
   694	    time += dt;
   695	    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 34);
   696	    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   697	    if (toastT > 0) toastT -= dt;
   698	    T.fx.update(dt);
   699	    T.updateFloats(dt);
   700	
   701	    if (screen === 'garden' || screen === 'end' || screen === 'choice' || screen === 'boot') {
   702	      st.dayT = (st.dayT + dt / 54) % 1;
   703	      st.night = (1 - Math.cos(st.dayT * 6.28318)) / 2;
   704	    }
   705	    if (screen === 'level') updateBoard(dt);
   706	
   707	    if (screen === 'boot') drawBoot();
   708	    else if (screen === 'garden') drawGarden();
   709	    else if (screen === 'level') drawLevel();
   710	    else if (screen === 'choice') drawChoice();
   711	    else drawEnd();
   712	  }
   713	
   714	  fit();
   715	  if (st.lvl >= 15) st.done = true;
   716	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   717	})(TT);

  1088	    if (!record) return;
  1089	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1090	    pressedButtonPointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1091	    if (event.pointerId === boardPointerId) boardPointerId = null;
  1092	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1093	    if (cancelled || orientationBlocked) return;

  1095	    if (record.kind === 'board') {
  1096	      const dx = point.x - record.startX;
  1097	      const dy = point.y - record.startY;
  1098	      const start = record.cell;
  1099	      if (!start) return;
  1100	      if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > 16) {
  1101	        let toCol = start.col;
  1102	        let toRow = start.row;
  1103	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) toCol += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  1104	        else toRow += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  1105	        if (toCol >= 0 && toCol < COLS && toRow >= 0 && toRow < ROWS) queueAction({ type: 'swipe', col: start.col, row: start.row, toCol, toRow });
  1106	      } else {
  1107	        const cell = cellFromPoint(point);
  1108	        if (cell) queueAction({ type: 'tap', col: cell.col, row: cell.row });
  1109	      }
  1110	    } else {
  1111	      const hit = hitAt(point);
  1112	      if (hit && hit.kind === 'button' && hit.id === record.id) {
  1113	        if (record.id === 'start') queueAction({ type: 'start' });
  1114	        if (record.id === 'retry') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1115	        if (record.id === 'new') queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1116	        if (record.id === 'continue') queueAction({ type: 'continue' });
  1117	        if (record.id === 'style') queueAction({ type: 'style', style: record.style });
  1118	      }
  1119	    }
  1120	  }
  1121	
  1122	  function handleKeyDown(event) {
  1123	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
  1124	    if (heldKeys.size < 64) heldKeys.add(event.key);
  1125	    const key = event.key;
  1126	    const actionKey = key === 'ArrowLeft' || key === 'ArrowRight' || key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key.toLowerCase() === 'r' || key.toLowerCase() === 'n';
  1127	    if (actionKey) event.preventDefault();
  1128	    if (event.repeat) return;
  1129	    if (state === 'intro' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ type: 'start' });
  1130	    else if (state === 'level') {
  1131	      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'r') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1132	      else if (key === 'ArrowLeft') moveCursor(-1, 0);
  1133	      else if (key === 'ArrowRight') moveCursor(1, 0);
  1134	      else if (key === 'ArrowUp') moveCursor(0, -1);
  1135	      else if (key === 'ArrowDown') moveCursor(0, 1);
  1136	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'tap', col: cursor.col, row: cursor.row });
  1137	    } else if (state === 'decorate') {
  1138	      if (key === 'ArrowLeft') decorFocus = (decorFocus + 2) % 3;
  1139	      else if (key === 'ArrowRight') decorFocus = (decorFocus + 1) % 3;
  1140	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'style', style: decorFocus });
  1141	    } else if (state === 'commentary' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ type: 'continue' });
  1142	    else if (state === 'fail') {
  1143	      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'n') queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1144	      else if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') queueAction({ type: 'retry' });
  1145	    } else if (state === 'end' && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || key.toLowerCase() === 'n')) queueAction({ type: 'new' });
  1146	  }
  1147	
  1148	  function frame(now) {
  1149	    const dt = lastFrame ? Math.min(0.033, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000)) : 0;
  1150	    lastFrame = now;
  1151	    if (!orientationBlocked) update(dt);
  1152	    draw();
  1153	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1154	  }
  1155	
  1156	  let boardPointerId = null;
  1157	  const initialSave = readSave();
  1158	  if (initialSave) {
  1159	    choices = initialSave.choices;
  1160	    currentLevel = initialSave.currentLevel;
  1161	    bestScore = initialSave.bestScore;
  1162	    totalScore = initialSave.totalScore;
  1163	    saveStage = initialSave.stage;
  1164	  }
  1165	  resizeCanvas();
  1166	  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas, { passive: true });
  1167	  window.addEventListener('blur', clearInputState);
  1168	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown, { passive: false });
  1169	  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove, { passive: false });
  1170	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => releasePointer(event, false), { passive: false });
  1171	  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', (event) => releasePointer(event, true), { passive: false });
  1172	  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => event.preventDefault());
  1173	  window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, { passive: false });
  1174	  window.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => { heldKeys.delete(event.key); });
  1175	  window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1176	})();

     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var T = {};
     5	
     6	  /* ---------- seeded rng (mulberry32) ---------- */
     7	  T.rng = function (seed) {
     8	    var a = (seed >>> 0) || 1;
     9	    return function () {
    10	      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    11	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    12	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    13	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    14	    };
    15	  };

   379	  /* ---------- gravity + refill ---------- */
   380	  Board.prototype.settle = function () {
   381	    var x, y, CELL = 1;
   382	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   383	      var write = this.rows - 1;
   384	      for (y = this.rows - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   385	        var c = this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
   386	        if (!c) continue;
   387	        if (write !== y) {
   388	          this.cells[write * this.cols + x] = c;
   389	          this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = null;
   390	          c.oy = (y - write) * CELL;   // rows above (negative), scaled by renderer
   391	          c.vy = 0;
   392	        }
   393	        write--;
   394	      }
   395	      for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   396	        var q = this.queue[x];
   397	        while (q.length < 4) q.push(this.rc());
   398	        if (q.length > 8) q.length = 8;
   399	        var nb = mkBlock(q.shift());
   400	        q.push(this.rc());
   401	        nb.oy = -(write - y + 1);
   402	        nb.vy = 0;
   403	        this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = nb;
   404	      }
   405	    }

   408	  /* ---------- end of move ---------- */
   409	  Board.prototype.endOfMove = function () {
   410	    var x, y, c;
   411	    // gears are heavy: each move they sink one row through a plain block
   412	    for (y = this.rows - 2; y >= 0; y--) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   413	      c = this.at(x, y);
   414	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   415	        var dn = this.at(x, y + 1);
   416	        if (dn && dn.k === 'b' && dn.sp === SP_NONE) {
   417	          this.set(x, y + 1, c); this.set(x, y, dn);
   418	          c.oy = -1; dn.oy = 1;
   419	        }
   420	      }
   421	    }
   422	    // gears reaching the floor are collected
   423	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   424	      c = this.at(x, this.rows - 1);
   425	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   426	        this.prog.gear++;
   427	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: this.rows - 1 });
   428	        this.set(x, this.rows - 1, null);
   429	      }
   430	    }
   431	    // balloons rise one cell (swap with a plain block above)
   432	    var risers = [];
   433	    for (y = 1; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   434	      c = this.at(x, y);
   435	      if (c && c.k === 'balloon' && !c._rose) {
   436	        var up = this.at(x, y - 1);
   437	        if (up && up.k === 'b') {
   438	          this.set(x, y - 1, c); this.set(x, y, up);
   439	          c.oy = 1; up.oy = -1; c._rose = 1; risers.push(c);
   440	        }
   441	      }
   442	    }
   443	    for (x = 0; x < risers.length; x++) risers[x]._rose = 0;
   444	    this.settle();
   445	
   446	    // goal / fail evaluation
   447	    var gl = this.def.goals, done =
   448	      this.prog.crate >= gl.crate && this.prog.balloon >= gl.balloon &&
   449	      this.prog.gear >= gl.gear && this.prog.pop >= gl.pop;
   450	    if (done) {
   451	      this.over = 1;
   452	      var ratio = this.movesLeft / Math.max(1, this.def.moves);
   453	      this.stars = ratio >= 0.38 ? 3 : (ratio >= 0.15 ? 2 : 1);
   454	      this.score += this.movesLeft * 120;
   455	    } else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) {
   456	      this.over = -1;
   457	    } else {
   458	      var guard = 0;
   459	      while (!this.hasMove() && guard++ < 30) this.shuffleColors();
   460	    }
   461	    if (this.score > 99999999) this.score = 99999999;
   462	  };

    68	  Board.prototype.build = function () {
    69	    var x, y, i;
    70	    for (i = 0; i < COLS * ROWS; i++) this.cells[i] = mkBlock(this.rc());
    71	    this.queue = [];
    72	    for (x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
    73	      var q = [];
    74	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) q.push(this.rc());
    75	      this.queue.push(q);
    76	    }
    77	    // obstacles. Gears go first and keep a clear chute of plain blocks beneath
    78	    // them, so digging a gear out is always a solvable line of play.
    79	    var gl = this.def.goals, k, tries, blocked = {}, usedCol = {};
    80	    for (k = 0; k < gl.gear; k++) {
    81	      for (tries = 0; tries < 80; tries++) {
    82	        x = this.rng.int(COLS);
    83	        y = 1 + this.rng.int(3);
    84	        if (usedCol[x]) continue;
    85	        var gc = this.at(x, y);
    86	        if (!gc || gc.k !== 'b') continue;
    87	        usedCol[x] = 1;
    88	        this.set(x, y, mkObj('gear'));
    89	        for (var yy = y + 1; yy < ROWS; yy++) blocked[x + ',' + yy] = 1;
    90	        break;
    91	      }
    92	    }
    93	    var spots = [];
    94	    for (k = 0; k < gl.crate; k++) spots.push(['crate', 2, ROWS - 2]);
    95	    for (k = 0; k < gl.balloon; k++) spots.push(['balloon', ROWS - 3, ROWS - 1]);
    96	    for (k = 0; k < spots.length; k++) {
    97	      for (tries = 0; tries < 90; tries++) {
    98	        x = this.rng.int(COLS);
    99	        y = spots[k][1] + this.rng.int(spots[k][2] - spots[k][1] + 1);
   100	        if (blocked[x + ',' + y]) continue;
   101	        var c = this.at(x, y);
   102	        if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   103	        // keep obstacles apart: a crate ringed by crates can become unreachable
   104	        if (tries < 70 && this.neighborObstacles(x, y) > 0) continue;
   105	        this.set(x, y, mkObj(spots[k][0]));
   106	        break;
   107	      }
   108	    }
   109	    // guarantee a legal opening move
   110	    for (tries = 0; tries < 30 && !this.hasMove(); tries++) this.shuffleColors();
   111	  };

   554	  function updateActions() {

   559	      if (orientationBlocked) continue;

   562	        beginFromSave();

   566	        newRun();
   567	      } else if (action.type === 'swipe') {
   568	        performSwap(action.col, action.row, action.toCol, action.toRow);
   569	      } else if (action.type === 'tap') {
   570	        boardTapCell(action.col, action.row);
   571	      } else if (action.type === 'style') {

   573	      } else if (action.type === 'continue') {

   577	      }
   578	    }

   606	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   607	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   608	    ctx.closePath();
   609	  }
